Whether it’s house, techno, old-school rave, or something unexpected. “I love creating sets that bring people together and make great memories” Over the last six years, He has played in venues across Dublin and abroad, including Ibiza. Every set is different, with different crowds and faces connecting with people through music and creating moments they will remember.

tu-thla.name: Tuáthla
tu-thla.bio: A Dublin based DJ & radio presenter. She's built a reputation for curating fun, fast paced sets with high energy and nostalgic moments. Tuathla is a festival favourite known for her crowd-charging sets that fuse house, pop, and floor filling throwbacks. With a radio background and an instinct for big energy moments, she has played stages across Ireland that demand connection, movement, and serious feel-good vibes. Tuáthla moves seamlessly between the studio and the stage. As a DJ and presenter, she has built a reputation for curating fun, fast paced sets that connect with real people. Whether it's a packed venue or a solo car singalong, she knows how to set the tone.

michelle-mccormack.name: Michelle McCormack
michelle-mccormack.bio: Dublins very own hardhouse Dj Michelle McCormack having supported Ewan Mcvicar she is definitely one not to be missed

eskay.name: Eskay
eskay.bio: DJ and producer from Dublin, Ireland, known for her infectious energy, genre-blending sets, and ever-evolving sound. Bursting onto the scene in late 2022, she's quickly carved out a name for herself within the Irish electronic music community. Since her debut, she's played alongside a stellar lineup of homegrown talent, lighting up dancefloors at many of Dublin's most respected venues as well as in a number of bars in Tenerife and Ibiza. Her style is rooted in electronic and dance music, delivering a playful and polished journey through genres, always with a focus on uplifting, bouncy rhythms that bring joy to the crowd. Whether it's a peak-time set or a deeper, more intimate vibe, she has a natural instinct for reading the room and guiding dancers on a feel-good ride. She organises regular events with her collective THC DJs and is the host of The Ultimate Playlist, her weekly radio show on PlayFm.

the-dirty-disco.name: The Dirty Disco
the-dirty-disco.bio: The Dirty Disco was born in Berlin and raised on dancefloors around the world. Now one of Ireland’s most distinctive travelling parties, it brings its signature house sound to everything from tiny pubs to packed festival stages—always tuning into the crowd, never losing its spark. Led by founding member Jamie Sugrue, The Dirty Disco isn’t your typical club brand or touring act—it’s a living, breathing party. Sets are built in the moment, shaped by the energy in the room, and laced with familiar vocals, cheeky samples, and infectious beats. With stops in London, New York, and beyond, the vibe is always inclusive, unpretentious, and made to move. Whether you’re two-stepping in a tent or going full send under the stars, expect a night of connection, spontaneity, and a touch of Berlin mischief

the-discobox-collective.name: The Discobox Collective
the-discobox-collective.bio: The DiscoBox Collective DJ 4some made up of Paulo ,Aaron ,Stevie & Manwelli — 4 selectors united by a deep love for disco, house, and sparkle ! One for the more mature crowd with their throwbacks and sold out over 30s events if you see the container rocking please come a knockin

dj-jessica-maciel.name: DJ Jessica Maciel
dj-jessica-maciel.bio: Jessica Maciel is a Dublin-based DJ with a background in radio and a growing passion for live sets. Known for her fun, feel-good mixes and love of house, funky house and dance music, she brings good energy to every gig. Off the decks, she runs her own tattoo studio and shares her creative life online, connecting with people through music and community

groove-palette.name: Groove & Palette
groove-palette.bio: Looking for a creative way to relax during the festival? Drop by Groove & Palette at the ArtLot Area, a casual painting space hosted by Aleksandra Golanska and her team, where you can unwind, express yourself, and enjoy some great music. Whether you are an experienced artist or have never picked up a paintbrush before, you are welcome to join in and create at your own pace! Bring your friends, meet new people, or simply take a break from exploring the festival. Groove & Palette is all about enjoying the moment through creativity and fun! Open to all ages and skill levels, it's the perfect place to unwind and unleash your creativity.

joe-skylark.name: Joe Skylark
joe-skylark.bio: Joe Skylark has been releasing music both as a solo artist and formerly as part of Heroes in Hiding for over 15 years. He has been nominated for Choice Music Prize song of the year and has toured extensively in his career. His collaborations with A-Musing take on a more light hearted tone; lampooning politics, popular culture and even Electric Picnic itself!

rhythm-people-recordings.name: Rhythm People Recordings
rhythm-people-recordings.bio: Rhythm People Recordings: Following the success of our inaugural release by label co-founder Barrio B, which reached #11 on the Traxsource Charts with support from Mr. Scruff, DJ Vadim, Aroop Roy, Kiko Navarro, and BBC Radio 6, I am writing to introduce Ireland's first Afro-Latin record label: Rhythm People Recordings.After a sold-out label launch at Fidelity Studios in Dublin earlier this year, label co-founders Lex Woo and Barrio B (aka Bazza Ranks) are now booking their label showcase for upcoming club events, private functions, and festivals. The showcase features world-class percussion master Basil Isaac (Black2Basic) and is hosted by the legendary MC Kwasi.

teggy.name: Teggy
teggy.bio: Teggy is a rap MC, born in Birmingham in the UK in the 90’s when Jamaican culture was rising in the city. In his teens he moved to Athlone, Ireland. Drawing inspiration from his life in Birmingham shedding skin, creating a new mindset and dealing with life’s situations through a different lens. Teggy’s music embodies a spiritual vibe that represents hope and the mantra of “One Love, his energetic high-octane shows bring you on a journey to church.  Teggy has performed at Electric Picnic for the last three years, becoming an established artist with Trenchtown Irieland. Teggy is currently working on his new EP, a set of dance drum and bass singles, which have been road tested at Trenchtown Irieland 2025 and will be released in 2026.

will-softly.name: Will Softly
will-softly.bio: DJ Will Softly has been at the beating heart of Treasure Beach since its inception. His music always uplifts the crowd with the best feelgood roots rock reggae music. 1000’s of Treasure Beach revellers have rejoiced in his unique celebration of reggae music. During his career he has supported DJ legends Lee Scratch Perry, Sister Nancy, Cian Finn and Don Letts only to mention a few!  The legendary One World Mash-up on Sunday night at Treasure Beach is one of the highlights of his year! Providing the Funktion One Soundsystem to back him up!!

stellar-jo.name: Stellar Jo
stellar-jo.bio: Stellar Jo is a Donegal-based Irish DJ known for emotive, uplifting and deeply connecting sets rooted in progressive house, deep house and Afro house. Her sound balances power with gentleness, weaving melodic movement and carefully chosen vocals through sets that feel considered, distinctive and beautifully human. Her love of electronic music was shaped in her late teens while living beside Kelly’s in Portrush, one of Ireland’s most iconic clubbing institutions, giving her a deep respect for dance floor storytelling and long-form musical journeys. In just four years, Stellar Jo has progressed from complete beginner to playing festivals and events across Ireland, the UK, Europe and the US, including All Together Now, Éalú le Grá, Jika Jika’s Seaview Sessions, The Cause London and Burning Man.

michael-downing.name: Michael Downing
michael-downing.bio: Michael Downing is an electronic DJ and producer based in County Cork. Formerly known for his part in the DJ duo Malleus and Incus who had been crafting high energy sets ranging in genre from techno, melodic techno, Progressive and Afro house to Deep house. Known for consistency in layering of infectious grooves and heavy baselines. Having played ATN, ÉALÚ le Grà, Izakaya basement The Mayo Burn, The Magic Room, Fire (London). Going from DJ to production was a natural progression to the studio and the latest release on Musique de lune Noire is just out. A remix of Sturge’s Acid Tuesdays by Malleus and incus has been part of his 3-track EP.

mitch-presents.name: Mitch Presents
mitch-presents.bio: Mitch Presents is a DJ and selector with a passion for music that brings people together, he'll be sharing a selection of reggae, roots, world music that have inspired him over the years. His sets are all about good energy, timeless records and creating a warm atmosphere where everyone feels welcome. Expect rhythms, deep cuts and music played from the heart. Come together, dance, and celebrate the simple power of great music.

ray-mcshake.name: Ray McShake
ray-mcshake.bio: Ray McShake:Making a welcome return to Treasure Beach for EP25, Ray McShake steps back into Trenchtown with a crate full of bass-heavy treasures. Known for weaving reggae, dancehall, hip hop and global riddims into one seamless sonic journey, McShake’s sets are equal parts block party and beach party. With deep musical roots in Kingston, Havana and New York, his sound carries the pulse of the Caribbean and the hustle of the streets—expect dubwise drops, hip hop heat, and serious reggae. A long-time crowd favourite and selector with serious credentials, Ray knows how to hold a vibe.

andy-k.name: Andy K
andy-k.bio: DJ Andy K: Self-confessed musical chameleon, Andrew is as likely to be found kicking out summer jams or dubby basslines in a festival tent, as he is ripping up a dancefloor of a sweaty basement with a bag of Disco and Soul stompers. Hailing from the External Sounds collective in Drogheda, he's hosted and played support to the likes of Norman Jay, Don Letts, Jerry Dammers, Terry Hall, Goldfrapp & Ashley Beedle to name but a few.  A regular performer at Irish festivals such as Body & Soul, Electric Picnic, Another Love Story, as well as curating his own events such as Dessert Island Disco, and Global Grooves festival. He's also performed at events in the UK, Berlin, Croatia and Scandinavia.

karmawi.name: Karmawi
karmawi.bio: DJ Karmawi (a slang term for someone from Tul’karm) is a Dublin-born Palestinian producer and DJ ready to deliver middle eastern beans blended with reggae. With a deep-rooted passion not just for expression but for connection, Karmawi’s sets act as portals, drawing listeners into rhythms shaped by distant geographies, collective memories, and the pulse of resistance. From lows that make us groove to highs that move, his sound is both grounding and uplifting. As a resident at Klub Sukar, spreading SWANA music and culture, and a co-founder of the PBBRC music & arts collective, running charity fundraisers for the likes of the Palestine Children's Relief fund and Focus Ireland; at every stage, DJ Karmawi is building more than just a career, he’s building a bridge between dancefloor and diaspora. Inviting the crowd with each set into something bigger: a sonic space where joy, struggle, and identity move together.

bvn.name: BVN
bvn.bio: BVN is a musical performer and vocal artist. Her performances span genres including reggae, alternative, and roots music. Returning to the stage this year, is one of Irelands bright artists. Having played The Workmans Club and Whelans to much acclaim. This set is one not to be missed!

pablo-santo.name: Pablo Santo
pablo-santo.bio: PABLO SANTO: For Pablo music has been a burning passion since early childhood. He studied Brazilian acoustic guitar at The Clube do Choro in Brasilia - it was a no-brainer that he would work in the music industry in some capacity. Pablo moved to Dublin with dreams of pursuing his career as an artist. Pablo became a DJ resident at the Infamous Bernard Shaw where he carved his name in the music scene. Pablo's work consists of exploring his Latin music background bringing the genuine rhythm and flavours of Brazilian music to the dance floor. Currently Pablo and t-woc run Different Rhythm a party label since 2019, and a show on Dublin Digital Radio, if you want to dance to African, Caribbean, and Latin American music. He released African influenced house music, under his alias "Santo" with Jimmy Rouge (Orange Tree Edits), releasing "Milk and Honey" and "Trippin on Frogs".

shimmy-irie.name: Shimmy Irie
shimmy-irie.bio: SHIMMY IRIE: "Aunty Shimmy, also known as Shimmy Irie, is a Dublin-based reggae selector and a founding member of the Irie Ireland Crew. Based in Dublin she has been a regular on the decks in many events. Shimmy has regularly collaborated with other selectors, bringing upfront reggae vibes and deep roots to local venues. She has long supported homegrown Irish reggae and ska music, making her well-known in reggae circles around the Irie Isle of Ireland. Her association with "Trenchtown/Treasure Beach" originates from the well-known reggae and island-themed section of the Electric Picnic Festival in Stradbally, where she has been a regular performer and member of the crew for ten years."

beansidhe.name: Beansidhe
beansidhe.bio: A familiar face on the Electric Picnic Treasure beach stage, Beansidhe returns for a fourth consecutive year after delivering standout performances at the festival over the past four years. Known for bringing authentic roots reggae energy, soulful grooves, and a powerful live presence, each set is a celebration of positivity, unity, and conscious music. This year's performance will feature a mix of classic roots reggae influences alongside original material, showcasing Beansidhes own songwriting and unique sound. With a passion for connecting with audiences and creating an uplifting atmosphere, and this year's set promises to be no exception.

kelsey.name: Kelsey
kelsey.bio: Kelsey is a Galway-based DJ, promoter and party starter who has been lighting up dancefloors in Vietnam, Tenerife, Dublin and Galway over the past few years. In 2022, she launched the @teighsios collective, putting on multi-disciplinary parties focusing on inclusivity around Galway, and made her Irish festival debut at Electric Picnic and Wild Roots. She's also a regular at the Blue Note in Galway's west end and most recently shared the stage with Ireland's wildest Ping Pong Disco in the Button Factory. Kelsey's love for the dancefloor fuses an array of genres into her sets from techy rollers, garage swingers to electro while always providing bass-driven beauty and collaborating with live performers such as Cain Finn and Lady Grew.

kelly-bongo.name: Kelly Bongo
kelly-bongo.bio: Kelly Bongo is a Galway-based Roots Reggae, Dancehall, Afrobeats and Global Bass DJ originally from Dublin and Clare. With over 13 years of experience behind the decks, she has built a reputation for delivering uplifting, high-energy sets that unite people through music, culture and dance. Her professional DJ journey began in Mallorca, where she held a residency at Basement / Disco Inferno, one of Santa Ponsa’s biggest nightclub venues. Since returning to Ireland, Kelly has performed extensively at festivals, cultural events, club nights and sound system sessions both nationally and internationally. Kelly has worked with and held residencies for collectives and events including Afro Bristol, Basement Project, Rave Culture, Galway African Diaspora, Bon Voyage, Riggs Sound System, Mé Féin, Cultur.Riot, Tèigh Síos Comharghrúpa and many more within Ireland’s diverse music and LGBTQIA+ communities. Festival appearances include Electric Picnic, All Together Now, Cepta Festival and Ar Imeall Festival

puffin-man.name: Puffin Man
puffin-man.bio: Puffin Man: Midland Vibration!  Vinyl only reggae selector.  I love sharing the joy of reggae music with positive people and getting the hip shakers moving! I have been going to EP as a punter since the beginning, so it means a lot to be able to give back entertaining people with the music I love!

dj-denfensive.name: DJ Denfensive
dj-denfensive.bio: DJ Defensive is a reggae selector based in Sligo and Drogheda, Ireland. He has played all the major summer festivals such as Electric Picnic, Body and Soul, Vantastival, Sunflower Belfast, Dessert Island Disco, Global Grooves and The Great Outdoors. Along the way he has shared stages with such reggae legends as Jerry Dammers, Wrongtom, Count Skylarkin and Worries Outernational. He once had Don Letts ask him about a tune he was playing! Defensive has been a resident DJ in Mc Phails, Fusion night club, Odd Mollies, Mc Hughs and The Living Room. He also hosted his Rebel Reggae Frequency Show on The Isolation Station. A Defensive set encompasses the full range of Jamaican riddims including ska, rocksteady reggae, early dancehall and lovers rock. Nuff niceness!

sibh-c.name: Sibh C
sibh-c.bio: Sibh C is a female DJ playing ska, rock steady and Caribbean beats. Expect feet stomping head booping beats to take you away to the sunshine. Owner of street 66 Bar Dublin. Selector for over 20 years with Port Royal, Treasure Beach, Trenchtown, Body and Soul, All Together Now. Supporting Nancy Bam, Will Softly, Cian Finn and other legends.

zazaman.name: Zazaman
zazaman.bio: ZAZAMAN is an Artist, songwriter and DJ from Ramacca, a small town in Sicily. He started his musical journey in 2003, writing lyrics in the Sicilian dialect. Two years later, he became involved in the hip hop and reggae scene. In 2012, he co-founded the Ramajca Boyz, a trio made up of childhood friends from the same town. In 2015, he also started creating and editing the band's music videos. The group released their first album, Radici ("Roots"), in 2016, followed by Brexit in 2018, receiving great support from the Italian reggae scene. Ramajca Boyz have opened shows for international artists such as Shaggy, Elephant Man and T.O.K., and have shared the stage the biggest names in the Italian reggae scene, including Boomdabash. In 2025, Zazaman started his journey as a DJ. Today, he brings together reggae, dancehall and modern sounds in energetic sets, sharing his passion for Jamaican music.

one-world-sound.name: One World Sound
one-world-sound.bio: One World Sound has been operating as a reggae/world music collective for over 16 years. Gathering together a group of dedicated roots rock reggae inspired music for all ages.

three-little-birds.name: Three Little Birds
three-little-birds.bio: A collective of female reggae DJ's. Three little birds are sure to get you dancing your cares away. "This is my message to you -ou-ou"

rocksteady-social-club.name: Rocksteady Social Club
rocksteady-social-club.bio: Rocksteady Social Club is a collective of DJs bringing deep cuts, heavy grooves, and unstoppable energy to every dancefloor. From soul and reggae roots and everything in between, Rocksteady Social Club isn’t just a party — it’s a movement.

bob-marley-reggae-tribute-dj-set.name: BOB MARLEY REGGAE TRIBUTE (DJ SET)
bob-marley-reggae-tribute-dj-set.bio: BOB MARLEY REGGAE TRIBUTE (DJ SET). One love. One heart. One unforgettable night. Join us for a feel-good reggae session celebrating the music of Bob Marley — all your favourite classics played loud, from No Woman No Cry to Three Little Birds, Exodus, One Love and more. DJ set spinning Marley all night. Singalong moments — don’t hold back! Good vibes only | Positive energy. Come sing. Come dance. Feel Irie.

mojo.name: Mojo
mojo.bio: Mojo: Born in Kenya and shaped by a life of travel, Andrew Stanley is a singer-songwriter whose music blends folk, blues and acoustic rock. With soulful melodies, thoughtful lyrics and a warm, engaging style, he creates songs for wanderers, dreamers and seekers alike. Matthew Smawfield: Musician/Producer founder of The Electric Caravan which promotes original music and acoustic performances by artists like @gurugang_og and @lavosti. The band streams tracks across major platforms and frequently posts clips of their live sets and music releases online.

ceola-haile.name: Ceola Haile
ceola-haile.bio: Being blessed with a name that was inspired by music and spiritual power, Ceola Haile, rose through the reggae scene from birth! Spending her youth singing on Revelation Sound System, breaking bread with world class Dub artists and sound system family at the kitchen table, to sharing quality moments and music with many; such as the mighty Jah Shaka, Dan Imperial, Alpha and Omega, Conscious Sounds, Lavosti, Channel One, YT, Kebra Ethiopia, Cian Finn, Wiggle, Firehouse, Rootical, WBC, Zion Train, Murrayman, Iration Steppas and many, many more! As a young woman, she is already well versed in the roots, reggae and dancehall genre, being exposed to such veterans!

chlo-pixie.name: Chloë Pixie
chlo-pixie.bio: **Chloë Pixie** is a professional contortionist and belly dancer with years of live performance experience, known for blending fluid belly dance technique with striking contortion work. Her performances are vibrant and dynamic, featuring colourful props, expressive movement, and a strong connection to music that brings each set to life. At Electric Picnic, Chloë Pixie will bring high-energy, visually captivating performances to Treasure Beach, performing to reggae-inspired sets alongside DJ Will Softly. Her style is playful, immersive, and designed to lift the atmosphere and draw audiences into the rhythm. With a strong festival presence and a focus on audience engagement, Chloë Pixie delivers a bold, feel-good performance experience that is colourful, unique, and not to be missed.

pearl-the-water-nymph.name: Pearl the Water Nymph
pearl-the-water-nymph.bio: Pearl the water nymph will be found at Treasure Beach at Electric Picnic, alongside Chloe Pixie and DJ Will Softly. Pearl is a belly dancer, and she loves to integrate belly dancing into all styles of music. She is passionate about getting the crowd moving and will be coming to Treasure Beach bringing her mysterious and sensual touch, to captivate and inspire others to move their bodies to the beat, to let go and live in the magic of the moment.

ian-hart.name: Ian Hart
ian-hart.bio: Ian Hart: Founder of Basement Project, Scrobarnach & Lá Tech Music Conference. Ian, Galway based now, Ian is heavily involved in the electronic music scene in the west of Ireland. A DJ and vinyl enthusiast for over 14 years under his TripdiscO moniker, Ian has gained himself a reputation for his diverse taste in music, from deep, progressive house, acid, Detroit techno, and minimal, to afrobeat, reggae and worlds beats. His chameleonic and acute selections have won him residencies at a number of Galway's best music venues including The Blue Note, Factory, Club Aras Na Gael, and Electric, as well as gigs in the UK, Spain, Australia, and at festivals such as Life Festival, SunflowerFest, Decompression, Fuinneamh Festival, Vantastival, Electric Picnic.

inklings-with-jimmy-o-connell-mary-eagan.name: INKLINGS with JIMMY O CONNELL, MARY EAGAN CAMBELL, JEANETTE EVERSON, CLARE O REILLY
inklings-with-jimmy-o-connell-mary-eagan.bio: Inklings is a vibrant, welcoming creative-writing group based in Mullingar, Co. Westmeath. Formed in 2016, it brings together writers of all abilities, styles and genres who share a passion for the written word. For this reading they're joined by members Jimmy O'Connell, Mary Egan Campbell, Jeanette Everson and Clare O'Reilly — poets whose work ranges from Dublin storytelling to finding elevated meaning in the everyday.

luan-press-with-lee-sheridan-andy-porter.name: LUAN PRESS with LEE SHERIDAN, ANDY PORTER, ELENA STACK MARTIN, MICHELLE BOSONNETT
luan-press-with-lee-sheridan-andy-porter.bio: Founded in 2022 by Lee Sheridan, Luain Press is an Irish publishing platform championing prose, poetry and spoken word from new and emerging writers. This showcase gathers Luain Press voices Lee Sheridan, Andy Porter, Elena Stack Martin and Michelle Bosonnett — from award-winning debut collections to work spanning Ireland and beyond.

cass-north-kevin-brennan-colm-mcgearailt.name: CASS NORTH, KEVIN BRENNAN, COLM McGEARAILT
cass-north-kevin-brennan-colm-mcgearailt.bio: A three-hander of distinctive voices. Cass North is a poet from Ireland's north coast, winner of the 2024 Speak the Word Poetry Slam and the 2021 Bangor Poetry Competition, with work featured internationally. Kevin Brennan is a Dublin actor, novelist and poet, seen on stage in the acclaimed civil-war drama The Best Man. They're joined by Colm McGearailt.

slip-of-the-tongue-with-wayne-power-nico.name: SLIP OF THE TONGUE with WAYNE POWER, NICOLA SPENDLOVE, TIM O DRISCOLL
slip-of-the-tongue-with-wayne-power-nico.bio: Slip of the Tongue, launched in 2022, is a night of spoken word, poetry, live music and comedy hosted by Waterford artist Wayne Power — a supportive but cutting-edge platform for up-and-coming talent. Here Power is joined by Nicola Spendlove, a writer, actor and producer who moved from spoken word into theatre, and Cork poet Tim O'Driscoll, an Honours English graduate and Munster slam finalist.

sean-corrigan-annie-the-witness.name: SEAN CORRIGAN, ANNIE & THE WITNESS
sean-corrigan-annie-the-witness.bio: Two contrasting acts share the stage. Sean Corrigan returns to Electric Picnic — a writer focused on rhythm and tongue-twisting wordplay, exploring self-expression through poetry and fashion. annie & the witness are a Dublin-based post-punk band who debuted in 2024, drawing on art rock, spoken word and gothic aesthetics to channel intimate rage and spectacle.

the-magic-of-mythology-with-marty-mullig.name: THE MAGIC OF MYTHOLOGY WITH MARTY MULLIGAN, BOBBO THE BARD
the-magic-of-mythology-with-marty-mullig.bio: A spellbinding celebration of story and song hosted by Marty Mulligan — a Mullingar native, a major driving force in the Irish festival scene and a passionate champion of his hometown. Joined by Bobbo the Bard, The Magic of Mythology blends words, myth and music.

d-abdu.name: D_ABDU
d-abdu.bio: d_abdu is the moniker and the Xbox 360 gamertag of Ethio/Irish musician Dara Abdurahman. Hidden in plain view playing bass in BRICKNASTY since its inception, Dara now pursues his own sound, drawing from Elliott Smith, Grouper and The Microphones to make up the DNA of the d_abdu project.

nathan-johnson.name: NATHAN JOHNSON
nathan-johnson.bio: Blending the grit of the blues, laid back folk and the heart of classic soul, Nathan Johnston is part crooner, part storyteller crafting songs that sit somewhere between retro and modern but with a timeless appeal. Hailing from Mullingar in Ireland, Johnston first made waves under the alias Sion Hill touring Europe with acts like Pete Doherty, A ha, and Alice Merton.

heron-red.name: HERON RED
heron-red.bio: With a sound that fuses vibes from Dolly Parton, and Simon and Garfunkel, Heron Red is a dynamic folk duo with a full-band sound. The band blends traditional Irish music with Americana, country, and traditional folk. Composed of songwriters Molly Buchan and Callum Wall, the duo crafts music that ranges from stripped-back storytelling, echoing the poetic depth of Bob Dylan and Joni Mitchell, to the soaring, full-bodied energy of The Waterboys and Planxty.

sei-green.name: SEI GREEN
sei-green.bio: Sei Green is a Dublin-based project led by duo Adam Garrett and Ellen Sleator. Blending soul, funk and disco with dreamy psychedelic textures, they create groove-led songs that feel hazy, immersive and quietly emotional. Their sound sits somewhere between laid-back funk and dream pop, with smooth basslines and lush layered instrumentation carried by breathy unison vocals. The warmth of their recordings is brought to life on stage by Will Aranha on drums and Arthur Noswitz on guitar, adding movement, texture and depth to their hypnotic rhythms. Drawing subtle comparisons to Khruangbin, Men I Trust and Parcels, Sei Green crafts music that feels both intimate and expansive, reflective lyricism wrapped in melodies that linger. At its heart, Sei Green is two pals making groovy, sleepy music, soundtracks for slow mornings, late evenings and everything in between.

baleia-baleia-baleia.name: BALEIA BALEIA BALEIA
baleia-baleia-baleia.bio: Baleia Baleia Baleia formed in late 2015. The band consists of Manuel Molarinho (bass and vocals) and Ricardo Cabral (drums and vocals). They are highly regarded in the independent Portuguese music scene for blending urgent, vibrant punk energy with witty, socially conscious lyrics that turn misery into a party.

adore.name: ADORE
adore.bio: Adore are a dynamic Irish garage-punk trio formed in 2022. Known for their melodic, guitar-driven sound, the group has quickly become a standout act in the Irish underground scene. Adore's frantic, kinetic style combines garage punk ferocity with elements of surf and early Britpop. They are often likened to legendary bands like The Breeders, Elastica, and their Irish contemporaries, Sprints. Known for a commanding gang mentality on stage, they have relentlessly toured across Ireland and the UK, supporting bands like Sprints, The Scratch and Chalk, as well as performing at festivals like All Together Now.

carla-beattie-rude-judes-adele-leahy-dan.name: CARLA BEATTIE, RUDE JUDES, ADELE LEAHY, DANIEL BRESLIN
carla-beattie-rude-judes-adele-leahy-dan.bio: Four spoken-word voices with plenty to say. Carla Beattie is a mother, psychologist and poet writing about parenthood, womanhood, love and identity. Rude Judes serves witty observations of life drawn from Australia, London and Cobh. Adele Leahy is a seasoned performer and slam finalist who's graced Electric Picnic and the Fingal Poetry Festival. They're joined by Daniel Breslin.

fiona-o-loughlin-cat-brogan-dom-byrne.name: FIONA O LOUGHLIN, CAT BROGAN, DOM BYRNE
fiona-o-loughlin-cat-brogan-dom-byrne.bio: A rich mix of performance poetry. Fiona O'Loughlin is an actress and multidisciplinary artist from Co. Clare whose lyrical, character-driven work is steeped in Irish music and folklore. Cat Brogan, from Omagh, is the 2024 Ulster Poetry Slam Champion, exploring place, memory, queerness and post-conflict identity. Dom Byrne is a Kilkenny poet, Dublin-based, bringing his own wry, warm style.

the-poetry-kiln-collective-with-annie-pe.name: THE POETRY KILN COLLECTIVE with ANNIE PETER, ANNA D, MIKEY CULLEN, DAVID HYNES
the-poetry-kiln-collective-with-annie-pe.bio: The Poetry Kiln Collective is a Dublin-based platform for contemporary spoken word and interdisciplinary performance, hosting open mics and workshops. This year they've toured with Mike Garry, shared a stage with David J of Bauhaus, and performed at Seamus Heaney HomePlace. Featuring Annie Peter, Anna D, Mikey Cullen and co-founder David Hynes.

latrice-roisin-kearney-julie-goo.name: LATRICE, ROISIN KEARNEY, JULIE GOO
latrice-roisin-kearney-julie-goo.bio: Three dynamic voices from the Irish scene. Roisín Kearney, aka FloRo, is a spoken-word artist, poet and rapper from Dublin 22 and a fixture of the booming Irish hip-hop and poetry scene. Julie Goo is a bilingual poet, writer and singer from Cork City, an award-winning slam poet published in Poetry Ireland Review and The Stinging Fly. They're joined by Latrice.

lauren-mcnamara-ben-mccaoilte-hazel-hoga.name: LAUREN McNAMARA, BEN McCAOILTE, HAZEL HOGAN
lauren-mcnamara-ben-mccaoilte-hazel-hoga.bio: A powerhouse trio. Dr Lauren McNamara is a Limerick poet, playwright and essayist, three-time Munster slam champion and author of Quarter Life Crisis. Ben MacCaoilte is a multidisciplinary artist blending poetry, spoken word and experimental soundscapes rooted in Irish storytelling and folklore. Hazel Hogan is a Dublin poet and facilitator whose poem 'Grangegorman' features on the Junior Cycle syllabus.

the-dead-thatchers-annie-francis.name: THE DEAD THATCHERS, ANNIE FRANCIS
the-dead-thatchers-annie-francis.bio: The Dead Thatchers (Alienpig Rave Experiment) are an offshoot of the Glasgow art-punk collective, pairing Derry-based Glaswegian spoken-word performer and musician Willy Copeland's beat- and loop-driven electronic soundscapes with live words. Joined by Annie Francis, a bilingual poet whose fiery, anti-capitalist work spans the Irish language, Palestine and our connection to nature.

the-adventurers-with-johnny-coyne-friend.name: THE ADVENTURERS WITH JOHNNY COYNE & FRIENDS
the-adventurers-with-johnny-coyne-friend.bio: Johnny Coyne is an Irish adventurer, entrepreneur and speaker from Clonbur, Co. Galway. Alongside paddling partner Liam Cotter he completed a monumental expedition, and now brings The Adventurers to the stage — a rousing set of storytelling and friends celebrating the spirit of adventure.

good-strangers.name: GOOD STRANGERS
good-strangers.bio: Good Strangers are an Irish indie band whose music offers a lyrically bare-chested exploration of transition — love, loss, sexuality and the shift from free-spirited youth to adulthood. Best friends since childhood, led by singers Niamh and Co, they bring warmth and raw honesty to the stage.

dagda.name: DAGDA
dagda.bio: DAGDA is a new music and artistic collective founded by poet Leon Dunne and Simon Jones, former bassist of The Verve and guitarist for Gorillaz. The collective is currently slow-releasing their debut album 'MONGRAL', which features multiple Irish and UK based artists including former band members of The Verve: Simon Jones and Peter Salisbury, with new tracks scheduled for monthly release throughout the year. Blending Irish traditional music with rock, folk, blues, and jazz alongside spoken word and poetry, DAGDA stands apart through its seamless integration of multiple artistic mediums. Music and poetry are not merely combined but balanced as equal forces, creating a rich, sonic experience that transcends conventional boundaries.

beat-club.name: BEAT CLUB
beat-club.bio: Beat Club, a Mullingar-based improvised music collective, take to the stage on Saturday. Rooted in improvisation, Beat Club moves fluidly across jazz, funk, blues, soul and beyond, with no two shows ever the same.

paulie-martin.name: PAULIE MARTIN
paulie-martin.bio: Paulie Martin is a renowned musician, singer and songwriter whose work brings stories of love, excitement and culture through rhythmic, poetic lyrics, dynamic vocal harmony and acoustic rock-band arrangements.

anne-tannam-alicia-byrne-keane-catriona-.name: ANNE TANNAM, ALICIA BYRNE KEANE, CATRIONA LANE
anne-tannam-alicia-byrne-keane-catriona-.bio: Three award-winning poets. Anne Tannam is the author of four collections, most recently 'dismantle' (Salmon Poetry, 2024), and a former Poet in Residence with Poetry Ireland. Alicia Byrne Keane is a Dublin poet moving between spoken word and the page, writing on housing, nature, gender and everyday life. Caitríona Lane is a bilingual writer from Dublin, now in Connemara, and a multiple Irish-language poetry award winner.

tiny-little-gods-keith-hanna.name: TINY LITTLE GODS, KEITH HANNA
tiny-little-gods-keith-hanna.bio: Tiny Little Gods is the creative partnership of Sarah and Aaron Lennon Ross, who over twenty years have worked across textile design, theatre, film, illustration and stand-up, now bringing their blend of dark humour and craft to the stage. Joined by Keith Hanna, performing extracts from his debut spoken-word play with music.

eva-mary-lucy-holly-hughes-chiamaka-enyi.name: EVA MARY LUCY, HOLLY HUGHES, CHIAMAKA ENYI-AMADI
eva-mary-lucy-holly-hughes-chiamaka-enyi.bio: Three of the finest voices in spoken word. Eva Mary Lucy is a Belgian artist based in Dublin, winner of the 2024 Talkatives Grand Slam and 2025 All-Ireland Poetry Slam Championship, representing Ireland at the European championship. Holly Hughes, from Clonakilty, took her sold-out show to Dublin and Brighton Fringe and represented Ireland at the 2025 Poetry Slam World Cup. Chiamaka Enyi-Amadi is a commissioned poet and anthology editor published in The Stinging Fly and Poetry International.

a-musing-with-joe-skylark-liam-mccabe-co.name: A-MUSING with JOE SKYLARK, LIAM McCABE, CORMACK Mac GEARAILT, DAVID HYNES
a-musing-with-joe-skylark-liam-mccabe-co.bio: A-Musing returns to Electric Picnic with its trademark mix of hilarity and depth. This year's team brings together Liam McCabe, Joe Skylark, Cormac Mac Gearailt and David Hynes, with special guest Alan Nolan — musicians and spoken-word artists weaving music and poetry into one warm, funny, moving set.

rising-tide-with-leon-dunne-sheila-ryder.name: RISING TIDE with LEON DUNNE, SHEILA RYDER, KALLE RYAN, JOHN CUMMINS
rising-tide-with-leon-dunne-sheila-ryder.bio: Rising Tide showcases the phenomenal breadth of poetry and music talent across Ireland, giving artists a platform to reach a wider audience. This session features Leon Dunne, a working-class Dublin poet writing with high energy about voices outside the mainstream; All-Ireland slam finalist Sheila Ryder; spoken-word trailblazer and LINGO co-founder Kalle Ryan; and John Cummins.

dublins-finest-with-james-william-dillon.name: DUBLINS FINEST with JAMES WILLIAM DILLON, NICOLA CLARE, CONOR KILEEN
dublins-finest-with-james-william-dillon.bio: Poetry is having a moment in Ireland, and Dublin's Finest is at the heart of it — built by artists for artists, showcasing up-and-coming poets and musicians from the basement of Sin E to the Electric Picnic stage. Featuring James William Dillon (aka Jimbo), Fingal Slam winner; Nicola Clare, a north-county Dub who says yes to every stage; and Conor Kileen, whose sold-out debut 'Yup The Poems x' lit up Dublin this year.

dec-byrne.name: DEC BYRNE
dec-byrne.bio: Dec (Declan) Byrne is a staple of the midlands live-music scene, known for his distinctive voice and acoustic guitar, performing original songs alongside popular classics.

steph-hurley.name: STEPH HURLEY
steph-hurley.bio: Steph Hurley is an Irish singer/songwriter taking the music scene by storm across Ireland and New York City. Now based in NYC, Steph can be found performing at some of the city's busiest and most vibrant music venues, delivering unforgettable shows packed with energy, emotion, and personality. With her infectious stage presence and ability to connect with audiences, Steph is quickly becoming one of the exciting new voices emerging from the Irish music scene. Her single 'I'm Fine.' was named Track of the Weekend by RTÉ 2FM, further cementing Steph's place as a rising artist to watch. Steph is thrilled to return to Electric Picnic for a second consecutive year.

some-ones-sons.name: SOME ONES SONS
some-ones-sons.bio: Some One's Sons are one of Ireland's most exciting emerging folk acts, blending traditions of Irish folk music with contemporary songwriting and raw storytelling. The five-piece from Mullingar have earned a reputation as one of Ireland's most dynamic live folk acts, delivering powerful performances and original songs that capture the realities, struggles, humour, and spirit of modern Irish life. Drawing inspiration from The Clancy Brothers, Planxty and Christy Moore, the Sons have developed a catalogue of original songs that blend heartfelt storytelling with the energy and spirit of modern Irish folk music. In 2026, they released their debut EP The Boom Is Back. They recently embarked on their debut Irish and UK tour, which included sold-out shows in London, Liverpool and Dublin, and have shared stages with Sharon Shannon, Seán Keane, The Wolfe Tones, George Murphy, The Fureys and The Scratch.

george-murphy.name: GEORGE MURPHY
george-murphy.bio: George Murphy is an Irish singer-songwriter from Beaumont, Dublin, who exploded onto the scene with memorable appearances on RTÉ's You're a Star, quickly winning over audiences while still just out of school.

delyra.name: DELYRA
delyra.bio: DELYRA is an Irish folk group rooted in tradition yet unafraid to explore its darker, more evocative edges. Formed in the heart of the Irish Midlands, the band brings together musicians whose individual stories and talents intertwine to create a sound that is both timeless and strikingly original.

ruaile-buaile.name: RUAILE BUAILE
ruaile-buaile.bio: Ruaile Buaile are an Irish based 5-piece twisted-trad band, based in the midlands of Ireland. The group formed in 2011. In 2021, world renowned musician Cathal Guinan (fiddle) joined the band, followed by Seán Bourke (banjo) in 2023. Along with original members Niall Kelly (vocals and guitar), Jack Godley (percussion) and Shane Lynam (vocals and bass), the quintet are entertaining audiences with a bigger than ever sound. From upbeat old Irish favourites, ground thumping trad, and unique twists on recent day classics, this collective are bringing their energy to masses around Ireland and further afield.

laois-today-and-colm-parkinson-of-the-sm.name: Laois Today and Colm Parkinson of the Smaller Fish Podcast
laois-today-and-colm-parkinson-of-the-sm.bio: Local media favourites LaoisToday return to the festival with a sit-down interview featuring one of the biggest names in Irish sports broadcasting — Colm Parkinson of the Smaller Fish Podcast. He'll chat about his own football career, his move into the media, and how he built the biggest GAA audience in the country.

crime-world-podcast-with-nicola-tallant-.name: Crime World Podcast with Nicola Tallant: The Dapper Don
crime-world-podcast-with-nicola-tallant-.bio: Crime World is a hit podcast hosted by award-winning Irish investigative journalist Nicola Tallant, exploring the gritty realities of organised crime, drug cartels, and the global underworld.

how-to-gael.name: How to Gael
how-to-gael.bio: Ireland's number-one bilingual podcast, live and unscripted. Doireann Ní Ghlacáin, Louise Cantillon and Síomha Ní Ruairc slide between Gaeilge and English mid-sentence, covering everything from group-chat drama to the state of the nation. No grammar drills, no modh coinníollach, just craic den scoth.

rt-documentary-on-one-the-composers-lfur.name: RTÉ Documentary On One: The Composers — Úlfur Eldjárn, Paddy Flynn & Alma Kelliher
rt-documentary-on-one-the-composers-lfur.bio: Experience the soundtracks that drive hit true-crime and investigative podcasts. Every RTÉ Documentary On One series features a custom-commissioned soundtrack that acts as the musical heartbeat of the story. All are then released as standalone soundtrack albums. In this exclusive session, three award-winning composers dissect the art of music composition for audio storytelling. Alma Kelliher reveals how she channelled tension for the recent dark investigative series, Pirate Predator. Icelandic Music Award-winner Úlfur Eldjárn breaks down his haunting, award-winning score for Where is Jón?, the story of a missing Icelandic poker player. And local Laois-based composer Paddy Flynn shares his melodic approach to tracking the global con artist Samantha Azzopardi in the series Finding Samantha. They'll share their inspirations, break down their creative processes, and each will perform live tracks from their scores. The ultimate collision of original music and gripping audio journalism.

the-irish-times-inside-politics-podcast-.name: The Irish Times Inside Politics Podcast with Political Editor Pat Leahy and Political Correspondents Ellen Coyne and Jack Horgan Jones
the-irish-times-inside-politics-podcast-.bio: The paper of record's politics podcast, live in a field. Political Editor Pat Leahy is joined by political correspondents Ellen Coyne and Jack Horgan-Jones to unpack the summer's plotting and what the autumn holds for the Coalition. The Dáil may be in recess, but the intrigue never takes a holiday.

house-warming-with-james-kavanagh-and-wi.name: House Warming with James Kavanagh and William Murray and Kim Buckley
house-warming-with-james-kavanagh-and-wi.bio: Housewarming is your inside look at real Irish homes transforming for a greener energy future. The show is all about helping you to make your home a warmer, more energy efficient, and beautiful place to live. For this special live episode, host Kim Buckley is joined by James Kavanagh and his partner William Murray. James and William have left Dublin, which they've called home together for the last 11 years, in search of a simpler life in the countryside. They've bought a house in Kilkenny with an acre of mature garden ready for planting and growing, and have undergone a major renovation to make their home more energy efficient and suitable for their lifestyle. They join Kim to chat about their renovation journey and hopes and plans for the future.

catch-up-with-louise-mcsharry-and-carl-k.name: Catch Up with Louise McSharry and Carl Kinsella with Emer McLysaght
catch-up-with-louise-mcsharry-and-carl-k.bio: The weekly podcast that takes the news and the nonsense equally seriously, recorded live at MindField. Louise McSharry is joined by her regular news correspondent Carl Kinsella and special guest Emer McLysaght, co-author of the Aisling novels, to sift through the week just gone: politics, culture, reality television and whatever the group chat is currently fighting about.

paul-howard-presents-ross-o-carroll-kell.name: Paul Howard presents: Ross O'Carroll Kelly
paul-howard-presents-ross-o-carroll-kell.bio: Nearly three decades, twenty-odd novels and one weekly Irish Times column later, Ross remains south Dublin's most quotable rugby jock. Creator Paul Howard brings him to life on stage: Sorcha, Honor, the old man, and whatever fresh disgrace the Rossmeister has visited on the southside this season. A field in Laois is not remotely Ross's scene, which makes this all the sweeter.

shane-mccarthy-i-said-what-i-said.name: Shane McCarthy - I Said What I Said
shane-mccarthy-i-said-what-i-said.bio: One of Ireland's most-followed content creators takes the chat off the phone and onto a stage. Shane McCarthy's weekly podcast has built a devoted audience on pure honesty: life, love, pop culture and the stories most people would keep to themselves. Unfiltered, chaotic and very funny. He said what he said.

fifth-court-podcast-with-jason-carty-on-.name: Fifth Court Podcast with Jason Carty on The Beatles
fifth-court-podcast-with-jason-carty-on-.bio: Ireland's legal podcast meets the most litigated band in history. Barristers Peter Leonard and Mark Tottenham are joined by Beatles obsessive Jason Carty of Nothing Is Real to open the case files: the break-up suit, the wars over Apple, and how four lads from Liverpool kept half the lawyers in London busy for decades.

shite-talk-history.name: Shite Talk History
shite-talk-history.bio: Irish history with the reverence removed. The hit comedy history podcast takes the national story — rebels, chancers, saints and absolute disasters — and tells it the way it would be told at the back of the bus. Educational despite itself.

behind-the-scenes-the-art-of-investigati.name: Behind the Scenes: The Art of Investigative Audio with RTÉ Documentary on One. Shauna McGreevy, David Doran, Nicoline Greer, Liam O'Brien
behind-the-scenes-the-art-of-investigati.bio: Step inside the multi-award-winning world of RTÉ Documentary on One to discover how gripping investigative journalism becomes world-class audio storytelling. The creators behind hit narrative series — including The Nobody Zone, Finding Samantha, Runaway Joe, The Real Carrie Jade, Where is Jón?, Stolen Sister and Pirate Predator — reveal their deep-dive reporting craft. This session explores everything from spotting stories and chasing tip-offs to navigating tricky legal waters: how they build trust with vulnerable sources, verify facts under pressure, and handle listener feedback, all while maintaining strict ethics. The team will also focus on First Conviction, a recent co-production with RTÉ Investigates about a couple wrongfully imprisoned for a crime that never happened, and who were recently declared factually innocent by the Irish courts.

the-pleasure-agenda-grace-alice-s-and-an.name: The Pleasure Agenda: Grace Alice Ó Sé and Annie Queeries
the-pleasure-agenda-grace-alice-s-and-an.bio: Sex, intimacy and everything Ireland spent a century not talking about. Award-winning sex educator and Sex Educated author Grace Alice Ó Sé is joined by Annie Queeries for a frank, funny and entirely shame-free hour. Bring your questions, or just bring your scarlet face. Both are welcome.

an-irishman-abroad-with-jarlath-regan.name: An Irishman Abroad with Jarlath Regan
an-irishman-abroad-with-jarlath-regan.bio: The comedian and pod father Jarlath Regan sits down with Irish athletics legend Ciara Mageean for a wide ranging discussion about love, life, loss and the persistence of craic in the face of adversity.

mike-vittorio-s-guide-to-parenting.name: Mike & Vittorio's Guide to Parenting
mike-vittorio-s-guide-to-parenting.bio: Two London-based Irish comedians tackle the pressing issues facing parents, from the unique vantage point of having no children, no interest in children, and no intention of mentioning children at all. Mike Rice — Kilkenny-born, tens of millions of views online, and the man behind specials An Irish Disgrace and Nasty Character — and Vittorio Angelone, the Northern Irish stand-up whose tours sell out faster than he can announce them, bring their chart-topping weekly podcast to MindField. Unfiltered, unrepentant, and about anything but parenting.

deirdre-o-kane.name: Deirdre O'Kane
deirdre-o-kane.bio: The nation's comedy sweetheart and national treasure, Deirdre O'Kane is known for her sharp observational humour and versatile performances in film, television and theatre. Her humour often explored themes of both Irish culture, family life, and personal anecdotes, earning her a loyal fan base and critical praise.

steve-spade.name: Steve Spade
steve-spade.bio: Dubbed Ireland’s “Houdini”, Steve Spade is one of the country’s most in-demand magicians, illusionists and escape artists. Internationally recognised for blending world class slight of hand, jaw-dropping escapes and sharp comedy into unforgettable live performances.

diona-doherty.name: Diona Doherty
diona-doherty.bio: Diona Doherty, a regular panellist on the BBC's Blame Game. This comedian, actor, podcaster, has just landed a lead role in a 10-part CBC Canada and BBC comedy co-production, alongside Schitt's Creek actor Dustin Milligan. Sharp, sexy and sassy, she is a must-see for those who enjoy comedy with a heart.

darren-gaffney.name: Darren Gaffney
darren-gaffney.bio: With a storytelling style that is as sharp as it is chaotic, Cavan man Darren is proving that the quietest parts of the country produce the loudest laughs, as seen on RTE, Virgin Media, and LadBible.

louisa-n-ide-in.name: Louisa Ní Éideáin
louisa-n-ide-in.bio: Award-winning comedian and writer, who has had two sellout shows at Dublin Fringe Festival. Described as a new comedy arrival who could move from cult to household name in a flash. Catch her before she gets lost to stardom.

martin-angolo.name: Martin Angolo
martin-angolo.bio: Known for his sharp wit and dry humour, Martin has gained recognition for his performances across Ireland, the UK, Europe and the USA. His performances are characterised by intelligent one-liners coupled with tension and energy that mark him as a standout comedian on the Irish scene.

taran-o-sullivan.name: Taran O'Sullivan
taran-o-sullivan.bio: Taran O'Sullivan is an Irish media personality and comedian known for her work on RTÉ 2FM, where she appears on the popular Laura Fox Show. Her dry, sardonic wit and storytelling cover a wide range of topics with humour and insight.

ian-burke.name: Ian Burke
ian-burke.bio: Known for his dark wit, fearless punchlines, and ability to say the wrong thing in exactly the right way, Ian's comedy lives in that sweet spot where audiences are unsure whether to laugh, gasp, or quietly reassess their morals.

fred-cooke.name: Fred Cooke
fred-cooke.bio: Fred has been delivering a unique brand of comedy through his musical prowess and wild, crafted physical storytelling since 2011. Currently appearing as the affable MC on the Tommy Tiernan Show, Fred brings a special brand of comedic chaos to every show.

ailish-mccarthy.name: Ailish McCarthy
ailish-mccarthy.bio: Ailish has spent the last number of years earning her stripes on Ireland's stand-up scene and gaining online acclaim through her viral comedy sketches on TikTok.

eric-lawlor.name: Eric Lawlor
eric-lawlor.bio: His warm, energetic onstage presence makes for an unforgettable experience for the audience. With gags that always hit the spot, his engaging, high-intensity performances make him one of the top names of must-see comedians.

mc-damian-clark.name: MC Damian Clark
mc-damian-clark.bio: Hilariously surreal, he is scorchingly funny and charmingly engaging. This adopted Aussie comic is one of the hottest tickets in comedy clubs and festivals, both here and in the UK.

mario-rosenstock.name: Mario Rosenstock
mario-rosenstock.bio: Mario Rosenstock is a multi-award-winning comedian and one of Ireland's leading satirists and mimics, the creator and voice behind "Gift Grub" on the Ian Dempsey Breakfast Show on Today FM since 1999. He has broken all box office records in Ireland, including five sold-out nights at the Bord Gáis Theatre, eleven straight nights in Dublin's Olympia Theatre, and in 2025 became the first Irish comedian to sell out the 3Arena.

vittorio-angelone.name: Vittorio Angelone
vittorio-angelone.bio: This Italian Irish comedian, who grew up in Belfast, has risen through the ranks of comedy world at an incredible speed, building up a following with stand-up clips, podcasts and sketches, amassing millions of views online. He is co-host of the hit podcast "Mike and Victoria's Guide to Parenting” and can be seen a lot on the internet unless your, unless your algorithm hasn't blessed you thusly.

emer-maguire.name: Emer Maguire
emer-maguire.bio: Emer Maguire is a Northern Irish comedian known for her sharp storytelling, musical comedy genius, and gloriously chaotic honesty. Recently named by Channel 4 as one of the top 10 new comedy talents, she has been commissioned by the station as the creator and star of the upcoming sitcom "Socially Awkward" about her life as an autistic adult.

enya-martin.name: Enya Martin
enya-martin.bio: The creator of the "Giz a laugh" online sketch series, this lovable Clondalkin native reflects on growing up in the 90's in a council estate to eventually flying first class to Australia. She explains the funny side of modern fitness culture and the many hurdles she has come up against that have shaped her into one of Ireland's top comedians.

bernard-casey.name: Bernard Casey
bernard-casey.bio: Bernard Casey is a comedian, actor and drama teacher from Portmagee village in County Kerry. He has sold-out shows at the INEC, Vicar Street and the Everyman Theatre in Cork. His online comedy videos have over 15 million views and have garnered him over 130,000 social media followers. "The future may be a mystery, but for Bernard Casey, it's sure to be a bright one" - The Irish Independent

kevin-mcgahern.name: Kevin McGahern
kevin-mcgahern.bio: Kevin has been a staple of Irish comedy for years, hosting RTÉ's "Republic of Telly" for ten seasons, hosting "Traitors Ireland", "Uncloaked", playing the character Sim Card in "The Hardy Bucks", as well as hosting the glittery IFTA Awards. He co-hosts the "Lovely Show" podcast with fellow bogger Justine Stafford.

paddy-mcdonnell.name: Paddy McDonnell
paddy-mcdonnell.bio: Belfast comedian Paddy McDonnell has built a strong reputation across the UK and Ireland, turning everyday observations into hilarious anecdotes. He talks about getting older, dealing with gout, and the perils of still trying to be a young man and raising kids.

willie-white.name: Willie White
willie-white.bio: Willie White has exploded in popularity over the last eighteen months, quickly marking himself out as one of the biggest names in the Irish comedy circuit, and selling over 8,000 tickets to date. He has also taken to podcasting seeing his show "You Must Be Jokin", which he co-hosts with Dublin comedian Eric Lawlor, fly to the top of the Irish podcast charts.

thomas-greene.name: Thomas Greene
thomas-greene.bio: Thomas Greene is an Australian comedian renowned for his high-energy comedy. His crowd work is revered, his likability off the chart, and he has the innate ability to get any audience on side with his charismatic Aussie best mate persona. Raw, unfiltered, and hysterical, he is a definite must-see over the weekend.

bernard-o-shea.name: Bernard O'Shea
bernard-o-shea.bio: A stand-up comedian, broadcaster, and best-selling author, a familiar voice on Irish radio, he co-hosted "Breakfast Republic" on RTÉ 2fm. While on television, Bernard co-wrote and starred in RTÉ's hit series "Bridget and Eamon". He also writes a popular weekly column for the Irish Examiner. His comedy often explores themes of life, relationships, and societal issues, resonating with audiences across Ireland and beyond.

sadhbh-mcloughlin.name: Sadhbh McLoughlin
sadhbh-mcloughlin.bio: Sadhbh McLoughlin is a Dublin-based actor, writer and comedy content creator who blends sharp observational comedy with personal stories. With an Irish passport and a Brussels upbringing, Sadhbh can finally pronounce her name... sort of…

breda-heggarty.name: Breda Heggarty
breda-heggarty.bio: Breda Hegarty is an emerging star of Irish comedy and has been picking up lots of awards along the way. Having grown up in rural West Cork, she remains slightly feral, but in her stand-up, Breda shows her hysterical failings as a human, which will in no doubt leave you feeling a bit better about your own life.

anna-clifford.name: Anna Clifford
anna-clifford.bio: Anna Clifford is a natural entertainer with a strong stage presence and jokes to match. She has had audiences across the globe laughing with her unbelievable stories and clever observations on millennial life. She effortlessly blends humour, fashion, food, and life stories with a playful, relatable touch.

david-mcsavage.name: David McSavage
david-mcsavage.bio: David McSavage is an Irish comedian, satirist and creator of the cult RTÉ series, "The Savage Eye". He's been making people laugh and occasionally calling their solicitors for over two decades. When he's not on stage, he's recording podcasts, or upsetting someone on X (formally Twitter).

patrick-mcdonnell.name: Patrick McDonnell
patrick-mcdonnell.bio: Patrick McDonnell, probably best known both in Ireland and abroad as the gormless Eoin McLove in "Father Ted". But don't let that fool you, with a master's degree in Irish history and a sharp and acerbic view on rural and urban life, Patrick is a surefire hit.

dame-stuffy.name: Dame Stuffy
dame-stuffy.bio: Dame Stuffy isn't just a performer, she's a full-blown glitter cyclone with lashes longer than your rent receipt and a voice that could shatter both glass and egos. Equal parts outrageous and unhinged, this self-declared queen of Ballymun will leave you gasping for air.

richie-bree.name: Richie Bree
richie-bree.bio: Currently supporting Jim Owen on his UK tour, this North Down comedian is the real deal. With beautifully timed jokes and hilariously sharp delivery, be sure to get down early to get to the comedy arena to catch him live.

mc-karl-spain.name: MC Karl Spain
mc-karl-spain.bio: Karl Spain has long been established as one of Ireland's most popular comedians, for his own tours and touring with others. Widely regarded as the best MC in Ireland, be prepared for some killer audience work and witty badinage.

shane-todd.name: Shane Todd
shane-todd.bio: Like many comedians, Shane is an overnight success, 15 years in the making. Hailing from Hollywood, Belfast, he is known for his top-notch observational and anecdotal humour. He has rose from YouTube sketches to sellout world tours, holding a 24-night solo record at Belfast Grand Opera House. He hosts the hit podcast "Tea with me". This modern-day king of comedy is well on his way to world domination.

reggie-watts.name: Reggie Watts
reggie-watts.bio: Reggie Watts is an internationally renowned musician, comedian, writer, actor, who most recently starred as the band leader on CBS's "The Late Show" with James Corden. Using his formidable voice, looping pedals, and vast imagination, Watts bends and blurs the lines between music and comedy, wowing audiences.

mike-rice.name: Mike Rice
mike-rice.bio: A phenomenal wordsmith and world-class raconteur, there is a cruelty to Kilkenny's Mike Rice. Currently living in London, he has brought four separate solo shows to the Edinburgh Fringe and is co-creator of the hugely successful podcast called "Mike and Vittorio's Guide to Parenting", which is regularly ranked on the Irish and UK podcast charts.

rachel-galvo.name: Rachel Galvo
rachel-galvo.bio: Rachel Galvo returns to EP after her debut performance last year. Blending raunchy humour with sharp social commentary, she explores her Catholic upbringing, awkward sexual encounters, and the life choices that have shaped her journey. It's a celebration of radical self-love and the joy of embracing imperfections.

david-nihill.name: David Nihill
david-nihill.bio: David Nihill, living in Dublin, where he was born and raised until the age of 22. David Nihill got drunk on travel and never quite got the sobriety of it. He has lived and worked in twelve countries and visited over eighty. A festival favourite, David's videos have gone viral many times over, with over one billion views and social media following of over 2 million people.

michael-fry.name: Michael Fry
michael-fry.bio: A talented comedian, actor and content creator, Michael Fry has gained recognition for his sharp satirical stories and musical parodies of viral videos on Twitter and Instagram. His impressive credits include roles in "Derry Girls", "Holding", and "No Worries If Not".

aoife-dunne.name: Aoife Dunne
aoife-dunne.bio: Aoife Dunne is one of the fastest rising new faces of Irish comedy and is also a poet and storyteller with a growing online audience of 160,000 across Instagram and TikTok. Her work blends humour and heart, often exploring themes of grief and resilience with honesty and wit.

john-colleary.name: John Colleary
john-colleary.bio: Apart from being one of the most in-demand comics on the land, John has written and starred in IFTA award-winning shows "The Savage Eye" and "Irish Pictorial Weekly" for RTÉ. Autumn 2026 promises more success for him when he tours his brand-new solo show, "Mighty Quack", nationwide.

owen-colgan.name: Owen Colgan
owen-colgan.bio: Owen Colgan is a full-time professional comedian who embarked on his remarkable journey in 2005 as the lovable character Buzz McDonald in the cult TV show "Hardy Bucks". With a passion for laughter and a love of nature, Owen brings you on a wild and crazy comedic ride.

simon-hennessey.name: Simon Hennessey
simon-hennessey.bio: Simon Hennessey is a comedian, writer, actor and content creator from Dublin. His viral characters, parody songs and sketches have seen him build a following of over 430,000 on social media. He plays the lead role in the Screen Ireland film "The Kevin Intervention", which had its premiere at this year's Galway Film Fleadh.

katie-boyle.name: Katie Boyle
katie-boyle.bio: Katie Boyle is an Irish comedian living in New York City. Her favourite stand-up topics are her journey through American culture, dating therapy, and shame. She currently hosts "The Shift" podcast in which she and guests discuss sex and dating from an Irish perspective.

alison-spittle.name: Alison Spittle
alison-spittle.bio: Alison Spittle is an award-winning screenwriter, actress and touring comedian. Her latest show, "Big", won the Comedian's Choice Award for the best show at the 2025 Edinburgh Fringe Festival. Her nuanced, cheeky and joyful style, coupled with her quick wit and delivery, mark her out as a kind of genius.

sin-ad-quinlan.name: Sinéad Quinlan
sin-ad-quinlan.bio: Comedian and radio presenter on Cork's Red FM, Sinéad deals with the hard topics with sharp storytelling, big heart, and a mischievous twinkle in her eye. Her most recent show, "The Cultured Culchie", was a hilarious reckoning with heart, heartbreak, identity and a long, bumpy road to finding yourself.

ger-staunton.name: Ger Staunton
ger-staunton.bio: Originally from Mayo, Staunton draws on stories, insights, anecdotes and characters from this unique part of the world and opens them to a global audience. He has honed a style of material which endears him to all races, backgrounds, ages and demographics.

keith-fox.name: Keith Fox
keith-fox.bio: A charming and energetic performer, Keith is regarded as one of Ireland's comedy gems. As featured on Virgin Media TV and FM104, his stand-up blends clever observation with mischievous storytelling.

paul-marsh.name: Paul Marsh
paul-marsh.bio: Paul Marsh has been one of the busiest comedians on the Irish comedy scene for over twelve years. Known for his fast-paced, gag-filled sets, he has won multiple awards, including Ireland's funniest joke.

michael-roche.name: Michael Roche
michael-roche.bio: Michael Roche is a Cork-based comedian from Kerry who began stand-up in 2019. His cheeky, playful delivery makes him instantly likable once he hits the stage. He has won several comedy competitions, including Show Me the Funny in 2026.

music-generation-laois.name: Music Generation Laois
music-generation-laois.bio: Banna ceol traidisiúnta ó Music Generation Laois le páistí agus daoine óga ó Chontae Laoise.

ceathair-id-shr-id-marlborough.name: Ceathairéid Shráid Marlborough
ceathair-id-shr-id-marlborough.bio: Ceol na nglórtha i stíleanna éagsúla. Bígí linn is sinn ag canadh cheol bearbóra, amhráin na hÉireann, snagcheol, agus cúpla iontaisín eile le linn an gcoirm ceol.

saibh-n.name: Saibhín
saibh-n.bio: Is ceoltóir Éireannach / Meicsiceach í Saibhin, lonnaithe i mBáile Átha Cliath. Cuireann sí draíocht ar a cuid lucht féachana lena cuid séiseanna agus liricí.

beannaithe-idir-mhn.name: Beannaithe idir Mhná
beannaithe-idir-mhn.bio: Cairdeas, ceol agus cumhacht na mban! Beidh ceol, amhránaíochta agus damhsa ag 'Beannaithe idir Mhná' ar an árdán.

na-tonnta.name: Na Tonnta
na-tonnta.bio: Racbhanna cúigear leaids a d'fhreastal ar Choláiste Eoin, Baile Átha Cliath, atá sa ghrúpa ceoil Tonnta. Tá an-tionchar théis a bheith ag Oasis, Fontaines DC, agus The Beatles ar an mbanna seo, a mbaineann meascán d'amhráin cháiliúla agus amhráin fhéinchumtha lena gceol féin. Bíonn na baill seo ag seinm ceoil le fuinneamh agus óna gcroí amach - Ní chuirfear bac orthu lá ar bith feasta! Buailigí isteach chucu anseo ag Puball na G!

whitewater.name: Whitewater
whitewater.bio: Is banna rac-cheoil agus blues iad WHITEWATER as Gaoth Dobhair, Co. Dhún na nGall. Faigheann siad inspioráid ó mhórainmneacha an rac-cheoil chlasaicigh agus an blues, agus cuireann siad seó fuinniúil ar stáitse le hamhráin ó ealaíontóirí ar nós Rory Gallagher, Thin Lizzy, Cream, Jimi Hendrix agus go leor eile.

hannah-mcfadden.name: Hannah McFadden
hannah-mcfadden.bio: Is amhránaí agus scríbhneoir amhrán í Hannah Mc Fadden as Dún na nGall. Téann sí díreach go croí na fírinne lena cuid ceoil, ag tarraingt as amhráin amh, chumhachtacha faoin ghrá a cailleadh, faoin uaigneas, agus faoin dóigh a dtiteann rudaí as a chéile. Tá dynamic láidir, stoirmiúil ina glór ar leith a chorraíonn an t-éisteoir ar an chéad éisteacht, rud a fhágann nach bhfuil anseo ach ceol macánta, gan scáth gan cheilt, agus tallann nádúrtha nach bhfuil ag iarraidh leithscéal ar bith a ghabháil.

sult.name: Sult
sult.bio: Is grúpa ceoltóirí traidisiúnta ó Thuaisceart Bhaile Átha Cliath iad Sult. Bí ag súil le ceol bríomhar, amhránaíocht agus damhsa traidisiúnta ó Emer, Caoilfhionn agus Sorcha Ní Scolaí.

clann-mhic-ruair.name: Clann Mhic Ruairí
clann-mhic-ruair.bio: Is banna ceoil dúchais agus traidisiúnta Éireannach iad Clann Mhic Ruairí. Grúpa teaghlaigh atá iontu, agus iad comhdhéanta de na siblíní Tony (amhránaí), Aodh (amhránaí, giotár), Seán (amhránaí) agus Dónall (amhránaí, cnaguirlisí), mar aon le hiníon Tony, Megan (pianó agus amhránaí). Mar theaghlach, tógadh iad ar amhráin agus ar scéalta i nGaeilge Ghaeltacht Rann na Feirste i gContae Dhún na nGall, ceantar Gaeltachta atá suite in iarthuaisceart na hÉireann. Nuair a chloiseann tú a gceol, faigheann tú léargas ar an gcultúr saibhir seo, cultúr a leanann siad orthu á chaomhnú.

imbolc.name: Imbolc
imbolc.bio: Cuirfear tús inspioráideach leis an lá le cainteanna spreagúla ó dhaoine ar ceannródaithe iad ina n-earnálacha féin. Bígí linn agus muid ag labhairt le:

sc-al.name: Scéal
sc-al.bio: Nuachtán úrnua a fhreastalaíonn ar phobal ilchineálach na Gaeilge. Beidh scríbhneoirí agus aíonna Scéal i mbun díospóireachta ag an bPicnic Leictreach i mbliana. Bígí linn agus ná dearmad, tarraingíonn scéal scéal eile!

d-chas.name: Dúchas
d-chas.bio: Podchraoladh faoinár mbéaloideas, ár miotaiseolaíocht, ár bpisreoga agus ár ndúchas. Buail isteach ag teach an dúchais d'oíche scéalaíochta cois teallaigh i dteannta Chían Mhic Choisteala ⁊ Chúáin de Búrca. Sa tsraith éadrom spraíúil seo, foghlaimeoimid faoi na creidimh agus na scéalta atá i gcroílár ár bhféiniúlachta mar Ghaeil. Fill ar do dhúchas!

reic.name: Reic
reic.bio: Cloistear filíocht ó bhéal, rap, ceol agus scéalaíocht ag an oíche filíochta ilteangach REIC. Bunaíodh REIC in 2015 le hardán a thabhairt do thraidisiún ársa na filíochta béil mar atá sí sa lá atá inniu ann agus le baile a chruthú do thaispeántais de gach cineál i nGaeilge.

gaelgair.name: Gaelgairí
gaelgair.bio: Seó grinn as Gaeilge. Cuireann siad oíche ghrinn ar siúl go rialta i mBaile Átha Cliath agus ar fud na hÉireann freisin. Cuirfidh an dream seo ag gáire gan stad sibh ón bpointe boise. Bíonn an-chraic, spleodar, spraoi is diabhlaíocht ar siúl ag na rógairí seo ar an stáiste i gcónaí, agus beidh go deimhin arís anseo ag an bPicnic Leictreach 2026 - Bígí linn!

ceol-domhanda-le-eve-ie-caitriona-ni-mhu.name: Ceol Domhanda le Eve ie. Caitriona Ni Mhurchu
ceol-domhanda-le-eve-ie-caitriona-ni-mhu.bio: Meascáin trad agus funky folk.... I nGaelinn, Spáinnis agus Francis. Cloisfidh tú tionchar Meiriceá Laidineach, Aifric Theas agus Chroca Dhuibhne!

seosamh-mac.name: Seosamh Mac
seosamh-mac.bio: Is cumadóir, Gaeilgeoir agus ceoltóir traidisiúnta as Béal Feirste, Éire, é Seosamh Mac. Meascann Seosamh ceol traidisiúnta le blasanna ó sheánraí eile le hinsint scéalta faoinár ndaonnacht chomhroinnte, agus le cruthú ceoil chun an corp a bhogadh agus an t-anam a mhúscailt.

eoghan-ceannabh-in-niamh-keady-tabbal.name: Eoghan Ó Ceannabháin & Niamh Keady-Tabbal
eoghan-ceannabh-in-niamh-keady-tabbal.bio: Amhráin Ghaeilge agus Arabacha ó amhránaí ar an sean-nós, Eoghan Ó Ceannabháin, agus amhránaí Éireannach-Liobánach, Niamh Keady-Tabbal. Tagann an bheirt le chéile ag casadh amhráin a bhaineann le himirce, le streachailt, le grá agus le dóchas.

jessie-the-veil.name: Jessie & The Veil
jessie-the-veil.bio: Is banna folk-rock é Jessie & the Veil atá lonnaithe i mBaile Átha Cliath. Spreagtha ag ceoltóirí cosúil le Clannad, Florence and the Machine agus The Cranberries. Meascann a chuid ceoil gnéithe do cheol traidisiúnta na hÉireann le fuaim mhothúchánach agus neamhshaolta.

seisi-n-r-nda-c-n-de-b-rca-x-hhh.name: Seisiún Rúnda: Cúán de Búrca x hHH

cian-curn-in-seit-dj.name: Cian Ó Curnáin - Seit DJ
cian-curn-in-seit-dj.bio: Seit DJ le Cian Ó Curnáin a chuirfidh clabhsúr ar oíche Shathairn in An Puball Gaeilge — ceol agus craic go luath ar maidin.

coinne-il-orainn-cumann-dr-ma-ochta-olls.name: ‘Coinneáil Orainn’ Cumann Drámaíochta Ollscoil na Gaillimhe
coinne-il-orainn-cumann-dr-ma-ochta-olls.bio: Nuair a théann Cigire deireanach na roinne sa tóir ar an mbeirt chainteoir dúchasacha deireanacha sa tír, ardaítear ceisteanna a théann buille beag róghar don chnámh.

byobeanglaim.name: BYOBeanglaim
byobeanglaim.bio: Craic leis na cailíní - scéalta agus scannal leis na mná thar chúpla deochín

funny-focail.name: Funny Focail
funny-focail.bio: Oíche ghrinn dhátheangach Funny Focail a bhunaigh fuirseoirí Diane O'Connor agus Louise O'Toole anuraidh. Is spás speisialta é chun taitneamh a bhaint as an teanga cibé caighdeán atá agat.

seisi-n-na-mban.name: Seisiún na mBan
seisi-n-na-mban.bio: Ceiliúradh ar chruthaitheacht Mhná na hÉireann le ceol agus filíocht. Bígí linn don seit spreagúil suimiúil seo!

buail-feirste.name: Buail Feirste
buail-feirste.bio: Is grúpa drumadóireacht é Buail Feirste; grúpa "batería" atá ann, bunaithe ar thraidisiún ceoil an charnabhail, nó "Samba" ón mBrasaíl. Úsáideann siad meascán uirlisí traidisiúnta ón mBrasaíl le píosaí traidisiúnta a sheinm agus ceol nua a chruthú – ag baint inspioráid ó mhiotaseolaíocht na hÉireann agus ón saol comhaimseartha.

dall.name: Dall
dall.bio: Grúpa ceoltóirí óga fuinniúla as Béal Feirste atá sa bhanna ceoil traidisiúnta Dall. D'fhoghlaim na baill conas ceol a sheinnt i Scoil Cheoil Traidisiúnta Glengormley agus chuir siad snas ar chúrsaí faoi threoir na gceoltóirí is fearr i gcathair Bhéal Feirste i Tigh Mhadáin, nó baile an cheoil thraidisiúnta mar fheictear do mhuintir na háite é. Grúpa spleodrach bríomhar craiceáilte is ea é.

tart.name: Tart
tart.bio: Soláthraíonn TART punkcheol corparáideach don aois nualiobrálach.

l-ofa.name: Líofa
l-ofa.bio: Ceol agus amhránaíocht thraidisiúnta ó Ghaoth Dobhair, Dún na nGall

seisi-n-r-nda-the-railway-boys.name: Seisiún Rúnda: The Railway Boys
seisi-n-r-nda-the-railway-boys.bio: Le rithimí beomhara, agus fuinneamh tógálach, tugann The Railway Boys beocht úr don cheol traidisiúnta. Seinneann Piaras Ó Lorcáin, Mickey Fearon, Oisín Ó Murchú, Seán Ó Briain agus Brian Ó Gallachóir meascán d'fhidil, bainseó, giotár agus dord, cruthaíonn siad fuaim bhríomhar atá chomh hoiriúnach do sheisiúin bheaga is atá do stáitsí móra. Tá siad ag bailiú lucht leanúna ar fud na tíre – agus ní gan chúis!

salon-du-chat.name: Salon du Chat
salon-du-chat.bio: The Picnic's beloved morning ritual: speed debating over tea, coffee and biscuits. Pick a topic from the menu, sit down opposite a stranger and talk — properly. Chat, without the chit. Runs every morning of the weekend.

human-library.name: Human Library
human-library.bio: The Human Library is an interactive workshop where our "books" tell a story about their lives and our "readers" have a chance to discuss and ask questions. This offers open dialogue about themes and topics that others may resonate with. You may find similarities in your own story with our books, or break down prejudices you've held by hearing someone else's experience and having a conversation. This falls in line with our slogan, "unjudge someone."

gossip-bures-a-woman-s-place.name: Gossip Bures: A Woman's Place
gossip-bures-a-woman-s-place.bio: An intergenerational discussion with Traveller women on navigating a more feminist society while maintaining traditional Traveller values. Gossip Bures is an entertaining yet educational podcast of Traveller mothers and daughters. For the first time they leave the podcast studio and camp up on stage at MindField. Chaired by settled Journo Bure, Jennifer O'Connell.

history-ireland-hedge-school-a-unique-re.name: History Ireland Hedge School A 'unique relationship'?—Ireland & the US 1918-present - Tommy Graham with Dan Mulhall Michael Kennedy Bernadette Whelan)
history-ireland-hedge-school-a-unique-re.bio: History Ireland Hedge School A 'unique relationship'?—Ireland and the USA 1920-present. While the UK claims to have a 'special relationship' with the USA, we claim a 'unique relationship', exemplified by the now traditional bowl of shamrock presentation in the White House each St Patrick's Day. But the relationship hasn't always been cordial: Dev failed to get recognition for the Irish Republic from the US government in 1920; the biggest threat to our neutrality during the Emergency came not from the Nazis or the British—but from the USA; and today by far the biggest source of far-right misinformation and disinformation is from the USA. To assess this roller-coaster relationship join History Ireland editor, Tommy Graham, in discussion with Dan Mulhall (former Irish Ambassador in Washington), Bernadette Whelan (University of Limerick), and Michael Kennedy and John Gibney (both Royal Irish Academy's Documents on Irish Foreign Policy).

screening-my-friend-kev-winner-of-best-s.name: Screening: My Friend Kev (Winner of Best Short at Galway Film Fleadh) Colin Peppard (director) in conversation with Donie O'Sullivan
screening-my-friend-kev-winner-of-best-s.bio: Winner of Best Short Documentary at the 38th Galway Film Fleadh 2026 — and now Oscar-longlisted — 'My Friend, Kev' is the debut documentary from director Colin Peppard. Set against a winter in West Clare, it follows a filmmaker reconnecting with an old friend he hasn't seen in years. Kev caddies on the edge of a Trump-owned golf course and dreams of escaping to Florida, until his visa is denied. Over a few days their conversations drift between old memories, new beliefs and the fractures of the present, asking how strong shared memories must be to hold a friendship together when everything else is pulling apart. Colin Peppard is a director from Monaghan, based between Belfast and Dublin, whose work spans documentaries, music videos and commercials. Following the screening, he joins Donie O'Sullivan in conversation.

divorcing-the-superpower-the-us-europe-a.name: Divorcing the Superpower: The US, Europe and the Next 250 Years. Leviathan panel hosted by Andrew Maxwell with Donie O'Sullivan, Eric Lonergan, Dan Mulhall(?), Jennifer O'Connell
divorcing-the-superpower-the-us-europe-a.bio: America turns 250 and the transatlantic marriage is on the rocks. Comedian Andrew Maxwell referees as CNN's Donie O'Sullivan, economist Eric Lonergan and The Irish Times's Jennifer O'Connell ask whether Europe should fight for the relationship, file the papers, or quietly change the locks.

amnesty-hour-republic-of-conscience-spea.name: Amnesty Hour: Republic of Conscience: Speaking Out Against the Global Disorder
amnesty-hour-republic-of-conscience-spea.bio: Amnesty's annual MindField hour takes its title from the poem Seamus Heaney wrote for the movement, and asks what speaking out means when the global order is coming apart: who defends the defenders, and what conscience costs in 2026.

leviathan-europe-accession-ambassador-la.name: Leviathan - Europe: Accession. Ambassador Larysa Gerasko of Ukraine, Ambassador Larisa Miculet of Moldova, Barry Andrews MEP and host Shona Murray
leviathan-europe-accession-ambassador-la.bio: Two countries fighting for their futures make their case for Europe. Ambassador Larysa Gerasko of Ukraine and Ambassador Larisa Miculet of Moldova join Barry Andrews MEP and journalist Shona Murray to talk enlargement in wartime: what accession asks of them, and what it asks of the rest of us.

chats-in-the-flats-brian-branningan-anit.name: Chats in the Flats: Brian Branningan, Anita Reilly, Willa White
chats-in-the-flats-brian-branningan-anit.bio: Chats in the Flats is a storytelling project dedicated to preserving voices, stories and rich culture of working class communities. 'Sure, Isn't That Just Life?' brings together Brian Brannigan (singer, A Lazarus Soul), Willa White (comedian) and Anita Riley (TV personality) for a conversation about life's ups and downs. Through humour, honesty and lived experience, they'll share the moments that shaped them, the setbacks they overcame and the resilience that carried them through.

no-filler-presents-who-killed-the-dancef.name: No Filler presents: Who Killed the Dancefloor (Spoiler: It's Not Dead Yet) hosted by Anthony Remedy
