cyriac.bio: French native Cyriac is the host of the excellent The Main Ingredient on DDR. Driven by a bottomless thirst for musical discovery, his sets span genres and regions but with special mention for his forays into music from the Nordeste of Brazil, and the caribbean islands of Martinique & Guadeloupe.

the-se7en-inch-collective.name: the se7en inch collective
the-se7en-inch-collective.bio: the se7en inch collective, for the love of 7" vinyl. The genre bending soundclash jukebox !

mattie-b.name: Mattie B
mattie-b.bio: Spinning vinyl since the 1990s, Mattie B has been delivering raw and soulful grooves from underground clubs to outdoor festival stages for over three decades. Cutting his teeth in the golden era of rave and early house, his sets have blended gritty soul and funk classics with rare disco pressings, house classics, and electrifying breakbeats. Like many seasoned selectors, the focus is always on the record and the crowd crafting moments that feel timeless he has a reputation for dynamic sets that traverse decades of dancefloor history. Each performance is an invitation to get down and groove and feel the soul in the music expect warm rhythms, tribal drums, vintage basslines, and impeccable groove selection

the-woohah-hip-hop-chess.name: The Woohah Hip Hop & Chess
the-woohah-hip-hop-chess.bio: The Woohah Hip Hop & Chess events were started by Chris Thomas in Bristol before he eventually relocated to Cork and linked up with renouned record digger and turntablist JusMe. The concept is simple. Classic hip hop records and Chessboards. No Tournaments or Formalities. Just good music, relaxed atmosphere and Chess including a jumbo board with pieces that are almost 3ft tall! Chris and Jus are bringing a couple friends along. Cuttin Heads Collective residents Rostah and Itchi will be helping out on the decks for the afternoon too!

jonezy.name: Jonezy
jonezy.bio: Jonezy has been hustlin around the Irish bass music scene for about 15 years now. Following several years as a resident at flagship Irish dubstep crew, DubCulture, Jonezy launched his own promotion concept, Riseup!, in 2010 to explore a broader take on modern rave sounds and bring key, cutting edge acts to Cork. High profile acts such as Mala,Objekt,Pangaea,D-bridge,Skeptical and Youngsta all made appearences.In addition to his hard-won mad-skills behind the decks, Jonezy’s vast horde of ridiculous records is as fine an anthology as any in Ireland. Soulful reggae classics, hidden jungle gems, the latest Machester hybrid halftime weapon – Jonezy mashes the dance and puts it back together with ease.In 2014 Jonezy & his dad a trained chippy started building The RiseUp! Soundsystem and it was ready for it's first outing in 2016. The RiseUp! Sound is known for it's heavy rumble, precision top end and is known as one of the best Soundsystems in the country .

swiss.name: Swiss
swiss.bio: Dj, producer and owner of Crossroads Recording Studio in Kilkenny, Ireland. Home to a wall of boutique analog gear and a vinyl cutting lathe. His love for analog sound is very noticeable not only in his music but also in his vinyl only DJ sets. Expect lots of Funk, Soul, Disco, House and everything in between. Swiss has released music on Kingstreet Sounds NYC, Maison Roughe UK and has a release dropping this year on Lumberjack’s In Hell and a debut album with his live band East West Assembly, forthcoming on the iconic Sound Signature run by Theo Parrish.

local-groove-records.name: Local Groove Records
local-groove-records.bio: Local Groove Records is a DJ duo and independent record label founded by two lifelong friends from Waterford, Ireland, brought together by a shared passion for digging records and uncovering forgotten gems. What began as years spent collecting vinyl and DJing together evolved into a distinctive sound rooted in rare boogie, disco, and world groove records.Known for their deep crates and carefully curated selections, Local Groove Records deliver energetic, groove driven sets packed with records rarely found on streaming platforms.

jusme.name: JusMe
jusme.bio: Obsessive record collector, turntablist and party rocker JusMe began DJing in Cork at the end of the 90s. He got his start battling as a Hip Hop DJ before moving on to promoting shows through the Hobo Convention and Cuttin' Heads Collective crews, with a focus on championing forward-thinking Irish artists. Over the years hes warmed up for artists such as DJ Shadow, Havoc (Mobb Deep), The Pharcyde, Nightmares On Wax and Macy Gray to name a few. Owner of one of Corks deepest and most eclectic vinyl collections, JusMe's sets are driven by a lifelong obsession with good music. Drawing influence from Classic House and Disco, Latin Grooves, UK Bass Music, and Detroit Techno, his sets blend turntablism with thoughtful selections, unexpected transitions and an infectious sense of fun.

k-i-l-o.name: K I L O
k-i-l-o.bio: Rockin Records, Rockin Records, Rock The Records, The Guy Rocks Rocords

chartini.name: Chartini
chartini.bio: Chartini is a Waterford based vinyl collector  with a deep love for rare funk, boogie, Afro beat and disco sounds. Expect timeless rhythms and soulful selections chosen with real love behind them.

eile.name: Eile
eile.bio: Rooted in rhythm and guided by feel, Eile sets are inspired by R&B and Latin sounds. Expect earthy grooves, sun-soaked beats, and an open invitation to move.

jacqui.name: Jacqui
jacqui.bio: Whether dropping an Afrobeat gem into a set of Latin boogaloo or seamlessly bridging SWANA grooves with American soul, Jacqui loves nothing more than a dance at the cultural crossroads filled with musical handbrake turns. Jacqui is fresh from playing The Cambium Club at ATN, and is thrilled to be back at the Heart and Anchor Bar again this year.

daria.name: Daria
daria.bio: Daria's vinyl sets blend disco, soul, boogie and global sounds, celebrating connection, energy and the joy of sharing music with others. Always led by the groove...

dandelion.name: Dandelion
dandelion.bio: Since the early 90's Dandelion has been running club nights and spinning 45's in Bars, Nightclubs & at events throughout Dublin City. Her thrilling Dj sets and Iconic look have enthralled and bedazzled night owls in every corner of the capital. She has held residencies in legendary Dublin clubs Ri Ra, POD & The Kitchen and has shared stages with such luminaries as lan Dury, Kevin Rowland and Iggy Pop. Expect a hip shaking barrage of Up-tempo Northern Soul, Dancefloor Jazz, Motown, Disco, Femme &

dj-sin-ad-n-mh-rdha.name: DJ Sinéad Ní Mhórdha
dj-sin-ad-n-mh-rdha.bio:
An award-winning, international DJ, Sinéad Ní Mhórdha has been working her musical and production craft on-air, at residencies, events and festivals for over 20 years. 
She cut her teeth on the decks whilst working at Dublin’s Temple Bar Music Centre (now the Button Factory) where she co-founded the all-girl DJ trio - Chicks on Decks.  From there she took to the radio airwaves and TV, hostng shows for Phantom FM, FM104 and Radio Nova in Ireland and further afield in Australia, for Balcony TV in Sydney, to America’s  longest running, independent free-form radio station, WFMU in New York, then returning to Europe for Radio Monaco.  
Her musical genres are vast and woven to include Indie, Alternative, Funk, Soul, Disco, House, Electronic and ‘90s hip hop, all of which create a musical feast for the ears and body.  You’ll savour the sounds of “Ireland's First Female DJ Superstar” – The Star, at this year’s Electric Picnic 2026.

the-night-mayor-ed-is-on.name: The Night Mayor & ED IS ON
the-night-mayor-ed-is-on.bio:
Two longtime stalwarts of the Irish music, festival and nightlife scene finally come together for one monumentous set — a mere five years in the making.

The Night Mayor of Dublin, aka Ray O’Donoghue, aka DJ Razor, joins forces with Edison Waters, aka EdIsOn, for a back-to-back midnight set at the Jerry Fish Stage.

With a frankly alarming 60 years combined experience in the business, expect the best tunes from over 3 decades of questionable decisions, late nights and impeccable musical taste.

Midnight.  Fish Town. History, of sorts, will be made.

tony-st-ledger.name: TONY ST LEDGER
tony-st-ledger.bio: Widely credited as one of the pioneers who brought credible underground dance music to Irish audiences, Scurry’s influence extends far beyond the dance floor. He remains a respected mentor and cultural figure within Dublin music circles, inspiring newer generations of DJs, producers and artists. His legacy is intertwined with the evolution of Dublin nightlife itself — from the early warehouse and club movement through to today’s modern electronic scene.

7lz.name: 7LZ
7lz.bio: Renowned as the drummer / vocalist and driving force behind Dublin's enigmatic proto prog rockers TWINKRANES. Anthony Wrasse returns to the stage as 7)LZ (Seven Levels of Lift). Swapping the acoustic drum kit for the kick drum of the 909, electronic circuitry and modular polyrhythms. The project marries unconventional song structures, avant garde compositions and dancefloor heavy arrangements, channeling kosmiche, new age, primitive techno and machine driven electronica.

groev.name: GROEV
groev.bio:
‘Groev’ (pronounced Grove) is a Galway-based indie folk six-piece made up of Joe Sweeney, Rory O'Regan, Jack Lennox, Mike Glynn, and brothers Evan and Keagan Forde. Hailing from across the West of Ireland and formed from late-night sessions and pints, they've fully leaned into what they call a 'drinking band with a music problem'.
Drawing on Irish tradition while reaching further afield, they've carved out a sound that sits comfortably in the indie-folk world, threaded through with the craic of the West. Five songs in, each track represents a distinct slice of life in their twenties, shaped by the lived-in honesty of their influences like Amble, Kingfisher, Sam Fender, and Paolo Nutini.
With over 450,000 Spotify streams and Tara Grove landing on the Spotify Viral 50 Ireland, the numbers are growing, but it's live where Groev really comes alive. From Jack's (now legendary) dance moves to Joe and Keagan sinking pints mid-set, there's a warmth to their shows that makes you feel like you've known them for years.
With sold-out headline shows at Róisín Dubh Upstairs and Whelan's Upstairs, and having already played Momentum Festival, Galway Folk Festival, and Doolin Folk Fest, Groev are only getting started.

malaki.name: MALAKI
malaki.bio: Known for his seamless blending of deep house, Detroit techno, disco and acid house, Scurry earned a reputation as a “DJ’s DJ” — revered by peers and club-goers alike for both his technical skill and musical knowledge. Over the decades he has shared stages with many of the world’s leading electronic artists and played seminal clubs and festivals throughout Ireland and Europe. His appearances at legendary Irish nights including Temple of Sound, Transmission, Influx and Sea Sessions cemented his standing as a cornerstone of the Irish electronic scene.

madams-last-discovery.name: MADAMS LAST DISCOVERY
madams-last-discovery.bio:
Madams Last Discovery nicknamed 'Madams' are a tyrannical mix of Sean Ryder’s Happy Mondays, on a three-week Belfast bar crawl, having run into David Byrne, Grian Chatten and the devil along the way. 
Madams spent 2025 appearing at Stendhal festival, Output Belfast Festival, touring the UK/Ireland, featuring on the Scratch my Progress talent development programme as part of the Oh Yeah Music Centre, and supported artists including Inspiral Carpets and The Howlers.
The band released 3 singles throughout the year gaining them traction on BBC Introducing, RTE 2FM's New Music Show by Beta Ba Silva and Dan Hegarty's Alternative show in addition to a feature on the BBC Radio Ulster 'Where Music Matters' playlist.
To kick off 2026 Madams performed at Whelan's Ones To Watch festival and released "Orange Juice". This track was featured on BBC Radio 1 with Jess Iszatt, Radio X, RTÉ 2FM as Beta Da Silva's Track of the Week, Hot Press and more. To follow this up the band released their debut EP on the 11th of March and are performing at Ireland Music Week 2026.

jean-pack-the-slay-babies.name: JEAN PACK & THE SLAY BABIES
jean-pack-the-slay-babies.bio: Camp flair and raw feeling, structured chaos and cinematic charm: Jean Pack introduces herself as a bold, emotionally saturated presence, a cocktail of melancholia and mischief, poured neat. Describing her sound as “a dirty aperitif with the first pint of the night,” she blends lush harmonies, lo-fi edges, sly lyricism, and storytelling that's part cabaret, part confessional. Whether performing solo or with her Slay Babies, Jean Pack has quickly built a strong reputation on the live circuit. Recently named one of the Irish Examiner's Ones to Watch for 2026, she is currently working on her debut album, with new singles set for release throughout the year. Influences span The Shangri-Las, Nancy & Lee, and The Velvet Underground, yet her voice remains unmistakably her own: vulnerable, glamorous, and half-laughing through the ache.

jinx-lennon.name: JINX LENNON
jinx-lennon.bio:
Jinx Lennon sings about what he believes is happening in the real world as seen through the
eyes of his border schizo punk fffolk music emanating from the Irish borderlands .Subjected in
his youth to the split screen of Republic Ireland and Northern Ireland volatile goings on and the
sort of doublethink politics no one would wish on any young head thus Jinx ended up throwing
it all into a blender along with his favorite sci fi books and mindfuckery of living in joyless holy
Eire.Now he sings it all with the aim of not making life any more unbearable for the listener
overwhelmed by modern existence

maykay.name: MAYKAY
maykay.bio:
MayKay is one of Ireland's most distinctive and compelling performers, renowned for her fearless voice, magnetic stage presence and genre-defying songwriting. First rising to prominence as the frontwoman of Fight Like Apes before joining Le Galaxie, she has spent nearly two decades pushing creative boundaries with some of Ireland's best artists including Kormac, Elaine Mai, Jerry Fish and Jack O'Rourke. 
Her critically acclaimed self-titled debut solo album, released in 2025, marked an exciting new chapter, showcasing a more intimate and deeply personal side of her artistry through songs exploring relationships, grief and resilience. This summer, MayKay brings her super group full band show to festival stages including Beyond the Pale and All Together Now, delivering the powerful, emotionally charged live performances that have made her one of Ireland's most captivating artists.

jerry-fish.name: JERRY FISH
jerry-fish.bio:
He’s the Joker in the pack and he’s back, at Electric Picnic 2026! 

An Indie legend and ringmaster of exceptional renown, Jerry Fish has evolved into a showman extraordinaire, capturing the hearts and minds of audiences all over with his now legendary live shows, a unique live theatrical experience that dissolves all boundaries between performer and audience. 

“Our live performances at Electric Picnic are a mix of alternative music, theatre and the spirit of the carnival," says Jerry ”Wherever I go, the circus is never far behind." A true carnival creator, all-around entertainer, and slightly deranged proprietor of Fish Town.
We love the madness and drama of Fish Town: Get yourself down to our crazy anything-can-happen late night shows ~ Which this year will happen after midnight at 1:30am on Friday Night and experience The ultimate Jerry Fish Party!
Jerry Fish blasted onto the Music Scene in the 1990's touring the globe as front-man of alternative rock outfit An Emotional Fish, the band who gave us the indie rock anthem “Celebrate”  ~ These days the name Jerry Fish is synonymous with Festivals, Carnival Sideshow, Circus, Cabaret and Theatre.  

A highly charismatic performer who refuses to countenance audiences having anything but a good time, accentuating the positive and bringing smiles to troubled faces with his swaggering vocal, generous and infectious smile and that fantastic vaudeville moustache. 

Let your inner child run away with the Circus at The Jerry Fish Electric Sideshow.

r-s-a-g-kilo-presents-decks-n-drums.name: R.S.A.G. & Kilo presents Decks N Drums
r-s-a-g-kilo-presents-decks-n-drums.bio:
R.S.A.G. (Jeremy Hickey) and Kilo (John Kealy) have been friends and collaborators for over 30 years. Their partnership began during the recording of R.S.A.G.’s Choice Music Prize-nominated debut album, Organic Sampler, and has since evolved into the explosive Decks & Drums live experience.
From late-night parties and intimate venues to some of Ireland’s biggest festival stages, the duo have built a reputation for high-energy, genre-defying performances that keep crowds moving. Expect pounding rhythms, infectious beats, and a set that refuses to be boxed into one style.
Get ready for an unforgettable performance when R.S.A.G. & Kilo bring their unique festival energy to Fish Town at EP26.

rua-r.name: Rua Rí
rua-r.bio: ‘Growing up in a coastal town, the presence of the sea is ever felt and for Cobh-born singer-songwriter Rua Rí, aka Seán Damery, it is no different. It is rare that the sea does not bleed into the soft and serene folk music he has become known for, his work echoing tradition while forging a path that feels wholly his own.

dear-willow.name: DEAR WILLOW
dear-willow.bio:
Dear Willow formed in December 2024 is a fresh new Irish trad and folk style band with over 14million views on TikTok and 72 thousand followers across their social media platforms within their first year together.
Dear Willow consists of lead singer Katie Phelan, guitarist Dave McCabe, banjo player Eoin Brosnahan, fiddle player Aoife Nolan and drummer lan Bailey.
Dear Willow has a distinct sound which has become extremely popular landing them opportunities like trad fest, electric picnic, the ruby sessions and support slots for the high kings on their
'Rocky road to Dublin' tour.
They have recently sold out Whelans for their first headline show. 
They are releasing new music very soon.
They have catchy original music along with heartfelt relatable originals which cater to people of all generations.
Dear Willows goal is to create traditional style Irish folk music with a twist and bring it to new audiences and people of all ages.

lucy-mc-williams.name: LUCY MC WILLIAMS
lucy-mc-williams.bio:
Dublin-born singer-songwriter Lucy McWilliams blends indie, R&B, acoustic pop, and ‘90s rock to tell honest stories of love, loneliness, and mental health. With over 16 million Spotify streams, her sweet, expressive vocals and emotional openness define her sound.

In 2024, released her debut EP Third Second Chance with Zach Dawes adding a sharper edge to her music.

Having supported Arlo Parks and Two Door Cinema Club, and performed across Ireland, London, and Paris, McWilliams continues to evolve—always grounded in heartfelt songwriting.

leevy.name: LEEVY
leevy.bio:
Grown from the boggy outcrop of the Muskerry Gaeltacht, Leevy are finding beauty and madness in the harshest corners of the Irish psyche.
Through relentless gigging and word of mouth, they have built a reputation for live shows where laughter, introspection, dancing and crying all go hand in hand.
From Gothic revenge tales and sacrificial burnings at wakes, to forlorn songs of loss and the death of the natural world, Leevy’s songs dance around the threshold of this world and the next.
With a sound that can roar with pounding drums, banjos, whistles, and heavy guitars or can just as easily sway with beautiful folk arrangements and harmonies that tie their raucous performance to tradition and culture.

gr.name: Grá
gr.bio: Despite decades at the forefront of club culture, Billy Scurry has retained the authenticity and passion that made him a standout figure from the beginning: a selector driven purely by music, energy and connection with the crowd.

rowetta-happy-mondays.name: ROWETTA (HAPPY MONDAYS)
rowetta-happy-mondays.bio:
Rowetta is the original female singer with t Madchester band, Happy Mondays, singing on all their hits & until last performed with them all over the world.

She is the voice on the renowned 1989 track "Reach Out/ BE", which has been sampled by many, Slam - (Eterna), Black Eyed Peas (Boom Boom Pow), Steve Angello, DJ Zinc, Todd Terry & many more.

She played herself in the Michael Winterbottom film 24 Hour Party People 
Rowetta also sings with Peter Hook (Joy Division / New Order)
Rowetta performed with Hacienda Classical at Glastonbury’s Pyramid Stage
Special guest appearances with Blossoms, Gorillaz & James.
2024 - Rowetta toured with Shed Seven on their Sold Out 30 year anniversary tour. celebrating 2 Number 1 albums in 1 year.
Currently recording & touring with a future legend, Tom A. Smith.

the-donnys.name: THE DONNYS
the-donnys.bio:
The Donnys are an exciting and vibrant rock and roll experience born and bred in Kilkenny.
Described by Hot Press magazine as “raucous rhythm ‘n’ booze” their infections brand of music is both steeped in 70s blues rock while dabbling in more modern punk and noise rock influences.

sideshow-disco.name: SIDESHOW DISCO
sideshow-disco.bio: Sideshow disco welcomes you to the world of swinging grooves and the  bigbeat sound !

trad-rave.name: TRAD RAVE
trad-rave.bio: From his early days Billy developed a deep connection to soul, funk, hip hop and disco before becoming immersed in the exploding house and techno movement. His early residencies at influential clubs such as Sides and later the iconic Temple of Sound established him as one of the country’s premier selectors. Alongside fellow DJ and promoter Johnny Moy, he helped transform Temple of Sound into one of Ireland’s defining clubbing institutions during the 1990s rave era.

billy-scurry.name: BILLY SCURRY
billy-scurry.bio: Billy Scurry is one of the most respected and influential figures in Irish dance music culture. Emerging from Dublin’s underground scene in the late 1980s and early 1990s, Scurry became synonymous with the rise of authentic house and techno music in Ireland, helping shape a generation of club culture through his legendary residencies, eclectic musical taste and uncompromising approach behind the decks.

kelly-anne-byrne.name: Kelly-Anne Byrne
kelly-anne-byrne.bio:
Kelly-Anne Byrne is regarded as one of the finest selectors on Irish airwaves, and, with a
career spanning two decades, one of Ireland’s most revered DJs. It all began in 2000 when
a large vinyl collection and a love of soul and disco prompted her to drop a mixtape into The
Dice Bar. Over twenty years later, she is still headlining many of Ireland’s top festivals,
including Electric Picnic, Longitude, Body & Soul, Sea Sessions, Night & Day and All
Together Now. She has supported Chic, Dave Lee, Dimitri from Paris, Black Pumas, Peter
Hook, Annie Mac and Mark Ronson. In February 2013 she began presenting The Saturday
Weekender on Phantom 105.2 which earned her a nomination for Best Newcomer at the PPI
Radio Awards. She later presented The Evening Show on TXFM for two years and The Beat
Goes On on Today FM for six years (named ‘The Best Show on Irish Radio’ by Jim Carroll in
The Ticket). In 2021 she took The Beat Goes 0n to The Face Radio in Brooklyn, NY, where it
was broadcast worldwide.

olivia-is-a-ghost.name: OLIVIA IS A GHOST
olivia-is-a-ghost.bio: Olivia is a ghost is a post-punk and shoegaze band originally formed in Madrid, Spain, in 2019 by María and Marcos. Blending atmospheric guitars, haunting melodies, and emotionally charged lyrics, the band quickly gained attention with their debut EP People Talking at the Movies, touring across Spain, Portugal, Italy, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Their music explores themes including mental health, feminism, antifascism, climate change, and personal loss, creating a sound that is both introspective and politically conscious. Following the disruption of the COVID-19 pandemic and industry challenges, the band disbanded in 2021 after releasing their debut album Bees Are Dying. In 2024, María relocated to Ireland and reformed Olivia is a ghost, joined by drummer Rory Lahart and guitarist Riccardo Militerno, with co-founder Marcos later returning on bass and vocals. The reunited four-piece is finally taking Bees Are Dying on the road, bringing their immersive blend of shoegaze and post-punk to audiences across Europe.

crayfish.name: CRAYFISH
crayfish.bio: Crayfish is an Indie band based in Dublin. Formed by Barry McNamara in 2025 and featuring the musical talents of Jules Farrell, Tosh Molloy, Marcus Dalton, Claudia Verdecchia and Rory Lahart. Throughout 2025 the band released a new single for every month of the year and received widespread national and international airplay. The beginning of the year saw Crayfish perform at Hi How Are You Day in the Grand Social with Jerry Fish, May Kay, Sexy Tadhg and Child of Prague.Summer 2026 is set for some new releases and more live shows so stay tuned!

calum-agnew.name: CALUM AGNEW
calum-agnew.bio:
Calum Agnew is one of Ireland’s most exciting emerging soul-pop artists and was recently named an Irish Times Ones to Watch for 2026. He released his hotly anticipated debut EP Bad Boy in February 2026 alongside a sold-out headline show at The Grand Social and packed slots at all the major festivals.
Agnew has supported acclaimed artists including Tolu Makay, Shobsy, Róisín Ó, SexyTadhg, Sam Wills, Curtis Harding and Jessica Doolan (London and Dublin). He was also selected as one of the faces of Culture Night 2025, appearing live on Virgin Media’s Six O’Clock Show.
Agnew is carving out a chic, soul-infused space in Ireland’s music scene. With a seductive vocal tone and a gift for weaving irresistibly catchy pop melodies through soulful, jazz-leaning arrangements, his sound draws comparisons to Amy Winehouse, Joy Crookes, Olivia Dean and RAYE, while remaining unmistakably his own.
Agnew brings a mischievous, mod-meets-modern energy that has quickly made him one of the most compelling new voices in Irish music.

regina-the-queens.name: REGINA & THE QUEENS
regina-the-queens.bio:
Led by Regina George and co-host Dylatrix, with special guests Alexis McQueen, Anita Hero, Ellis Dee Grainne Knees, Jaded, Lucina Shining & Sasha Fierce this fabulous collective of drag sisters and siblings delivers a one-of-a-kind show packed with dazzling lip-syncs, dirty dance, and unforgettable moments under the big top tent. 
Regina and the Queens is a celebration of drag, community, and pure entertainment. Expect glamour, laughter, big personalities, and a whole lot of heart as the queens invite everyone to join the party. 
Whether you're singing along, dancing in the crowd, or getting pulled into the action, one thing is guaranteed: you'll leave smiling.

shobsy.name: SHOBSY
shobsy.bio:
After a whirlwind few months including performances in LA and across Europe,
signing an international publishing deal, signing to influential UK Independent
label SO Recordings, Shobsy released his debut EP ‘Own The Night’ last Autumn.
Dance Or Cry’ (the first release from the ‘Own The Night’ EP) reached Number 4 on
the Influential Irish Radio Breakers Chart and achieved significant airplay on
Ireland’s most listened to station RTE Radio 1 and was ‘Track of the Week’ on RTE
2fm as well as being playlisted on stations such as Sydney Radio in Australia, Radio
Excalibur In Greece,  KOWS 92.5 (Santa Rosa, CA) and WXDR-LP 98.9 FM (New
Orleans, LA),

Shobsy recently completed a 14 date UK & European tour with SO Recordings
labelmates and he recently returned from LA where he was the Special Guest
performer at The International Music Industry Person of the Year Award
presentation to Kirk M. Sommer (WME Global Head of Music)

Shobsy’s current single ‘Silver Line Livin’ was ‘Track of the Week ‘on the Louise
Cantillon show on Today FM.

Shobsy recently released ‘OH!’ Which was his most successful streaming release.
He completed a sold out Irish acoustic tour taking in stops in Dublin, Cork
(Coughlan’s) & Listowel (Mike the Pies) He also recently performed at Beyond the
Pale Festival and at the Greenfields Festival in County Laois and has announced an
Irish tour for Autumn / Winer 2026 which includes a headline show at Whelan’s,
Dublin on Sat Nov 14 th .

Hot Press - “It’s not being unduly hyperbolic to say that Shobsy could soon be sitting
at Pop’s top table with the likes of Harry Styles, Lewis Capaldi and Sam Smith”
'If there is a better male singer in the world than Shobsy I have not heard him. He
has more octaves to climb and descend than evolution usually
allows. Champagne and Entertainment sound like George Michael style hits in-
waiting' 
 (Danny McElhinney - Irish Daily Mail on Sunday)

delush.name: DELUSH
delush.bio: Following a triumphant electric picnic debut last year, DELUSH return for what promises to be an electrifying set at the legendary Fish Town stage. Tallaght's finest have been building a hugely dedicated following recently. If you know you know. Miss it at your peril.

dose.name: DOSE
dose.bio:
Dose brings together the formidable talents of Lizzie Fitzpatrick (Bitch Falcon), bassist Lauren Heron (Merpire), synth player Aoife Spratt, and drummer Nicki Meehan. Their sound is a bold fusion of dream pop, post-punk, grunge, shoegaze and synth-pop, drawing inspiration from DIIV, Cocteau Twins, Beach House and Slowdive, while also channeling the surreal atmosphere of David Lynch’s films.


The band’s debut single, “Cuckoo”, arrived in 2024 to widespread acclaim, earning 2FM The Alternative’s Track of the Week. The Goo described it as “a fuzzy pitch shifting cross between shoegaze, coldwave with some post punk thrown in. Sung by The Roches and mixed by Eno,” and predicted big things for the band. Their debut EP, Sycophantic, produced by Joey Edwards (Pizza Pizza, Just Mustard, The Altered Hours), was released in May 2026, with The Goo declaring that “Dose can do no wrong.” Following appearances at Beyond the Pale and a support tour with US indie legends Throwing Muses, Radio X’s John Kennedy called Dose “iconic” and selected them as Track of the Week. With a growing catalogue of self-produced videos - including a striking homage to The Shining - and a live show that balances raw intensity, cinematic atmosphere and theatrical flair, Dose have quickly become one of Ireland’s most compelling new acts, leaving audiences captivated.

the-year-grunge-broke.name: THE YEAR GRUNGE BROKE
the-year-grunge-broke.bio: The YEAR Grunge BROKE are live at The Jerry Fish Electric Sideshow at Fish Town / Electric Picnic 2026, bringing an electrifying celebration of Grunge and '90s Alternative Rock. Calling all fans of Nirvana, Pearl Jam, Soundgarden, Alice In Chains, The Smashing Pumpkins, Stone Temple Pilots, Mudhoney, Tool, Rage Against The Machine, Screaming Trees, and more! This is the show for you. With nearly a million social media followers and sold-out performances throughout Europe, Ireland, and the UK, The YEAR Grunge BROKE is the ultimate grunge and '90s alternative rock experience on tour today.

mills.name: Mills
mills.bio:
Mills is a DJ & Producer from Dublin. Who has made a name for himself as a passionate supporter of Irish-made productions.

Now a regular in venues all around Ireland, he has also secured international gigs in Ibiza, Magaluf, Santa Ponsa, and Liverpool, sharing the stage with renowned artists like Weiss, Ejeca (Trancewax), Shermanology, Biscits, Yasmine Gardezi, Morgan Seatree, Camrin Watsin, Evan McGee, Caz, and Jess Bays.

Mills this year looks to reach wider audiences with his rolling rave synth lead tracks this year at Electric Picnic

king-kong-company-dj-set.name: King Kong Company DJ Set
king-kong-company-dj-set.bio: King Kong Company (DJ Set) brings the festival energy they're famous for straight to the decks. Expect a genre-hopping journey through house, rave, breaks, bass and feel-good anthems, packed with big drops and infectious vibes. Whether you've seen their legendary live show or not, this DJ set is guaranteed to keep the dancefloor moving from the first beat to the last.

together-as-one.name: Together As One
together-as-one.bio:
Together as One is a 6-piece reggae band from Dublin, Ireland. 

We came together in early 2025 — six musicians from different corners of the Dublin scene who have been friends for 25+ years off the back of playing in multiple successful bands together. What started as after-hours sessions turned into a band with a clear purpose: make music that unites people

Our sound is classic roots reggae with a Dublin heartbeat: one-drop rhythms, heavy bass, conscious lyrics, and live energy every time. From Northside Street busks to late nights in Fibbers, we mix lovers rock, dub, and ska, with a touch of Irish soul in the craic agus ceoil.

danzi.name: danzi
danzi.bio:
danzi is an Irish-based alternative R&B artist blending elements of Hip-Hop, Rock, and electronic music to create emotionally driven, introspective songs. Through atmospheric production and honest songwriting, he explores themes of identity, relationships, ambition, and self-reflection, developing a sound that is both personal and genre-fluid.

His single “BLEAK” is his most streamed release to date, while fan favourites such as “iknow” continue to resonate with listeners. Previous releases including “SUNRISE,” “SLUMDOGBOY,” and “danceforme” have helped establish his growing catalogue, while his most recent feature, “NO LGHT / NO LOVE,” appears on Fortune Igiebor’s latest mixtape, “VSTW.”

As a live performer, danzi. has built a reputation for engaging and energetic sets, selling out headline shows at both The Cobblestone and Whelan’s. He has also supported Bawo at The Academy and performed at festivals including Ones To Watch, Summerwatch, and Beyond The Pale.

With a growing audience and a strong live presence, danzi. continues to establish himself as one of Ireland’s emerging alternative artists.

avenue-68.name: Avenue 68
avenue-68.bio: Your granny’s secret sauce, Avenue 68, has quickly become a standout act in Ireland’s music scene. Through silky vocals and intricate guitar lines, this infectiously groovy 5-piece crafts a soundscape full of soul and energy.

sugaboo.name: Sugaboo
sugaboo.bio:
Sugabooo the “WhatsApp rapper” released his debut mix tape Kimmagination in August 2025. The collaboration with Luke Nelson organically reached 21K monthly listeners. His track Goin Ballistic reached the Viral top 10 in Ireland and Lewis Capldi’s Spotify wrapped. The moniker was coined in 2022 when his initial underground material was virally circulated in Dublin via WhatsApp. He is known for his hyper energetic flow and his sharp Dublin wit.

Sugabooo's debut headliner in Whelans was completely sold out. 2026 saw his American debut at SXSW, The Great Escape in the UK, Trinity Ball, Paris and The Workman’s Club with talk of the town Reggie.

Sugabooo's first public release was early in 2025, a Feat on Lil Skags Pilgrimmage to Kimmage. It received track of the week on the Nialler9 blog. They released a mixtape together this spring; SKAGABOO and drew a crowd of 2000 at Forbidden Fruit on the undergrowth stage.

p-h-l-l-o-u-t.name: P H Λ L L O U T
p-h-l-l-o-u-t.bio: P H Λ L L O U T bring hip-hop’s most iconic tracks to life — live and instrumental. No words, all soul. Old-school and modern classics are mixed and blended seamlessly, DJ-style, keeping the groove locked from first note to last. High-fidelity, authentic, and atmospheric — a set that hits different. Catch them live at Electric Picnic.

jeorge-ii.name: Jeorge II
jeorge-ii.bio:
A fixture of Dublin’s underground rap scene while also being one of its most exciting emerging voices, Jeorge II has spent years honing a sound shaped by the city that raised him. His music captures the grit, humour and everyday realities of Dublin life mirroring classic Irish literature in how he uses wit and wordplay to communicate struggle and hardship.

Equally at home over hard beats and more melodic productions, Jeorge II blends personal storytelling with undeniable energy, creating works that resonate far beyond the capital. His ability to tell full stories within the limitations of a verse chorus structure has earned him a loyal following and the respect of Ireland’s hip hop community.

Now, with momentum continuing to build, Jeorge II is stepping onto bigger stages without losing the raw honesty that made his name.

emorah-collective.name: EMORAH Collective
emorah-collective.bio:
EMORAH Collective is a collaborative dance project exploring the space between ritual, tribal fusion, contemporary performance and visual storytelling. Founded by two long-time collaborators and friends, the collective draws on improvisation, theatrical performance and alternative arts culture to create immersive, otherworldly experiences through movement, striking costuming and atmospheric soundscapes.

Inspired by transformation, connection and the stories that shape us, EMORAH Collective invites audiences into a darkly beautiful landscape where movement becomes language and symbolism takes physical form.

Blending choreography and improvisation, the duo creates performances that feel both intimate and expansive, ancient and strangely futuristic. Whether appearing at festivals, live music events, alternative arts spaces or immersive productions, EMORAH explores the places where personal experience meets collective imagination, inviting audiences into worlds that are at once familiar and unknown.

nuclearmaso.name: Nuclearmaso
nuclearmaso.bio: Nuclearmaso is usually found behind the sound desk at gigs but will be gracing the Glow Depot stage. Having started DJing at 6 years old on a set of Denon decks Nuclearmaso is ready to bring the best vibes and the grooviest tunes.

vasuki-red.name: vasuki red
vasuki-red.bio:
vasuki red blends breaks, bass and speaker-rattling kicks to create bassline poetry. Genre-fluid and never sticking to one sound, she crafts a unique and immersive experience that lasts way after the set is over. The low-frequency explorer has carefully curated a journey filled with energy, unpredictable rhythms and passion. Known to shake dance floors everywhere she plays.

vasuki red mixes between genres like UK Bass, Electro, Breakbeat and Techno to fill the space with heavy dubs and trickling hi-hats, designed for movement.
What started in Galway has grown far beyond home. She has lit up stages internationally with her signature sound, building her reputation for an unapologetic flow and relentless energy.

Beyond the bass, vasuki red is passionate about tearing down traditional gatekeeping, prioritizing inclusive and safe spaces for the community behind the sound.

rnl.name: RNL
rnl.bio:
RNL are a DJ Collective of 3, bringing big nights of 90's Old School Dance Classics and Ibiza Anthems 
to the Dublin dance scene . Made up of Robbie Dixon , Niall Regan & Liam Kieran, the lads plan to bring 
big house vocal and dance/trance favourites with them on the night for their Electric Picnic debut. 

Check our their Instagram for more info @rnlclubnights 
and search RNLclubnights on Soundcloud.

ev-wilde.name: Ev Wilde
ev-wilde.bio: Ev Wilde is a producer, remixer and DJ hailing from Dublin, Ireland.

betzy-nina-s-dirty-breakfast.name: BETZY NINA’s Dirty Breakfast
betzy-nina-s-dirty-breakfast.bio:
Floating Live burlesque show with Dirty Circus. Rooted in culture and driven by a deep love for music, Betzy Nina’s style blends the heat of world house music and unexpected sounds as a reflection of her multicultural influences and sharp musical instinct. 

A Caribbean artist based in Dublin bringing sun-soaked vibes to cold nights, delivering sets that are as dynamic as they are unforgettable.

smokey.name: Smokey
smokey.bio:
Smokey is a Swiss army knife in Irish music - a rapper, DJ, producer, and event curator. Hailing from Ballybrack, Dublin, he first made waves as part of the hip-hop collective The Rog Poets before stepping away from performing to organize events with Lord Apex, manage rising talent Curtisy, and collaborate with Hens Teeth. Now he's back - bigger, bolder, and wiser.

Over the past year, Smokey has worked with acclaimed producers like StrangeLove (Negro Impacto) and Isaac Jones, supported UK rapper Lord Apex, and solidified his role in Rory Sweeney's supergroup "Irish Hash Mafia."

Combining precise wordplay with production that challenges expectations, he is rapidly emerging as one of the most versatile voices in Irish contemporary hip-hop, continuing to push the boundaries of Irish rap.

fortune-igiebor.name: Fortune Igiebor
fortune-igiebor.bio: Fresh off a new mixtape and sold out Academy 2 headline, Fortune Igiebor joins the bill along some of the biggest artists in the world at Electric Picnic. Igiebor has spent recent years building momentum. Named Artist of the Year by Black & Irish in 2023, he has delivered sold-out headline shows in Dublin and London, performed at Forbidden Fruit, appeared at Breaking Sounds in Paris, and been selected for RTÉ 2FM Rising 2025. Two number one releases and a self-directed documentary premiere have marked a career built fully on his own terms. His live shows, whether intimate listening rooms or packed-out venues, have become a key part of that rise. Visually, Igiebor treats every release as a full world of its own, with artwork, fashion, music videos and production all tied together.

lil-skag.name: Lil Skag
lil-skag.bio: Lil Skag, from Enniscorthy County Wexford, has quickly carved a niche for himself on the Irish rap scene. Taking influence from contemporary trap and drill, Skag infuses his music with bold irreverence, provocative cultural references, and a sense of storytelling and wit that feels uniquely and authentically Irish (or rather, Wexfordish). Skag first made a name for himself with his debut single Cunning Linguist in April 2023. Since moving to London in September, he’s played all across the city but has still found the time to return home to perform a sold out headline show at Whelans alongside regional shows in Galway, Cork, Limerick and Wexford. On stage, his performances match the personality and confidence you hear in his music. Skag knows his audience; knowing when to keep the energy high, when to crack a joke, when to tell a story, and when to show his genuine appreciation for the people who’ve turned out to see him. Most importantly, he knows how to hit every bar as hard as he hits it on the record.

catacombs.name: Catacombs
catacombs.bio: Catacombs is Ireland's premier Underground Rap event series. Platforming both established and emerging artists within the Irish Underground Rap scene, Catacombs delivers high energy shows to sold out crowds with artists set to become future stars in their own right. Curated by Omen and Kate, Catacombs shows provide a variety of subgenres reflected in the line-ups. Catacombs shows are Hosted and DJ'd by Omen, who has managed Catacombs from its inception, and built it into the internationally recognised series and platform that it is today.

omen.name: Omen
omen.bio: Omen is a producer, DJ and visual artist from Wicklow, Ireland, known for his work with Ireland's premier underground rap event series Catacombs. Omen manages, curates, DJs and hosts Catacombs, while also DJing and producing music in the genres of Witchhouse and Electro-clash. A DJ set from Omen will range from the distorted 808s of underground rap hits to the screaming saw waves of Witchhouse and Electro-clash bangers. With over ten years of DJing experience, Omen cut his own path in Dublin's music landscape and set the standard for grassroots events in his scene.

manwelli.name: MANWELLI
manwelli.bio:
Manwelli is a queer DJ born in Italy, seasoned in London, and now based in Dublin.
 
His multi-influenced sets fuse electro, Italo, disco, synth-pop, HI-NRG, house, and techno-pop into a euphoric, joyful sound, rooted in a love for the dancefloor and the freedom found there.
 
He has brought his energy to Electric Picnic, All Together Now, and Audio Garden festivals, as well as some of Dublin, Cork, and Bray's favourite venues and queer events in Ireland.
He has also made exciting international appearances in London, Berlin, Barcelona, and Bangkok.
 
He is also active in organising events, particularly fundraising parties for the queer community.

the-mo-cultivation.name: The Mo Cultivation
the-mo-cultivation.bio: The Mo Cultivation set is a takeover of multiple DJs, MC and dancers

jenten.name: JenTen
jenten.bio:
Between Berlin and Dublin, JenTen is carving out her space within Europe’s shifting techno landscape. Rooted in her Nigerian heritage, she crafts a sonic identity defined by hypnotic repetition, intricate percussion, and minimalist tension.
Her long, seamless blends and atmospheric restraint create journeys built for late-night rooms. With a style that connects her cultural roots to Berlin’s electronic underground, JenTen brings a distinct voice shaping the scene’s next wave.

jess-maciel.name: Jess Maciel
jess-maciel.bio: Jess Maciel is a Dublin-based DJ and radio presenter with a passion for live sets. Known for her fun, feel-good mixes and love of house and dance music, she brings high energy to every gig.

saibhin.name: Saibhin
saibhin.bio:
The ethereal and magnetic Saibhin, is a Mexican-Irish singer who's creating a stir in the Irish music scene. Saibhin's charisma is described as infectious as she effortlessly flows from one emotionally evoking melody to a symphony full of life, bouncing off of her band - a five piece of Ireland's most talented upcoming musicians and instrumentalists.

Saibhin's genre bending music ranges anywhere from vocally soothing Sean- nós ballads "as Gaeilge" to soul inspired anthems and everything in between, creating a multicultural fusion of music and language.

The intent to create a safe space where people feel compelled to explore their own emotions, definitely translates. It's not uncommon to see a tear shed with Saibhin's personal life highs and lows being conveyed in the music and performance.

salamay.name: Salamay
salamay.bio:
Salamay is a Nigerian born, Cork raised artist challenging genre conventions of today with his unique brand of contemporary Hip Hop. His music is best described as a fusion of rhythm, and poetry shaped by the sounds of Hip Hop, Soul, R&B, Afrobeat, and more.
 
Since his debut in 2021, Salamay has received critical acclaim earning a No. 2 position on District Magazine’s ‘Top Ten Tracks” for “Take it Easy”, while receiving placements on various playlists including Spotify’s immensely popular Fresh Finds Hip Hop. His innate ability to captivate and connect with audiences has also landed him on some of the world’s largest stages from Electric Picnic to Other Voices Cardigan in Wales, and most recently Beyond the Pale.  
 
Set to release his next project in 2026, Salamay is intent on showcasing the rich and varied Hip-Hop talent Ireland has to offer with the world.

outstraight-records.name: Outstraight Records
outstraight-records.bio:
Outstraight Records is both a record label and artist collective from Dublin, Ireland. Predominantly operating in the hip-hop space, the label comprises various MCs (Don Kobz, Beano, Panda Drey, Conkan & Lú Ke) & Producers / DJs (No Venom & 404NOTFOUND) alongside our Label Director (Aaron
Connery), Creative Director (Dylan Jackson) and our Founder (Lewis Kenny).



The group, established in 2015, have built a formidable offering via their live show productions and consistent musical releases. 2025 was one of the most successful years to date, seeing sold out shows at the Sugar Club alongside their most significant album release with “Dual Odyssey” - a 12

track, collaborative album with Verb T (The Four Owls / High Focus Records). From the success of Dual Odyssey, Outstraight undertook a number of UK dates which included Bristol, Bournemouth & culminated with a headline London show at the Camden Assembly in June 2025.

mount-pyrus.name: Mount Pyrus
mount-pyrus.bio:
Once you’ve caught a glimpse, it’s hard not to become captivated by the weird and wonderful world of Mount Pyrus. 


What started as a retro-pop, indie-jazz inspired dream project has morphed beyond just music. Their unique combination of genres, visuals and samples creates a universe that explores psychedelia, nature and space, inviting listeners to travel through it all.


The band’s sound is brought to life by retro synth lines, soft vocals, groovy bass and driving drums. Immersive samples, soundscapes and visuals create an experience for the audience and piece together a unique and playful live show.


For fans of Crumb, Men I trust and Mild High Club

boss-events-friends.name: Boss Events & Friends
boss-events-friends.bio:
Boss Events & Friends is a collaborative showcase/performance with the B.I.M. (Believe In Me) music
collective. The Boss Events team will share the stage with some of the best emerging artists that the
country has to offer. The collective currently consists of 4 artists. Abbey Blu (Singer-Songwriter), Angel
Rose (Rapper-Songwriter), Shiloh Grey (Rapper-Songwriter) and the founder/leader of the collective
Mister K.Y.B (Rapper-Producer).

abbey-blu.name: Abbey Blu
abbey-blu.bio: Abbey Blu is a fresh new voice within singer-songwriter circles. As a newcomer to the scene, she released her debut single “Heal”. Abbey Blu proves she isn’t afraid to be vulnerable. “Heal” marks the beginning of what promises to be an inspiring journey from an artist determined to turn personal truth into universal connection. (FFO: Adele, Jorja Smith, Arianna Grande, Soulé, Amy Winehouse)

angel-rose.name: Angel Rose
angel-rose.bio: Angel Rose is South African born, raised in Ireland, a hidden gem and a true lyricist in the making, a diamond in the rough. As a rapper, she delivers raw, gritty energy, but shows her versatility when she switches into her smooth, melodic side. Inspired by artists like Zulu Mecca, Scarlip, Shaybo, and Little Simz, her influence comes through in her sharp pen, confident delivery, and authentic artistry. She’s a force to be reckoned with, and she’s only getting started. (FFO: Cardi B, Little Sims, Mohdee, BBY MUTHA)

shiloh-grey.name: Shiloh Grey
shiloh-grey.bio: Shiloh Grey is a versatile rapper emerging from the underground with a sound that moves effortlessly across genres. Whether he’s rapping like the rent is due or tapping into a more melodic lane, he brings intensity and range to every track. With several shows and headline sets under his belt, he’s steadily building a name for himself. Influenced by artists like Juice WRLD, XXXTENTACION, Fortune Igiebor, BBY MUTHA, and Yung Lean. Shiloh blends alternative roots with a style that can feel global while staying true to who he is.

mister-k-y-b.name: Mister K.Y.B
mister-k-y-b.bio: Mister KYB (Kay-Why-Bee) is a Zimbabwean-born, Dublin-based rapper and producer steadily making his mark. With over 700,000 streams and 3,000+ Shazams, his music is gaining real traction both locally and internationally. A former Hot Press ‘Big Break’ finalist, he’s gone on to perform across Ireland, at festivals such as Longitude, Indiependence, Electric Picnic and sharing stages with artists like Ne-Yo, Lloyd Banks, Major League DJs, General Levy, Lotto Boyzz, Machine Gun Kelly, and Tory Lanez. His work has also been supported on major radio platforms including RTÉ Pulse, 2FM, BBC 1Xtra, and Spin 1038. Known for his energetic, soulful performances, Mister KYB continues to grow as both an artist and collaborator, quietly building a strong and lasting presence in the scene. (FFO: Kendrick Lamar, Tommy Saint, Jafaris, J. Cole, AJ Tracey, Skepta, Odd Future)

sloucho-dj-set.name: Sloucho [DJ Set]
sloucho-dj-set.bio:
Sloucho  is an anonymous producer, live act, and visual artist from Ireland. Known for immersive live shows, genre-melting electronic music, and world-building, the project connects Ireland’s tradition of myth-making with global electronic music culture.

Sloucho’s work exists within a fictional universe anchored by OUCH™: a corporate entity obsessed with the commodification of culture and the replacement of human creativity. The world of OUCH™ reflects our fragmented, data-driven world and the ongoing blurring of lines between the digital and physical realms.

asylum-residents.name: ASYLUM RESIDENTS
asylum-residents.bio: Asylum is a Dublin-born house music brand founded in 2024. Inspired by the city's underground scene and a long-standing love of vocal house, its sound sits somewhere between timeless records and what's coming next.

newera.name: NewEra
newera.bio: New Era, performed by Ben Williams. Expect huge drops, non-stop energy and a set that turns the whole crowd into one massive moment. Unmissable.

super-average-djs.name: Super Average DJs
super-average-djs.bio: The boys are back in town! Super Average DJs return with 'Courtside' Caravan Mambo at GlowDepot. The DJ trio - Dolfin, Johnny M, and Dilicious - have teamed up once again to share their signature high-octane energy. Combining a love for a great party atmosphere with infectious dance grooves, their mission remains beautifully simple: have fun and make people dance. Following great events in 2022 and 2023, the lads are making their anticipated return to Electric Picnic this year. They have built a dedicated following on the music festival circuit, earning a reputation for creating a fun, welcoming party atmosphere wherever they play. With their blend of funky beats and individual styles, Super Average DJs are ready to bring the music back to Electric Picnic once again. Bring your energy and join the party!

aneta-moran-sax.name: Aneta Moran Sax
aneta-moran-sax.bio:
Aneta Moran is a saxophone player based in Ireland, who mainly performs alongside house music
DJ's. Influenced by jazz improvisation and experienced in performing with different international
DJ's, she brings the spontaneity of live music to electronic music ranging from deep house dark
melodies to soulful laid-back sets, from upbeat dance music to experimental underground.
As solo saxophonist or in collaboration with other instrumentalists and singers, she connects with
the crowd and brings excitement and party vibe to every event.

sx2.name: SX2
sx2.bio:
Formed in 2017, SX2 is the musical project of brothers Scott & Clive Sullivan. Born from a
shared love of all things sonic, their sound draws from an eclectic range of influences,
blending club, psychedelic, rock n' roll, indie, afro and melodic sounds into something entirely
their own.
This unique palette caught the attention of Moscoman in 2021, who signed the duo to Disco
Halal. Since then they've been steadily building their portfolio, with tracks like "Leave Them
All Behind" and "Steady Up" earning support from industry giants like Keinemusik, John
Digweed, Moscoman, Acid Arab, Dave Seaman and Maxi Meraki, while also being featured
on Tomorrowland and Adidas.
That momentum carried them onto the festival circuit, with regular closing slots at Electric
Picnic and All Together Now, alongside a residency at Waterford's Electric Avenue.
For SX2, things are only just getting started. Expect to see the name on your radar and
lineups in the near future.

dj-chartini.name: DJ Chartini
dj-chartini.bio: Hailing from Waterford, Chartini is a vinyl selector whose sound moves effortlessly through rare funk, disco, world music and disco house. Her sets are soulful, high-energy and carefully curated—designed to connect crowds, lift moods and keep dancefloors moving from start to finish.

kiki-d.name: Kiki D
kiki-d.bio:
Ciara Daly, AKA Kiki D, is a 22-year-old DJ from Galway, Ireland, with a passion for House, Hardgroove, and Techno. Since starting her DJ journey two years ago, she has developed a sound built around driving grooves, energetic rhythms, and crowd-focused selections. Known for her fun personality and high-energy sets, Ciara brings a vibrant atmosphere to every dancefloor, creating unforgettable moments and keeping the energy levels high from start to finish.
With a deep love for underground electronic music and a constant drive to evolve her craft, Ciara continues to establish herself as an exciting rising talent within Ireland's growing dance music scene.

mick-g.name: Mick G
mick-g.bio:
Mick Gill is an award-winning Irish club DJ and mashup artist known for packing dance floors with high-energy, multi-genre sets. Based in County Laois, he seamlessly blends current club bangers with nostalgic 90s and 00s dance anthems.
A former winner of "Kildare's Finest DJ," Mick has supported major international acts like Sigala, and irish legends like Al Gibbs and holds residencies across the Midlands in iconic venues like the Foundry in Carlow and the Naas Court Hotel. Expect fast-paced mixing, heavy basslines, and exclusive custom bootlegs designed to keep the festival crowd moving.

mookie.name: Mookie
mookie.bio: Mookie is a young energetic DJ from County Laois, Ireland. Having started her music journey at age 12, she has quickly gained widespread recognition across the Irish festival scene. Known for her high-energy sets, she spins commercial house, dance, and pop, regularly performing at major events like the Greenfields and Blackthorn Festivals, Making her Electric Picnic Debut having just turned 15, She is one to watch for the future.

fergal-d-arcy.name: Fergal D'Arcy
fergal-d-arcy.bio:
Fergal D’Arcy is one of Ireland’s most recognisable broadcasters and live event personalities, with a career spanning some of the country’s biggest radio stations including Today FM, RTÉ 2FM and iRadio. A six-time Hot Press National DJ of the Year, he has built a reputation as an electrifying performer, accomplished DJ and crowd-hyping MC who brings energy, charisma and quick wit to every stage he steps onto.

A veteran of Ireland’s festival circuit, Fergal has performed at some of the country’s most iconic events including Electric Picnic, Oxegen and Indiependence, while also taking to major stages such as Dublin’s 3Arena. Most recently, he entertained a crowd of over 20,000 people at Pints In A Field alongside The 2 Johnnies in St. Anne’s Park, Dublin.

Whether he’s behind the decks, hosting a live event or commanding a festival crowd, Fergal is known for his infectious energy, razor-sharp audience interaction and ability to read any room. From scratching to sampling, house to techno, indie anthems to chart-toppers, his versatility allows him to seamlessly mix across genres and create unforgettable moments on the dancefloor.

As one of Ireland’s most experienced event MCs, Fergal hosts and presents at events nationwide, bringing professionalism, spontaneity and an unmistakable stage presence that keeps audiences engaged from start to finish. Whatever the crowd, whatever the occasion, you’re in safe hands when Fergal D’Arcy takes control.

bren-curtis.name: Bren Curtis
bren-curtis.bio: Bren Curtis is an experienced Irish DJ with over 20 years behind the decks, specialising in house and commercial music. As a resident DJ at The Barracks, Carlow, Bren has built a reputation for delivering high-energy sets that keep dancefloors packed. Throughout his career, he has performed at venues and events including Foundry Carlow, Coppers Portlaoise, Naas Court Hotel, Encore Naas, Factory Waterford, Greenfield Festival, and many more. Combining experience, crowd awareness, and a passion for music, Bren creates unforgettable atmospheres for every audience.

thxtti.name: Thxtti
thxtti.bio: Thxtti is a Dublin based DJ with a Nigerian background whose sound is a fusion of black diaspora rhythms with electronic sounds. Her goal is to introduce you to songs and genres you’ve never heard before.

nancy-wilde.name: Nancy Wilde
nancy-wilde.bio:
Nancy Wilde is the host of radio shows Time Capsule and Polar Disco Radio on Flirt FM. 
Following her Balearic and Balkan Summer tour across Southern and Eastern Europe, she’s solidly finding her own style and sound, identity and creative tapestry, curating sonic journeys that captivate and transport, with selections that always reflect the current mood (and even the mood swings in between).
Nancy has brought her distinctive sound to venues across Europe, such as Koncept in Zagreb, Lemonade in Budva, Kosovo Kolektiv Radio in Prizren, Agimi Underground in Tirana, and Chillin Bar in Skopje. She has also featured in the Éalú Le Grá x Reclaim the Mainframe takeover at Pawn Shop, and standout sets at KUKI and The Magic Room, leading to slots at Éalú Le Grá and Rewild.
Nancy is part of the Mná Mná Collective and Polar Disco.

nia-byrd.name: Nia Byrd
nia-byrd.bio:
Nia_Byrd is an Irish DJ with a love for house music, afro house, and anything that gets people moving. Her sets blend soulful vocals, uplifting melodies, deep percussion, and infectious grooves, creating the perfect soundtrack for a day in the field or a night on the dancefloor.

Drawing inspiration from house sounds across the globe, Nia_Byrd brings together feel-good favourites, fresh discoveries, and afro-inspired rhythms in sets that are packed with warmth and energy. Whether it's a sunny festival session, a packed tent, or a spontaneous dance with strangers who become friends, she knows how to keep the atmosphere buzzing.

Expect house music with soul, afro house with rhythm, and plenty of tracks that'll have you saying, "just one more song."

dj-ozz-g.name: DJ Ozz G
dj-ozz-g.bio:
"Ireland dopest/Illest Urban Dj - Dj Ozz G is a resident Dj & host of Urban Saturday at Electric Nightclub Galway city.

Originally from Angola & living in Ireland since the early age of 16, Ozz G has been known for his uniquely party-rocking style with a smoooth touch of turntablism. 

Dj Ozz G has played for some of the biggest venues around the world, along side some of the biggest names in the music industry, ever since he embraced the entertainment world back in 2010.

dj-bongani.name: DJ Bongani
dj-bongani.bio: A Galway based DJ who’s maintained club residency before the pandemic up to date. Building off the experience of mixing hiphop, Rn’B, and afrobeats regularly in Four Four before lockdown, Bongani has developed a unique style blending different genres at Electric Galway where he’s showcased his talent almost every Friday night for the past two years. Not a stranger to electric picnic either as he’s been a support dj in trench town for the past 3 years where he’s mastered the art of performing live with other DJs and rappers. Expect to hear an international blend of music you can dance to when you attend any of his sets.

serenity-gardens-stage-opens-with-aos-s-.name: SERENITY GARDENS STAGE OPENS with AOS Sí NA TINE
serenity-gardens-stage-opens-with-aos-s-.bio: Aos Sí na Tine opens the Serenity Gardens stage area with a celebration of fire, voice and Fae magic. Rooted in the mystery of Irish fairy folklore, this atmospheric performance brings together fire, movement, live vocals and the deep, continuous drone of the shruti box. As flames rise and voices gather, the space is awakened and the weekend begins. Part invocation, part spectacle, Aos Sí na Tine honours fire as a source of warmth, transformation, creativity and connection. Step closer, enter the circle and witness Serenity Gardens come alive through flame, sound and a little Otherworld magic.

pauline-garcia.name: PAULINE GARCIA
pauline-garcia.bio: A vocalist and multi-instrumentalist originally from southern France and now based in Ireland, Pauline Garcia blends influences from highlife, reggae, Brazilian music, soul and acoustic folk into rhythm-driven live performances. Combining voice, guitar, bass and layered percussion textures, her music moves between intimate acoustic moments and groove-led soundscapes inspired by world music traditions.

emma-lohan.name: EMMA LOHAN
emma-lohan.bio: Emma Lohan is a song writer, performance artist and producer based in the west of Ireland. What began with a single VE-20 Roland vocoder has evolved into a full, hardware-driven live setup that Emma masterfully bends into her unique artform: a fully improvised performance, co-created in real time with her audience. No Emma Lohan set is complete without the unpredictable appearances of Techno God: a mythical, chaotic entity whose earthly mission is to revive car park raves and spread the gospel of Scooter. Moving between absurdity, vulnerability and hilarity; Emma Lohan is a must see in 2026.

fireside-jam-hosted-by-dom.name: FIRESIDE JAM HOSTED BY DOM
fireside-jam-hosted-by-dom.bio: Gather around the fire as the much-loved Fireside Jam returns to Serenity Gardens, hosted this year by travelling musician and songwriter Dom. After 11 years busking across England and Ireland, Dom brings songs honed on the street and aimed at the stars: great chord changes, irresistible choruses, soulful lyrics, easy-flowing grooves and a rock and roll heartbeat. There may also be fabulous jackets, excellent trousers and songs so bright you’ll need sunglasses when they shine into your heart. The Fireside Jam is a warm, informal and unplugged space where musicians, singers, poets and curious festival souls can share a song, join in or simply settle back and listen. Expect songs of the road, songs for the heart, spontaneous collaborations and a little late-night magic. Bring your voice, your instrument or just yourself, and let Dom guide the gathering into a joyful glow around the fire.

put-the-kettle-on.name: PUT THE KETTLE ON
put-the-kettle-on.bio: Catalan pianist Anna Xaubet Piferrer and ukulele player Jordi Sanchez Campanario come together in a blossoming of two musical worlds. Classically trained at ESMUC and Cork School of Music, Anna graduated with First Class Honours and received the Cork Orchestral Society’s Emerging Artist Award. Her curiosity draws her beyond classical music into folk, Irish music and new textures. Jordi explores the ukulele’s expressive possibilities across contemporary genres, performing with The Underscore Orkestra and The Last Petal. His solo project, Keo Kelele, released the EP Keep Moving On in 2024, the year after he received the Golden Ukulele Award at Galway Ukulele Festival. Together, they intertwine the ukulele’s eclectic voice with the piano’s classical sonorities. Their selected pieces come from vastly different traditions but wander beyond their origins through experimentation, creating unexpected pathways, fresh colours and a musical conversation shaped by curiosity, contrast and a shared spirit of discovery.

creative-writing-round-the-fire-with-lul.name: CREATIVE WRITING ROUND THE FIRE WITH LULU SINOTT POETRY BY THE BARROW
creative-writing-round-the-fire-with-lul.bio: Lulu Sinnott is an Irish poet and spoken-word performer whose writing explores place, memory, relationships and the beautifully complicated business of being human. Her poetry has appeared in A New Ulster, Cork Literary Review, Drawn to the Light, The Prose Poem and the PrimeCut/Axis Ballymun Anthology. A warm and engaging presence on stage, Lulu has performed in Ireland and internationally, including appearances in San Francisco, New York and Berlin. She hosts the monthly Poetry by the Barrow open mic in Graiguenamanagh and co-hosts Poetry by the Sea with ArtNetDLR. Returning to Serenity Gardens, Lulu brings poetry that is reflective, intimate and grounded in everyday life—inviting audiences to pause, listen and find something of themselves between the lines.

merlot-bird.name: MERLOT BIRD
merlot-bird.bio: Let Dingle based singer songwriter Merlot Bird serenade your ears with a mix of old timey 5 string clawhammer banjo folk and bluesy guitar. Heavily influenced by her time spent in New Orleans and hitch hiking the world, you can expect melodies about life on the road, day dreamer’s ballads and other tales of celebrated wildness.

ciara-lawless.name: CIARA LAWLESS
ciara-lawless.bio: Described as the “Irish Kate Bush”, Ciara Lawless is a Roscommon singer-songwriter known for poetic storytelling, captivating vocals and uplifting songs shaped by resilience and transformation. Ciara songs explore themes of healing, self-discovery and the power of human connection. Her music has received support from RTÉ Radio 1, 2FM, Newstalk, Hot Press and radio stations across Ireland. Ciara has toured throughout Ireland and Europe, bringing her distinctive voice, heartfelt lyrics and unmistakable flower-crown style to audiences in the UK, France, Germany and Portugal. After 2 albums Ciara has taken a leap into the dance genre blending an upbeat catchy melody with an upbeat message with another upcoming album. Her 2026 singles include No Plan B and Blessing in Disguise which have been played on BBC Introducing with Taylor Johnson & RTE 2FM’s The New Music Show With Beta DeSilva.

james-keegan.name: JAMES KEEGAN
james-keegan.bio: At 22 years old, Cork singer-songwriter James Keegan has spent the last two years on the road, playing shows across America, Europe and Ireland while steadily building a reputation as a compelling live performer. After joining metal legend Geoff Tate on a 15-country European tour, Keegan moved on to tour America, playing six shows a week for new audiences across 43 states. Opening each night armed with only an acoustic guitar and his voice before a nine-piece metal band, Keegan carved out his own space with raw, captivating performances that consistently won over new crowds. Playing iconic venues previously graced by legends including Elvis Presley, David Bowie and Johnny Cash, Keegan continues to build his audience the old-fashioned way: through live performance and consistent touring. Most recently, James opened for Imelda May at Cork’s Live at the Marquee, marking another milestone in the journey of this exciting young artist.

the-lady-fi-experience.name: THE LADY FI EXPERIENCE
the-lady-fi-experience.bio: The Lady Fi Experience is a vibrant new musical venture led by vocalist and improviser Lady Fi. Blending jazz, blues, soul, world & folk, the project draws on Fi’s wide-ranging musical background. Having spent 15 years living and performing in the United States, she returned to Ireland and in the past years has been a member of The Underscore Orkestra, Rasa Nua Trio and the experimental Ás Veces Collective, as well as appearing regularly at the Cork Jazz Festival. Fi also presents Sounds Original, a radio show celebrating original music and the artists behind it. Alongside her performance work, she facilitates singing and voice-based wellbeing experiences, exploring the voice as a powerful tool for expression, connection and healing. For this performance, Fi will be accompanied by Dara O’Brien, Tim O’Leary and Jordi Sanchez Campanario. Expect jazzy arrangements, bluesy grooves, soulful moments and Lady Fi’s distinctive vocal style.

mark-hayes.name: MARK HAYES
mark-hayes.bio: Mark Hayes is a versatile guitarist, bassist and music teacher with an MA in Musical Performance from MTU Cork School of Music. Moving comfortably between folk, pop, blues and musical theatre, Mark brings strong musicianship, sensitivity and adaptability to every performance. He plays acoustic and electric guitar and bass, and has worked with Lady Fi and a range of local artists across Cork’s live music scene. His performance experience includes Cork Youth Orchestra, the Cork Opera House pantomime band, Culture Night appearances and musical theatre productions including All Shook Up, 9 to 5 and Fiddler on the Roof. Alongside performing, Mark shares his experience through his work as a music teacher. Whether accompanying a vocalist or taking centre stage, his playing is thoughtful, expressive and grounded in a genuine love of live music.

brian-leach.name: BRIAN LEACH
brian-leach.bio: Brian Leach performs on the hammered dulcimer, a cosmic instrument through which he explores traditional Irish music and journeys far beyond it. Electronics and extended techniques transform his performances into immersive worlds of melody, rhythm and improvisation. Brian tours with folk singer Lisa O’Neill and has appeared on NPR’s Tiny Desk Concert and The Tommy Tiernan Show. He also performs with MacBóchra, presenting ancient Irish myths and legends in new ways, and hosts a programme on Éist Radio. His studies in Music Technology, Musical Instrument Building and Astrophysics bring depth and resonance to his work. A member of the Irish Composers’ Collective, Brian has created immersive soundscapes for galleries throughout Ireland and released his solo album Dulcimer Dreams in 2025. Described as one of Ireland’s most prominent hammered dulcimer players, he invites audiences into a spellbinding meeting place between ancient tradition, sonic experimentation and the limitless reaches of imagination.

geis.name: GEIS
geis.bio: Lurking in the spacetime between contemporary folk and revered tradition, you will find the music of Irish duo Geis. The band brings together Skerries singer-songwriter Paul Kelly and Mayo-born multi-instrumentalist and multiple All-Ireland Champion Ronan Donnellan, two likely lads whose paths crossed in the vibrant venues of Dublin’s traditional music scene. Kelly’s narrative songs are built on open-tuned fingerstyle and flat-picking guitar, his bardic voice augmented by Donnellan’s virtuosic touch on octave mandolin, lending hypnotic energy, overtones and colour to the mix. Geis exist at the crossroads of folk storytelling and free rhythmic expression, where words and music weave tales of love, lore and landscape with assured, formidable power. In a sound-world where ideas are minted in old Irish coinage, these two performer-alchemists transform the base metals of history, emotion, philosophy and place into narratives of glistening gold: music rooted in tradition, alive with imagination and forged for the present.

shimmer-boy.name: SHIMMER BOY
shimmer-boy.bio: Shimmer Boy, a guitarist first, is the artist project of Aaron O’Sullivan. Built on years of live experience, he has performed extensively across Ireland and abroad, playing everything from intimate venues to festival stages. Shimmer Boy lyrically sheds light on topics often overlooked, offering a personal perspective on matters of the heart, alongside a reflective view that leans toward the brighter side of the story. It’s honest, introspective writing rooted in lived experience Live, Shimmer Boy has supported a number of rising Irish artists including Robert Grace, Dave Lofts, and Oscar Blue, continuing to build a reputation as a compelling live act with a strong connection to audiences. The project has also received radio support, with Hideaway featuring on RTE 2FMs track of the week & continues to grow through consistent touring and releases.

erin-the-lens.name: ERIN & THE LENS
erin-the-lens.bio: Erin & The Lens will take you on a soulful and empowering musical adventure. Drawing influence from indie, contemporary folk, jazz, trip-hop, rock and soul, the project has toured throughout Ireland and travelled to London, Edinburgh and Paris in 2025. Founder and creative force Erin Luna Gallagher draws on the Irish poetic tradition, exploring mental health, inner resilience, human behaviour, love and the mystical through her writing. Known for her versatile, entrancing voice and powerful stage presence, Erin creates both solo and collaborative performances. Her debut single, “Yellow Door”, was named Single of the Week on national radio, while its stop-motion animated music video won Best Music Video at Cork Picture House and received nominations at the Madrid Indie Film Festival 2025 and Prague Film Festival 2026. This year, Erin is joined by musicians Billy Mansfield and Brian Collins for a performance on the Serenity Gardens stage at Electric Picnic.

s-oga-tine.name: SÍOGA TINE
s-oga-tine.bio: Síoga Tine are a female duo from the Royal County of Meath, beneath the ancient gaze of the Hill of Tara. Celebrating the spirit of Ireland through song, chant and poetry, their work is deeply rooted in Celtic tradition and cultural heritage. Ancient melodies, spoken word and soulful harmonies are woven together to honour the stories, landscapes and sacred heart of Éire. Their performances create an evocative space where old traditions meet living voices, inviting audiences to listen, connect and journey into the magic, memory and enduring spirit of Ireland.

shimmy-shake-celebrate-with-kateo.name: SHIMMY, SHAKE & CELEBRATE with KATEO
shimmy-shake-celebrate-with-kateo.bio: Shimmy, Shake and Celebrate is a playful fusion bellydance workshop filled with movement, music and plenty of hip-shaking fun. Led by multimedia artist and dancer Kateo, the session invites participants of all levels to explore fluid technique, musicality and improvisation in a relaxed, welcoming space. A teacher with Suadela Bellydance in Cork, Kateo brings a fresh, contemporary approach shaped by training with renowned artists including Rachel Brice, Heather Stants and Alexis Southall. A recent graduate of the Tribal Fusion Education Program in the UK, she blends dance and visual art to create a distinctive, expressive style. Expect shimmies, flowing movements, creative play and a chance to connect with your body through rhythm and celebration. No previous bellydance experience is needed: bring your curiosity, your enthusiasm, to loosen those hips and get ready to move. Laugh and celebrate yourself through dance.

dj-gaeltronica.name: DJ GAELTRONICA
dj-gaeltronica.bio: GaelTronica le hArd Éan is the Gaelic Trad-inspired electronic dance project of multi-genre DJ Ard Éan. This specially curated set weaves traditional songs and dance tunes with beats, breaks, drops, synths and contemporary electronic production. Expect progressive Trad remixes, songs in Irish and Scots Gaelic, and sounds spanning house, drum and bass, trance, breakbeat, tribal and melodic techno. The set celebrates contemporary artists from Ireland and Scotland, including Jiggy, Huartan, Caoimhín, Cushla, Valtos, Niteworks, Martyn Bennett and Dolphin Boy, alongside music from Spain, America, Iceland and the Faroe Islands. Based in Connemara, Ard Éan is musician and broadcaster Paul Phelan, presenter of Coast to Coast on Connemara FM for 15 years. Born from his first public DJ performance at Éalú le Grá in 2022, GaelTronica launched at Féile Vegan 2026 and has since moved dancefloors at Uisneach, Féile Solas, Battle for the Lake and Cleggan Fringe.

revive-your-vibe-with-vit-ria-souza.name: REVIVE YOUR VIBE WITH VITÓRIA SOUZA
revive-your-vibe-with-vit-ria-souza.bio: Wake up to another festival day with a gentle unfolding led by the Brazilian Yoga teacher Vitória. Based now in Cork Ireland, Vitória  invites you to come experience the love & joy of movement which she makes accessible to all levels. So come Revive your vibe & flow into the rest of your festival with ease.

dara-o-brien-morning-ragas-on-sitar.name: DARA O'BRIEN - MORNING RAGAS ON SITAR
dara-o-brien-morning-ragas-on-sitar.bio: Enjoy the serenity of Indian morning ragas with Dara O’Brien on sitar, enriched by live electronics, psychedelic sound layers and original compositions. Dara weaves the ancient, meditative and evocative music of North India with contemporary sounds, moving through darkness and light. With a PhD in Indian music, Dara works as a music educator, music therapist, performer and composer. He has also composed extensively for contemporary dance to critical acclaim. Described by Patrick Brennan in the Irish Examiner as an “extraordinary musician and composer” and an “amazing Irish instrumentalist”.

the-living-stage-live-improvised-theatre.name: THE LIVING STAGE LIVE IMPROVISED THEATRE EXPERIENCE WITH YVONNE COUGHLAN
