the-living-stage-live-improvised-theatre.bio: Experience the creative heart of Electric Picnic at Serenity Gardens with director and Creative Producer Yvonne Coughlan. With over 20 years’ experience across theatre, improvisation, dance, music, film and community arts, Yvonne creates joyful, inclusive experiences that bring people together through play and connection. Join Yvonne on Saturday for lively 35-minute theatre workshop loops designed for all ages and experience levels. Drop in for a creative reset or stay longer and enjoy multiple sessions. Perfect for solo festivalgoers, friends and families, the workshops combine improvisation, acting, movement, ensemble games, storytelling and spontaneous performance in a welcoming environment. Expect laughter, connection, self-expression and a chance to step away from the crowds and discover the spirit of Serenity Gardens, one of Electric Picnic’s most loved spaces for wellness, creativity and community. Yvonne returns on Sunday as MC of the Serenity Gardens Stage, introducing a line-up of musical artists. Come curious. Leave inspired.

rewilding-with-the-mindset-explorer-dj-c.name: REWILDING WITH THE MINDSET EXPLORER & DJ CHACHØU
rewilding-with-the-mindset-explorer-dj-c.bio: REWILDING, guided by The Mindset Explorer, is an immersive breathwork experience designed to regulate your nervous system and reconnect with your body. Using Silent Disco Headsets, emotionally loaded electronic music by DJ CHACHØU, and evidence-informed nervous system practices, you’ll be guided through a deeply immersive experience. We spend much of our lives avoiding discomfort and anything that feels unpleasant. While this is a natural protective response, it can also keep us stuck in patterns of fear, anxiety and persistent unexplained symptoms. The paradox is that lasting change begins when we change how we respond to discomfort rather than trying to escape it. PRIMAL Breathwork is one of the most natural and powerful ways to release tension and decompress the nervous system. Combined with The Mindset Explorer’s trauma-informed practices, you’ll be gently guided towards greater resilience, emotional freedom and a deeper sense of calm.

miranda-faul.name: MIRANDA FAUL
miranda-faul.bio: Irish singer-songwriter Miranda Faul is quickly establishing herself as a compelling new voice in indie folk and alt-pop. Named a One to Watch for 2026 by Whelan’s in Dublin, her emotionally rich songwriting blends folk roots with soulful melodies and modern pop textures. Her music has earned support from BBC Introducing, Nialler9, Hot Press, RTÉ 2FM and Today FM. After releasing her debut EP, “Rise & Run”, in January 2025, Miranda took her music on the road with shows in Amsterdam, London, Dublin, Belfast and across Ireland. Off to a busy start in 2026, she showcased at Whelan’s Ones to Watch in January and at Ruby Sessions in March, and opened for artists including Kate Stephenson, Tide Lines, Jesse Sykes and Dear Willow in Dublin. Her sophomore EP, “The Bar Is in Hell”, is set for release early next year. In the meantime, she’ll showcase at Ireland Music Week 2026.

dj-chach-u-on-the-decks.name: DJ CHACHØU ON THE DECKS
dj-chach-u-on-the-decks.bio: CHACHØU is a French DJ, producer and co-founder of Mindset, Into the Void collectives & Rewilding experiences, based in Cork. Known for taking listeners on emotional musical journeys, she blends melodic and progressive house with tribal percussion, organic elements and downtempo to create immersive sets that inspire connection, expression and dance. For Serenity Gardens at Electric Picnic, CHACHØU showcases the more organic side of her sound, weaving together warm percussion, earthy textures, ethereal vocals and uplifting grooves that invite people to dance barefoot, reconnect with themselves and those around them, and fully embrace the moment. Fresh from performances at Éalú Le Grá, Rewild, Féile Solas, Wild & Well and Fuinneamh Festival, CHACHØU continues to create experiences where music, nature and community come together. Expect an uplifting journey filled with melody, tribal influences and grooves that celebrate freedom, connection and the joy of moving together.

morning-kirtan-with-lea.name: MORNING KIRTAN WITH LEA
morning-kirtan-with-lea.bio: Discover the transformative power of Kirtan, a simple yet profound way to meditate through melody, rhythm and vibration. Kirtan is about letting go of fear and allowing every unique voice to merge into one soothing, collective sound. It is an ancient practice of communal chanting that can uplift the mind, open the heart and cultivate deep inner peace. This is the perfect space to completely let go and allow the music to carry you. Lea leads Kirtan straight from the heart, driven by her deep love for the practice. She profoundly believes that chanting mantras and working with sound are vital tools on our healing journey. Lea is also a certified Sound Practitioner and Vocal Alchemist.

neurographics-with-yana.name: NEUROGRAPHICS WITH YANA
neurographics-with-yana.bio: The Neurographics workshop is a 90-minute journey into your subconscious, where you will learn a neuroscience-informed, therapeutic art method designed to promote neuroplasticity, ease, flow and a deeper understanding of human nature. Following a simple algorithm, you will transform a negative thought pattern into a clearer, more positive insight through a guided, meditative drawing process. You will leave with your own Neurographics drawing, allowing the process to continue beyond the festival, as well as a new skill to add to your wellbeing toolbox. The session is facilitated by Yana, a certified Neurographics Specialist. All materials are provided and no previous experience is required. You don’t even need to be “good at drawing

s-yoga-b-beo.name: Sí Yoga: Bí Beo
s-yoga-b-beo.bio: A playful invitation to step out of the ordinary for a while. To move, listen, laugh, dance a little and remember what it feels like to be completely at home in your body. We’ll weave together flowing yoga, playful balances, intuitive movement and music, letting the rhythm carry us between the familiar and the unexpected. A practice with enough structure to ground us, and enough freedom to let something a little more instinctive emerge. Inspired by the natural world, a little Irish magic and the belief that wonder is not something we grow out of, but something we learn to notice again. No perfect poses. No previous experience needed. Just curiosity, bare feet and a willingness to play. Come as you are. Leave a little lighter, a little freer, and perhaps a little closer to the part of yourself that already knows how to be magical alive.

your-festival-journey-a-creative-journey.name: YOUR FESTIVAL JOURNEY: A CREATIVE JOURNEY THROUGH COLLAGE WITH RUTH & EL
your-festival-journey-a-creative-journey.bio: Join Ruth and El for a creative workshop of joyous reflection on your festival experience. Beginning and ending with a guided visualisation, this workshop will provide a safe and creative space to make a memento of your festival journey. Come away from your weekend with a map or small zine of your festival journey, to remind you of all the joy and shenanigans!

raw-reciting-spoken-word-hour-with-the-v.name: RAW & RECITING : SPOKEN WORD HOUR WITH THE VAGABOND QUEEN, LULU SINNOTT & CATHAL HOLDEN
raw-reciting-spoken-word-hour-with-the-v.bio: Raw & Reciting is an intimate hour of spoken word in the Soft Landing space at Electric Picnic, featuring The Vagabond Queen, Lulu Sinott and Cathal Holden. Honest words, bold voices, lived experience and stories that linger long after they have been spoken. Step away from the festival rush, settle in and experience three distinctive performers sharing work that is fierce, tender, funny and unapologetically human. Come as you are, listen closely and let the words land.

cathal-holden.name: CATHAL HOLDEN
cathal-holden.bio: Cathal Holden, is a poet, hip hop artist and storyteller from the Dingle Peninsula. His words grow at the crossroads between the old world and the new, rooted in the oral tradition of the seanchaí and branching into modern realms of spoken word and hip hop. Cathal writes for firesides and forests, for love lost and found, i gcoir stáitse féile agus shráid na cathrach araon.

lulu-sinnott.name: LULU SINNOTT
lulu-sinnott.bio: Lulu Sinnott is an Irish poet and spoken-word performer whose writing explores place, memory, relationships and the beautifully complicated business of being human. Her poetry has appeared in A New Ulster, Cork Literary Review, Drawn to the Light, The Prose Poem and the PrimeCut/Axis Ballymun Anthology. A warm and engaging presence on stage, Lulu has performed in Ireland and internationally, including appearances in San Francisco, New York and Berlin. She hosts the monthly Poetry by the Barrow open mic in Graiguenamanagh and co-hosts Poetry by the Sea with ArtNetDLR. Returning to Serenity Gardens, Lulu brings poetry that is reflective, intimate and grounded in everyday life—inviting audiences to pause, listen and find something of themselves between the lines.

full-funktion.name: Full Funktion
full-funktion.bio: Full Funktion is Irish techno duo Scott Curtis and Raymond O'Connor, crafting high-energy, hypnotic sets that blend driving rhythms with immersive sound design. Drawing inspiration from Detroit's underground grit, Berlin experimentation, and modern club-focused production, their sound is built on texture, tension, and momentum, combining pounding kick drums, intricate percussion, evolving synth layers, and cinematic atmospheres designed for late-night dancefloors. From DJ sets to original productions, Full Funktion creates a continuous journey of deep grooves, powerful breakdowns, and precision drops. Their music has been released on some of techno's most respected labels, including Kevin Saunderson's KMS Records, Sasha Carassi's Phobiq, Umek's 1605, 2000 and One and Sandy Huner's Bitten Records, as well as MKT, Orange Records, and Respekt, earning support from Eats Everything on BBC Radio 1. With a growing catalogue and an uncompromising passion for techno, Full Funktion continues to push forward with powerful, immersive performances.

ciano.name: Ciano
ciano.bio: Cian has been with Transmission from the very beginning, working behind the scenes as our sound technician and delivering the beautiful sound and thumping bass that define the experience. A seasoned DJ since the age of 16, Cian’s passion for old-school classics shines through in his electrifying sets. Having performed at festivals such as Casapalooza and supported top names including John Gibbons and DJ Krisp, Cian’s mixes promise an unforgettable journey through timeless beats.

granted.name: Granted
granted.bio: Granted has his roots based in the techno music scene since the mid-1990s. This deep-rooted passion for the genre has profoundly influenced his unique sound and style. Expect everything from deep groovy tech house tracks to funky techno through to melodic and hard techno beats, his sets will have you dancing as he takes you on a journey from start to finish. Having been at the Transmission Stage at Electric Picnic since 2022, he showcases his deep appreciation for the genre's pioneers with each set. Granted continues to captivate audiences and contribute to the ever-evolving world of techno music whilst paying tribute to the artists and classics that gave him his passion from the start.

victor-beesley.name: Victor Beesley
victor-beesley.bio: DJ Victor Beesley has been organising gigs since 2000. "Seeing the DJ's play the crowd gave me the passion to study techniques and find my own groove". Taking inspiration from various genres he's been playing pubs, clubs and raves for the last 26 years. He brings his own flavour to this versatile mix of Artists.

furlong.name: Furlong
furlong.bio: A true Transmission original, Furlong has been a cornerstone of the Transmission Stage since its very first edition in 2016. As the stage celebrates its 10th year, he returns once again to deliver the high-energy sets that have become a Transmission tradition. Known for his fearless and eclectic approach, Furlong blends techno, electro, acid, drum & bass, and more, taking crowds on an unpredictable journey across the electronic music spectrum. Expect deep grooves, driving rhythms, old-school influences, and fresh sounds, all woven together with his signature style. His infectious energy and commanding stage presence create an atmosphere that fills the dancefloor, while his ability to build the vibe keeps crowds moving from start to finish. Celebrating a decade of Transmission, don’t miss one of the festival’s longest-standing DJs as he once again brings the energy, passion, and soundtrack to another unforgettable year.

mad-gab.name: Mad Gab
mad-gab.bio: Dj and multi media artist, MadGab has played her local circuit organised gigs and art events since Lamberts legendary heyday raves where she was a body artist and club gear designer. She was joint collaborator with Ali Ali when they created the first Transmission together at EP 2016. MadGab brings a unique perspective, playing multiple genres, her sets are an ecclectic mix of beats basslines and bangers. As one of the origional Soundclowns, her priority is to read the crowd and keep it lit.

snell.name: Snell
snell.bio: Based in Arklow, Co. Wicklow, Snell has been the driving force in the Wicklow underground dance scene for over a decade. With standout performances on the Mixmag Stage at All together Now Festival as well as a main room set at Index, Snell has built a reputation for delivering high-energy, no nonsense House and Techno sets that keep dancefloors moving from start to finish. A resident DJ at the Royal Arklow, Snell can also be found playing clubs and venues across Dublin throughout the year, bringing a deep passion for underground electronic music and a relentless focus on creating memorable moments on the dancefloor.

dancenasty.name: Dancenasty
dancenasty.bio: For more than three decades, dancenastydj has been dedicated to underground electronic music, building a reputation for delivering energetic, carefully crafted DJ sets that blend house and trance with authentic underground sounds. With 30 years of DJ experience, dancenastydj has performed at intimate club nights, underground events, and community-driven electronic music gatherings, always focusing on the musical journey rather than trends. A resident DJ at Transmission Space for the past 10 years, dancenastydj has become known for creating immersive dancefloor experiences, moving between deep grooves, driving house rhythms, uplifting trance, and late-night underground selections. Every performance is built around connection, atmosphere, and keeping the dancefloor moving from the first track to the last.

mark-fitz.name: Mark Fitz
mark-fitz.bio: For over a decade, Mark Fitz has been blending driving techno, underground house and his own productions into high-energy sets that keep crowds moving. A regular on Electric Picnic's Transmission Stage since 2016, he's become known for championing Irish talent and bringing serious energy wherever he plays

vibez.name: Vibez
vibez.bio: A lifelong audiophile vinyl record collector with decades behind the decks, DJ Vibez delivers a no-nonsense journey through underground electronic music. Fusing rolling Tech House, driving Techno, and timeless old-school rave classics. Part of the Transmission Stage family at Ireland’s Electric Picnic since 2019, Vibez has helped shape one of the festival’s underground spaces. As the Transmission crew marks its tenth year at Electric Picnic, he continues to represent the stage with passion, experience, and a deep love for electronic music.

mxrk.name: MXRK
mxrk.bio: DJ MXRK is a house based DJ from Gorey, Co. Wexford, delivering groovy sets from start to finish. Expect a selection of house music built around groove, rhythm and keeping the energy flowing throughout.

baw.name: Baw
baw.bio: Raised in Ireland's thriving late-'90s techno scene, Baw found his inspiration at the legendary Club303, where a lifelong passion for electronic music was born. Influenced by progressive house, French house and techno, he has crafted a sound that flows from deep melodic grooves to pounding peak-time techno. A long-standing figure in the Gorey dance music scene, Baw has remained dedicated through every era of club culture, with appearances at Club303, Homelands, Mystic Festival, Audio Garden and Electric Picnic's Transmission Stage. Every set is a journey, built on one groove and designed to keep the dancefloor moving from start to finish.

drowzeedan.name: DrowZeeDan
drowzeedan.bio: DrowZeeDan is aN Irish based sound terrorist with 25 years of bass warfare behind him. His sets are pure pressure: dubstep, bassline, 4x4, and UK garage delivered loud, dark, and uncompromising. From smashing big rooms back in the day like Twisted Pepper to Soundclowns and now Transmission Space to illegal beach parties and raves, he lives for the underground where the subs do the talking. Known for face-melting drops and relentless energy, DrowZeeDan doesn’t warm up rooms - he levels them. His latest release "Dan in Denia" is out now.

kev-mac.name: Kev Mac
kev-mac.bio: Irish born techno DJ/producer. His driving industrial techno with euphoric atmospheres, he finds the perfect balance of timeless techno to lift the dancefloor higher and higher. Venues played: The Vaults, Twisted Pepper, local Clubs and Festivals.

ali-kemal-ali.name: Ali Kemal Ali
ali-kemal-ali.bio: The man behind Transmission finally steps into the spotlight. As the creator of Electric Picnic's iconic UFO-inspired late-night experience, Ali Kemal Ali has spent the last decade shaping the stage, inspiring its artists and creating the world that thousands lose themselves in each year. For Transmission's 10th anniversary, he steps out from behind the scenes for a rare set of his own original productions. The man who started it all finally takes the decks.

mav666.name: MAV666
mav666.bio: MAV666 is a Dublin based DJ and producer operating at the intersection of techno, trance and Latin tek, delivering high intensity and energetic sets. With a sound that leans into pressure and movement, Mav’s approach is both forceful and playful, built around tension that still feels undeniably fun. Mav describes her sound as “aliens chasing you with menacing beats, but still sexy, bouncy and trance driven.” That balance runs through her sets, blending hard, driving rhythms with euphoric energy and fluid transitions between styles to create something unpredictable but cohesive. Mav’s productions, including tracks like Static Chaos, Rock Dat Run Dat and Gone Girl, have landed on labels such as Coalition, ADERB, HATE , Shivers and Mahlwerk, gaining support from names like Clara Cuvé, Cera Khin, Samantha Togni and OTTA. A Boiler Room appearance in 2023 further marked Mav’s presence, alongside continued support across the underground circuit. Mav has brought this sound to cities across Ireland and Europe, from Dublin, Belfast and Galway to Berlin, Ibiza, Manchester, Glasgow, Nantes and beyond, translating it into high impact, floor focused sets.

shauna-dee.name: Shauna Dee
shauna-dee.bio: Shauna Dee is an emerging force in Ireland’s electronic music scene, known for her high-energy, multi-genre DJ sets that seamlessly blend House, Disco, and Techno into a driving, crowd-focused sound. With over six years of experience behind the decks, she has built a reputation for versatile, fast-paced performances that adapt to any stage while maintaining a distinct identity. In January, Shauna secured a standout milestone in her career when she was selected to support Ewan McVicar on his sold-out arena tour. She has performed at major festivals including Electric Picnic, Forbidden Fruit, All Together Now, and Longitude, alongside gigs across Ireland and international sets in Ibiza. She is also set to perform at Éalú le Grá in Galway and Forbidden Fruit this May, with many yet to be announced festival bookings, continuing a trajectory of high-profile bookings and growing recognition within the Irish electronic music scene. Shauna Dee continues to gain attention for her technical ability, crowd control, and energetic delivery behind the decks.

diebyveg-b2b-charlotte-walsh.name: DIEBYVEG B2B Charlotte Walsh
diebyveg-b2b-charlotte-walsh.bio:
DIEBYVEG is a distinctive selector out of the Irish electronic scene. Finding their feet within underground soundscapes including UKG and tech house, they have become known for their multi-genre approach which electrified dance floors across Ireland. DIEBYVEG performs high energy, unique and exciting sets with a distinct queer influence throughout. After being selected to close out the ‘Someplace Else’ stage at Forbidden Fruit 2025 and setting the pace for world renowned acts such as Interplanetary Criminal and Prozak, it is certain that DIEBYVEG is one to watch for the future. Charlotte, a Cork born and based DJ, has made a name for herself over the past 3 years with shows at Cyprus Avenue, Tengu, and the Telegraph Building, as well as recent appearances at Electric Picnic, Beyond the Pale, and Fuinneamh.
Her sets traverse the spectrum of dance music, from bass and breakbeat to progressive house. With a love for groovy basslines and dynamic textures, she creates a sound that is playful, bouncy, and brimming with momentum - the perfect ingredients to keep you bopping into the early hours.

lorcan-kelly.name: Lorcan Kelly
lorcan-kelly.bio:
A high-energy techno sound driven by nostalgia, intensity and forward momentum. Lorcan Kelly reimagines familiar hooks through a heavy, modern lens, pairing rave-ready power with sharp, contemporary production. At just 22, he is already bridging generations - collaborating with techno pioneer Mark Broom while aligning with new-wave artists including STITCH and Kule. His productions have earned support from Kettama, Fred again.., Patrick Mason, Tafkamp, Grace Dahl, Truncate, Prospa, Blasha & Allatt, Bailey Ibbs, Danny Wabbit, and Skin On Skin.
His recent EP on Dublin-based label Hidden Love marks a new chapter - expanding his sound beyond peak-time pressure into deeper, more emotional territory while retaining the drive that defines his productions.
A sound built for the floor.

lawrence-b2b-kule.name: LAWRENCE B2B Kule
lawrence-b2b-kule.bio: LAWRENCE is a fast-rising DJ and producer from Ratoath, Co.Meath. Over the past few years, LAWRENCE has been carving his own lane in the scene, playing shows with promoters like District X, Forbidden Fruit, Index, Slither, The Lounge, Shed Residents and Lips2Ears - alongside sharing the stage with major global acts such as X-Club, Clouds, Club Angel, LB aka LABAT, Sunnysoposted, Luke Dean and Max Dean to name a few. With a love for both underground and more commercial leaning sounds, LAWRENCE's sets and discography drift between Techno, Trance and Garage, with his productions maintaining this fluidity - ranging from deep ambient cuts to club ready rollers. 2025 saw a major breakout year for LAWRENCE with shows across the board garnering huge support slots and playing to his biggest crowds yet, alongside earning over 300,000 plays and ascertaining support from artists like LB aka Labat, Future666 and Thelma - the second half of 2026 is forecasted to up the intensity once again, as LAWRENCE steps comfortably into a new level of performance and artistry. Kule has been steadily carving out his own sound within the Irish scene. Known for his euphoric synths and nostalgia laced piano tracks, he has gained support from the likes of Skin On Skin, Effy, KETTAMA and Tiësto. Blending diverse genres with his own original productions, Kule bridges the gap between house and techno in his sets. Over the last number of months he has played at iconic Irish venues such as Wigwam, Dolan’s, Monroes and Index.

faxe-on-faxe.name: FAXE ON FAXE
faxe-on-faxe.bio:
FAXE ON FAXE is a Dublin-based DJ, producer, and member of Dublin collective The Shed Residents, renowned for his dynamic sound. He typically blends hardgroove, hard house, and UK funky. His productions span multiple genres with a focus on house, hardgroove, and eurodance, allowing his groovy, funky, and percussive style to captivate audiences and energise dance floors.
Having supported artists like MCR-T, Kink, DJ Aya, and more in Dublin’s top clubs, FAXE ON FAXE has built a strong reputation in the city’s nightlife. His music has been featured in major Irish publications such as District Magazine, Nialler9, and Four Four Magazine. FAXE ON FAXE has also made various festival appearances, featuring for The Shed Residents at Beyond The Pale and Fuinneamh.

oisinok.name: OISINOK
oisinok.bio: Over the past five years, OISINOK has carved out a distinctive place within Ireland’s thriving techno landscape. Known for dark, driving, and uncompromisingly dancefloor-focused selections, his sound balances raw intensity with moments of emotional depth—building immersive sets that feel both powerful and deeply resonant. He has played at Festivals such as Fuinneamh , Ifyouknow, Emerge, Outset, Electric Picnic and iconic venues including Index, XOYO ,The Telegraph Building, Dolans Warehouse and Silo as well as shows across Ireland aswell as Ibiza, London, Liverpool, Amsterdam & Glasgow.

collie.name: Collie
collie.bio:
Collie stands out as one of Dublin’s most consistent and dedicated selectors, earning a reputation for his deep musical knowledge, refined taste, and tireless work ethic. 
A familiar name across Ireland’s club circuit, Collie has graced the decks of every major venue and festival both at home and abroad, sharing lineups with heavyweights such as Sven Väth, DJ Seinfeld, Kerri Chandler, Sweely, and Chaos in the CBD. 
His international appearances include iconic stages like Fabric London further cementing his status as a trusted name in underground music circles.  
Raised in a musically rich environment, Collie began DJing at just 15 under the guidance of his father. Over the years, he’s built an extensive vinyl collection that spans genres and eras, allowing him to craft dynamic, unpredictable sets that move effortlessly between house, techno, and beyond.  
As a producer, Collie continues to push forward with a string of standout releases on respected imprints such as Out Straight Records and Traxx Underground. His latest 12” has already garnered strong support, with more vinyl releases lined up for 2026 - including an upcoming record on 393 Records and a fresh remix of a true Irish classic…  You can’t go far in Ireland’s club culture without hearing Collie’s name. His passion, authenticity, and versatility have made him one of the country’s most trusted selectors; his all-night-long sets showcase the full spectrum of his sound, from warm-up grooves to peak-time energy and after-hours depth.

taurean.name: Taurean
taurean.bio: taurean is an Ireland-born, Berlin-based DJ, and promoter, who has developed her style with an affinity for hypnotic, driving & dubby techno. Heavily influenced by the early sounds of Detroit techno, as well as the 2000s uk dub/jungle movement, she is currently carving out her space in berlin's techno scene with appearances in Renate, Aeden & Tresor. As founder of the community platform and event series DOLLHAUS, she advocates for FLINTA and BIPOC artists, and seeks to create intentional spaces for us to party, as well as a refuge on our dancefloors.

bronwyn.name: BRONWYN
bronwyn.bio:
Bronwyn is an emerging DJ from Dublin’s underground scene. Known for her hypnotic precision and deep, driving groove, she crafts sets that feel purpose-built for shadowy, immersive spaces.
A staple across Ireland’s most forward-thinking clubs and festivals, Bronwyn has supported international heavyweights including Kerrie, Ignez, 9x9, Zisko and more. Her reputation accelerated after a 12-hour marathon party alongside Ignez and Vilchezz — a testament to her ability to guide a crowd through long-form, full-body experiences.
Her sound is intentional and patient, rooted in minimal pressure and pulsing rhythms that blur the line between physical and cerebral. Bronwyn’s selections weave tension and release with surgical focus, creating a hypnotic atmosphere that locks dancers in and keeps them craving more. Expect layered textures, deep grooves, and a relentless undercurrent designed for the late-night forest energy.
With recent milestones including her debut at ADE, Bronwyn continues to carve her path. She brings a set built for movement, depth, and total immersion — a journey into the darker, more intense corners of the dancefloor.

sacred-sites-of-ireland-sean-sc-alta.name: Sacred Sites of Ireland | Sean Scéalta
sacred-sites-of-ireland-sean-sc-alta.bio:
Sean Scéalta | Tales of the Sovereignty Goddesses of Ireland
Storytelling and song by Archaeologist and Bean Draoí Treasa Ní Mhurchú of Sacred Sites of Ireland, Bean Feasa Deirdre Wadding, Founder of Coire SOIS School of Irish Spirituality and Creative Director Ani Borg, Founder of Babylon's Inferno Artistic Collective.

m-isle-r-festival-of-nomadic-cultures.name: M⁠isleór Festival of Nomadic Cultures
m-isle-r-festival-of-nomadic-cultures.bio: M⁠isleór Festival of Nomadic Cultures is Europe’s only festival dedicated to celebrating the arts, culture and lived experiences of nomadic communities. Founded by Galway Traveller Movement in 2019, Misleór brings together Traveller, Roma, Sámi and other nomadic artists, performers and cultural leaders from across the world to share music, storytelling, theatre, film, poetry and visual art while celebrating the richness and diversity of nomadic cultures. This year marks Misleór’s second visit to Electric Picnic, where the Hazelwood Stage will once again become a vibrant meeting place for Traveller and nomadic voices. Audiences can experience an exciting programme of music, spoken word and performance from Irish Traveller artists alongside performers from other nomadic communities, offering a unique glimpse into the creativity, resilience and living traditions that define Misleór. We’re delighted to bring a taste of Europe’s most distinctive celebration of nomadic cultures to Electric Picnic.

cosc-n.name: Coscán
cosc-n.bio: COSCÁN, formed in 1998, are a Traditional Folk band from Slane, Co. Meath have been busy performing at venues all over Ireland and Europe. With 3 highly acclaimed albums, COSCÁN is Harry Long (whistles, guitar and vocals), David Nevin (bodhrán, keyboards, guitar and vocals), Gerry Doggett (fiddle, accordian and whistles) and Kieran Weldon (guitar and vocals). COSCÁN are currentlybusy composing, arranging and recording new music. Collaboration between the four band members knows no limits. As with their previous album, COSCÁN compose music influenced by the ancient monuments and folklore of the Boyne Valley, particularly the village of Slane, Newgrange, Tara and surrounds.

major-feen.name: Major Feen
major-feen.bio: Is banna gatch-cheoil as Chathair Luimnigh iad Major Feen. Bunaithe i dtosach na Bliana 2024, cuireann an grúpa poirt traidisiúnta agus fuinneamh punk le chéile chun a bhfuaim féin a chruthú. Go dtí anois, tá E.P agus an singil darbh aimn ‘Last City’ curtha amach acu agus neart le teacht. Hailing from Limerick, Major Feen is an emerging Irish band blending raw punk sensibilities with deep-rooted traditional Irish folk. Taking their name from a fusion of military rank and the Munster vernacular word for man (“feen”), the group delivers an authentic, high-energy sound steeped in storytelling, heritage, and rebellion. Their music relies on physical, acoustic exertion and a do-it-yourself spirit. Major Feen reimagines old Irish traditions through contemporary narratives, capturing both complex craftsmanship and the chaotic charm of live performance. A prominent force within the burgeoning local music scene, the band has earned acclaim through high-octane showcases across Limerick.

the-liam-o-connor-show.name: The Liam O Connor Show
the-liam-o-connor-show.bio: Experience the raw energy, passion, and melodic genius of The Liam O'Connor Show, a spellbinding celebration of deep-rooted traditional Irish music, song, and dance.Led by internationally renowned multi-instrumentalist Liam O’Connor, the performance delivers an extraordinary blend of vibrant Irish heritage and contemporary mastery. Celebrated as the 2012 Instrumentalist of the Year and 2026 Family Band of the Year at the Irish Entertainment Awards, O’Connor brings a world-class production to life alongside his immensely talented family. Featuring Saoirse (vocals, concertina, keyboards), Oisín (guitars, keyboards, percussion), and Cillian (drums), this dynamic ensemble creates an unforgettable stage presence.  A staple of major international events and returning for his seventh year at Electric Picnic, Liam O’Connor delivers a powerful show that stands proudly among the best live music acts in the world.

fierin-j-electric-youth.name: Fierin J - Electric Youth
fierin-j-electric-youth.bio: Fierin j is a four-piece band from Clare that primarily plays indie rock. They like to write originals and enjoy the creative process, but they also cover songs by popular artists in the genre. They have played gigs across Clare with the Clare Youth Service and other live music venues in the county, and they look forward to venturing outside of the county. They are forever grateful for the opportunity. Electric Youth is a vibrant celebration of creativity and talent for young people aged 14-24 – this eagerly anticipated annual collaboration between Youth Work Ireland Laois and Electric Picnic which showcases the transformative power of music, arts and youthwork, highlighting its positive impact on the lives of its young participants. Electric Youth provides a unique platform for showcasing the remarkable skills and passions of these individuals, many of whom are self-taught artists, musicians, singers, or poets, many of whom are creating and performing to an enthusiastic and encouraging audience for the first time at Electric Youth.

paradise-conspiracy-electric-youth.name: Paradise Conspiracy - Electric Youth
paradise-conspiracy-electric-youth.bio: Paradise Conspiracy is a four-piece band from Tipperary. They have been together for a year and a half and have played a number of gigs throughout Ireland. Their catalog comprises originals and covers, and they are currently working on adding new original material to their setlist. Electric Youth is a vibrant celebration of creativity and talent for young people aged 14-24 – this eagerly anticipated annual collaboration between Youth Work Ireland Laois and Electric Picnic which showcases the transformative power of music, arts and youthwork, highlighting its positive impact on the lives of its young participants. Electric Youth provides a unique platform for showcasing the remarkable skills and passions of these individuals, many of whom are self-taught artists, musicians, singers, or poets, many of whom are creating and performing to an enthusiastic and encouraging audience for the first time at Electric Youth.

beomhar-electric-youth.name: Beomhar - Electric Youth
beomhar-electric-youth.bio: Beomhar is a group of 8 musicians from Laois and Offaly. They were formed to compete in the prestigious Siansa Gael Linn competition, which showcases the top young trad musicians across Ireland. Last year they reached the final, and this year they were placed 2nd overall. All members of Beomhar play multiple instruments and all have provincial and All Ireland medals at Fleadh Cheoil. They are members of the Music Generation Trad Orchestra and the Senior Harp Ensemble, as well as Ceoltóirí Óga Laighean. Their mentor is Siobhan Buckley of Laois Music Generation. Electric Youth is a vibrant celebration of creativity and talent for young people aged 14-24 – this eagerly anticipated annual collaboration between Youth Work Ireland Laois and Electric Picnic which showcases the transformative power of music, arts and youthwork, highlighting its positive impact on the lives of its young participants. Electric Youth provides a unique platform for showcasing the remarkable skills and passions of these individuals, many of whom are self-taught artists, musicians, singers, or poets, many of whom are creating and performing to an enthusiastic and encouraging audience for the first time at Electric Youth.

mackayla-chloe-electric-youth.name: Mackayla Chloe - Electric Youth
mackayla-chloe-electric-youth.bio: Makayla Chloe is a singer-songwriter from County Kildare. Her influences include Noah Kahan and Zach Bryan, and she has been writing songs since she was 14. Her first song was featured in a recent season of the Netflix show Ginny & Georgia. Electric Youth is a vibrant celebration of creativity and talent for young people aged 14-24 – this eagerly anticipated annual collaboration between Youth Work Ireland Laois and Electric Picnic which showcases the transformative power of music, arts and youthwork, highlighting its positive impact on the lives of its young participants. Electric Youth provides a unique platform for showcasing the remarkable skills and passions of these individuals, many of whom are self-taught artists, musicians, singers, or poets, many of whom are creating and performing to an enthusiastic and encouraging audience for the first time at Electric Youth.

oracle-villa.name: Oracle Villa
oracle-villa.bio: Oracle Villa are an original rock n roll band from Kilkenny, Ireland. Steeped in the musical heritage of their home town, the trio draws influence from roots, grunge, indie and punk . Their sound, described by Hotpress as ‘heavy on the strums, light on the ears’ is powerful yet melodic, inviting and yet unforgiving. They released their debut album to a sold-out crowd in Cleere’s, Kilkenny on the 20th June before embarking on a small Irish tour.

the-caochaleles.name: The Caochaleles
the-caochaleles.bio: Formed in October 2025 as a grassroots community gathering, The Caochaleles have swiftly evolved into one of County Laois’s most dynamic and uplifting musical ensembles. What began as a modest weekly meetup at Coach O’Leary’s pub in Ballacolla has rapidly scaled into a full-fledged acoustic phenomenon.  The Caochaleles bring an infectious, high-energy repertoire spanning timeless folk classics, pop anthems, and crowd-pleasing sing-alongs. Rooted in camaraderie, inclusivity, and traditional Irish craic, their performances bridge the gap between audience and stage.

l-lia-gillian-egleston-mike-hennigar.name: Lúlia Gillian Egleston & Mike Hennigar
l-lia-gillian-egleston-mike-hennigar.bio: Lúila is a singer/songwriter from limerick, Ireland, whose sound fuses soulful vocals with rock energy and unmistakable Irish folk edge. The lead singer of Limerick blues-rock band Edged in Blue, she recently brought her powerhouse presence to this years Rory Gallagher festival, channeling the spirit of classic guitar-  driven music on stage. Rooted in Ireland’s traditions, Lúila has also delved into Sean-nós and Irish trad, weaving that ornamented, story-first style into her own originals and interpretations. Her influences span Delores O’Riardan, Sinead O’Connor to Stevie Nicks and Alanis Morissette- 70s/80s rock queens whose grit, poetry, and vulnerability inform lúila’s dynamnic phrasing and delivery. Songs of feeling and empowerment with rock and roll flair, shot through with old Irish folk attitude. For this festival appearance, Lúila is joined by limerick guitarist Mike Hennigar (edged in blue, Sweets, Trench Knife), whose expressive tone and melodic bite add vivid colour to her emotive storytelling.

an-galar-dub-v-shelovescalpol.name: An Galar Dub v shelovescalpol
an-galar-dub-v-shelovescalpol.bio:
An Galar Dub v shelovescalpol with Julie Goo on the mic. Bounce around to sounds from The Marsh as this Cork trio collaborates, ahead of the release of their EP.
An Galar Dub is a bass-heavy electronic producer whose tracks are played across dance floors and radio stations internationally. shelovescalpol (SLC) comprises of producer & DJ Milis and bilingual poet/singer Julie Goo. SLC are an award nominated bilingual hip hop/trip hop Cork duo making waves across Irish radio. Bígí linn.

rageire.name: Rageire
rageire.bio: Creations from Irish musician Jeremy Morgan. Fusing Irish with Global Traditional and Contemporary Sounds, from Uilleann Pipes to Analogue Synths, Prepared Piano to Projection mapping.

tigh-na-coille.name: Tigh Na Coille
tigh-na-coille.bio: Tigh na Coille is an award-winning traditional Irish music, song, and dance ensemble from County Clare, Ireland. Named after their homeplace (meaning "house in the woods"), the group features talented teens and young adults directed by renowned musicians and educators Denis Liddy and Elvie Miller.

hiphap-gaelach.name: Hiphap Gaelach
hiphap-gaelach.bio:
Tá gluaiseacht hip-hap na Gaeilge ag dul ó neart go neart le blianta beaga anuas, le ceoltóirí, filí, agus rapálaithe ag ceiliúradh na teanga i gclubanna agus i bhféilte ar fud na tíre.  Is ceolchoirmeacha agus oícheanta filíochta iad Hip-Hap Gaelach a chuireann litríocht agus teanga bheo na hip-haipe ar ardán os comhair slua.
There has been a surge of Irish language hip hop music in the past few years, with musicians, rappers, and poets celebrating the form in clubs and at festivals around the country. Hip Hap Gaelach is a celebration if Irish language hip hop culture and artists that brings the living literature and language to audiences. First featured by CEOLTA at IMRAM 2026, curated by Eoin P. Ó Murchú, this Hazelwood installation will be curated by rapper James Shannon.

clada.name: Clada
clada.bio:
Is banna dinimiciúil damhsa as Contae na Gaillimhe iad CLADA. Bunaithe i mí an Mhárta 2024, tá siad tar éis ollthionchar a imirt ar a lucht féachana trí cheol traidisiúnta Éireannach a chumasc le buillí pop, func, agus damhsa. 
Hailing from Co. Galway on the Wild Atlantic Way, CLADA are at the forefront of Irish Dance Music — a sound rooted deep in the West of Ireland's living tradition and driven by the kind of infectious rhythmic energy that gets a room on its feet.
Born out of late-night sessions and a fierce love of the music, the band brings together some of the most exciting young players on the scene. Their performances are a masterclass in tension and release — tight, propulsive IDM at its best, shot through with the raw authenticity of Connacht tradition.

leatsa.name: Leatsa
leatsa.bio: Is banna dátheangach traidisúnta Gaelach / Ceilteach / Tíre / Pop iad Leatsa, as Gaillimh. Léimeann siad isteach i réimse leathan de cheol - idir phoirt phreabacha na hÉireann, na bailéid spreagúla, agus amhráin mhóra a dhéanann cór den lucht féachana. Tá blianta de thaithí acu os comhair an tsaoil mhóir a thagann go Gaillimh agus chuig na háiteanna móra le rá a mbíonn Leatsa ag casadh iontu go rialta sa gcathair, agus nuair a bhítear ag gig dá gcuid, is cinnte go mbeidh fuinneamh ar leith ann. Tá siad ag súil go mór le ceol, teanga agus fuinneamh na nGael a bhreith leo aniar chuig an bPicnic Leictreach i mbliana.

m-abh-mulligan-eva-carroll.name: Méabh Mulligan & Eva Carroll
m-abh-mulligan-eva-carroll.bio:
Is amhránaithe agus seinnteoirí consairtín iad Méabh Mulligan agus Eva Carroll, as Baile Átha Cliath agus Oirthear an Chláir. Tá cúlra ceoil acu beirt - is í Eva iníon na n-amhránaithe Brian O’Rourke agus Paula Carroll, agus is teaghlach Mhéabh atá i bhfeighil ar an Cobblestone i Margadh na Feirme, áit a gcasann na cailíní go minic. Casann siad amhráin in éindí as Béarla agus as Gaeilge le tionlacain consairtín, anuas ar na tunes ar ndóigh! 
Méabh Mulligan and Eva Carroll are two singing concertina players hailing from East Clare and Dublin. They both come from musical families, Eva being the daughter of singers Brian O’Rourke and Paula Carroll, while Méabh’s family run the Cobblestone pub in Smithfield, Dublin, where the two girls play on a regular basis. Méabh took Eva out of her musical shell and they have been playing together ever since!

bog-bodies.name: Bog Bodies
bog-bodies.bio:
“Rac an Phortaigh” nó “Draoirac” a thugtar ar cheol Bog Bodies go minic, banna tromfolk a bhunaigh an t-amhránaí agus antraipeolaí Dan Maher. Réimse staidéir agus suim Dan i gcultúir ársa a spreag seánra ardfhuinneamh an bhanna a tharraingíonn amhráin ón éitear le linn a gcuairtíocht ar tuamaí meigiliteacha agus suíomhanna seanda eile.
Bog Bodies are a heavy folk outfit (often dubbed “Bog Rock” or “Druid Rock”) formed by Irish singer-songwriter and anthropologist Dan Maher. Their genre-bending, high-energy folk sound is inspired by Dan’s close study and appreciation of ancient culture, pulling songs from the ether during visits to megalithic tombs and other ancient sites.

birch.name: Birch
birch.bio:
Banna ceoil ó chontae na Mí, is dlúthchairde iad Aoife Moore agus Kevin Burke. D’athraigh siad ainm an bhanna le déanaí ó ‘We’re Not Together’ go ‘Birch’. Cloistear ina gceol nithe den cheol folk ó na 60dí, chomh maith le ceol rac ó na 70dí. Beidh banna iomlán leo i mbliana ag an bPicnic.

Birch (formerly known as We’re Not Together) are a band and best friends Aoife Moore and Keving Burke from Meath. Their music weaves elements of 60s folk with 70s rock. They played Electric Picnic for the first time in 2023 with the help of Phil Christie and Joshua Murtagh on keys, Chris Barry on Bass, Donal Bowens on drums and Aoife Kelly on the fiddle. They will play with a full band at this year’s festival.

dj-nemo-beo-picnic.name: DJ Nemo / Beo Picnic
dj-nemo-beo-picnic.bio: DJ Nemo or DJ No Name.  Spinning the ones and twos with an eclectic mix of music from the past, present and future during our turnarounds.

l-ar.name: Léaró
l-ar.bio: Aoife Breathnach and Helen de Búrca make up Léaró, a folk-pop girl band from Fingal, North County Dublin. Having grown up together as best friends since their school days, Aoife and Helen bonded over a shared love of music and theatre. This interest inspires their romantic, lyrical style, emphasising performance and storytelling. With Aoife’s vocals and guitar paired with Helen’s accompaniment on harp and Q-chord, Léaró combines sounds to create a unique blend of dark, strong, smoky folk and light, delicate, dreamy pop. Join Léaró at the Hazelwood Stage on Thursday for a mix of nostalgic covers and original songs, with playful strumming, doleful melodies, and deeply earnest storytelling.

maryann-electric-youth.name: MARYANN - Electric Youth
maryann-electric-youth.bio: MARYANN is a rising force on Ireland’s pop scene, blending glittering, feel-good energy with emotional depth and sharp lyrical wit. Hannah Montana’s sparkle meets the rich, emotive tones of Dido — powerful, expressive vocals that move effortlessly between vulnerability, fragility, humour and bold pop confidence.Her songwriting is rooted in sincerity, exploring the highs and lows of modern life, lust and love; with a refreshing honesty, while never losing a playful, self-aware edge. There is a distinct comedic thread woven through her work, giving audiences not just something to feel, but something to smile and laugh at too. Having already built momentum through live performances at renowned venues such as Cleere’s in Kilkenny, Carlow Arts Festival and Fred Zeppelin’s in Cork, MARYANN is quickly gaining a reputation for her dynamic and engaging stage presence. Vivacious, invigorating, and unapologetically glamorous, MARYANN offers a performance that is both emotionally resonant and irresistibly fun.

entr-achte-performance-1.name: Entr’achte - Performance 1
entr-achte-performance-1.bio:
The ladies of Entr’acte Musical Theatre and Dramatic Society present to you our ‘miscast’ set. Performing songs typically sung by male performers in male roles, let our ladies take you on a journey and imagine iconic musical numbers with new textures, vocal ranges, and dramatic interpretations.
Entr’acte is a performing arts group that produces bold and innovative theatre for Ireland’s creatives. We are incredibly excited for our Electric Picnic debut - bringing the musical theatre experience to the festival audience.

innner-vision-visual-light-projection-by.name: INNNER VISION, Visual Light Projection by Susan Walsh
innner-vision-visual-light-projection-by.bio: Visual Artist Susie Walsh uses darkspace projection to create immersive environments. Her practice investigates how light, colour, and translucent materials interact to create vibrant visual, physical, and psychological experiences. Using a combination of analogue and digital light projecting devices, her work interrogates themes of time passing and ecological concern, exploring the interplay between bodily and mental experience. Through spatial unfolding in the darkspace, her projections construct captivating illusions and synthetic worlds.

morrigna-fire-show.name: Morrigna Fire Show
morrigna-fire-show.bio: Morrigna Productions present Spreacha na gCoillte - Sparks of the Woods, a bespoke piece for Hazelwood Stage at Electric Picnic. This intimate fire performance; merges circus, group choreography, and Irish music. It is an invitation for all to connect with and celebrate our living roots through the ancestral practice of gathering in community around fire.

bl-ith-n-de-burca-blacomedy.name: Bláithín De Burca - BlaComedy
bl-ith-n-de-burca-blacomedy.bio: An Chollchoill | The Hazelwood, Thursday night host is Bláithín de Burca (known online as BlaComedy). Bláithín is an Irish stand-up comedian, writer, and presenter from Dublin. She is well known for her work on YouTube's The Try Channel, presenting the RTÉ documentary The Irish For Sex, and her live comedy shows exploring feminism, dating, and neurodivergence.

shrem.name: SHREM
shrem.bio: Shrem is a Dublin-based DJ, vinyl selector and music blogger known for eclectic disco, house and boogie sets. A regular at Mother he brings crate-dug rarities and pure dancefloor joy to every set.

glamo.name: GLAMO
glamo.bio: Glamo is a member of the Mother Club family, a frequent guest known for high-energy sets that blend house, disco, techno, and queer anthems. A staple of Dublin’s queer nightlife, Glamo brings bold beats and euphoric vibes to every stage, creating unforgettable dancefloor moments rooted in celebration, freedom, and fierce self-expression.

rocky-t-delgado.name: ROCKY T. DELGADO
rocky-t-delgado.bio: Rocky T. Delgado is a resident DJ at Mother and a cornerstone of Dublin’s queer club scene. Known for their genre-blurring sets of house, disco, techno, and rave classics, Rocky brings high energy, deep grooves, and pure queer joy to every set — always keeping the dancefloor locked and lifted.

mother-djs-ghostboy-ruth-kavanagh.name: MOTHER DJS (Ghostboy & Ruth Kavanagh)
mother-djs-ghostboy-ruth-kavanagh.bio: The Mother DJs: Ruth Kavanagh, and Ghostboy bring their signature queer sound to the forest  for euphoric late-night dancing. Expect genre-blending sets, big queer anthems, and deep club cuts under the trees. It’s all about freedom, joy, and dancefloor connection deep in the woods.

cocktail-party-like-it-s-1999-with-judit.bio: Time travel with the Boyle sisters to remember what cocktails got the party started in 1999 - bring your dancing shoes too!

sherry-and-irish-whiskey-a-love-story-wi.bio: Dive into the long-standing love affair between sherry from Jerez and whiskey from Ireland, with tasters of both to get your palates sharpened.

the-evergreen-brothers.name: THE EVERGREEN BROTHERS
the-evergreen-brothers.bio:
The Evergreen Brothers are a Galway folk band drawing from American roots, country, Irish traditional elements and blues. Formed in 2025, the band found its sound the natural way - playing pubs, sessions and venues, learning what carries in a room and cutting anything that doesn't. The music is just music: folk-led, harmony- driven, built on rhythm and feel. American influence sits in the bones, Irish in the 
grain, country and blues running like threads through the middle, just songs played honestly. 
In the last year The Evergreen Brothers have travelled and performed across 
Ireland and Germany, bringing energy, and always people-facing. Small rooms, street corners, wherever suits - that's where it belongs.

maicin.name: MAICIN
maicin.bio:
Maicín are an Irish five-piece folk rock band making what they like to call “Channel-Surf Rock”: A flickering eclectic blend of jangle pop, folk, new wave, and even boogie woogie.

 

Maicín began as a creative escape for songwriter Matt Hurley and drummer Aidan Kelleher, two young architects worn down by London life. What started as weekly jams to escape the mundanity of corporate life quickly became a fully fledged band. Well not quite “fully fledged”. Upon returning to Ireland, the band was completed by a mix of childhood friends and family: Darragh McNamara (bass), Méabh Fitzgerald (keys), and Ryan Daly (lead guitar).

the-foreign-locals.name: THE FOREIGN LOCALS
the-foreign-locals.bio: A musical collective built on rumours and word of mouth. We just create and hope you can relate.

out-on-bale.name: OUT ON BALE
out-on-bale.bio:
Out on Bale are a young Irish trio bringing high-energy live performances that blend country, pop and trad. Formed in March 2024, the band have already played to crowds of over 6,000 and built a rapidly growing online following, with their videos reaching over 2.4 million views.

Combining guitars, keyboards, bodhrán, accordion, bouzouki and harmonica, Out on Bale deliver a lively mix of music, energy and plenty of craic — guaranteed to have the crowd up, dancing and hopping from start to finish. Known for their fantastic crowd interaction. 

After an exciting few years building their name across Ireland, Out on Bale are set to make their UK debut in 2027.

dublin-ukulele-collective.name: DUBLIN UKULELE COLLECTIVE
dublin-ukulele-collective.bio:
The Dublin Ukulele Collective (DUC) is a thirty-five plus piece ukulele harmony band with a high feel-good-factor and watching them perform, the fun is obvious.

Members range in age up to 70+ and they perform a diverse repertoire of songs which reflects their age span.

Within are a seriously talented range of Dublin musicians including; experienced choir harmonisers, sexy middle-aged rockers and electric teenage funksters.

Expect upbeat, fun and rhythmic songs with loads of harmonies and a little nostalgia including songs from; Elbow, Cold Play, Radiohead, Talking Heads, Amy Winehouse, Erazure, Bob Dylan, Leonard Cohen, Jason Mraz and more. DUC is very much an audience join-in band.

jean-pack-and-the-slay-babies.name: JEAN PACK AND THE SLAY BABIES
jean-pack-and-the-slay-babies.bio:
Jean Pack is one of the year’s most idiosyncratic new voices - a songwriter whose work blends camp flair with raw feeling, structured chaos with cinematic charm. Her debut EP Allora, recorded at Big Child Studios in Cork with producer Caoilian Sherlock, introduced her as a bold, emotionally saturated presence: a cocktail of melancholia and mischief, poured neat.

Describing her sound as “a dirty aperitif with the first pint of the night,” she weaves lush harmonies, lo-fi textures, and sly lyricism into storytelling that is part cabaret, part confessional. Breakout single “Ruby” offered velvet bite and gem-cut polish, while “Birthday” traced a tragicomic friendship unravelling with dry wit.

Drawing influence from The Shangri-Las, Nancy & Lee, and The Velvet Underground, Jean Pack’s voice remains unmistakably her own - vulnerable, glamorous, and half-laughing through the ache.

the-luna-boys.name: THE LUNA BOYS
the-luna-boys.bio:
From the foothills of Bray Head comes the irrefutable finest live band in the country. Their shows are
a sex driven, love laden, heartbreaking, tear jerking look into modern society. They have taken the
country, folk and bluegrass genre and moulded them into their own brand of boom grass. The
versatility of the band means that they can captivate a theatre crowd or send a wedding party into a
frenzy . Hold on tight to your mammas, your sisters and your brides to be, cause they are gonna be
led astray at a Luna Boys show.

dogpond.name: DOGPOND
dogpond.bio:
DOGPOND, the dynamic ensemble known for their electrifying performances, are ready to captivate
audiences anew with their signature blend of short, snappy, and irresistibly catchy tunes.
Straight out of Dublin’s music melting pot, DOGPOND are a genre-defying force who’ve emerged
from the ashes of former rock and roll sensations The Hot Sprockets.
Their first single ‘KILNAMANAGH BLUES’ received a generous amount of National radio play, was
critically acclaimed by HotPress magazine and other print media, and was featured in a popular
Channel 4 TV Series.
This isn’t just a band; they’re a sonic journey, a musical kaleidoscope bringing the soul of Dublin to
life. Their fourth single ‘PAW IN DA POND’ is out now on all platforms.

david-geraghty.name: DAVID GERAGHTY
david-geraghty.bio:
David Geraghty is a member of SCGI (Screen Writers Guild of Ireland). He is also a five time Choice Music Prize-nominated multi-instrumentalist, composer, producer and writer of songs. 

He is a founding member of Bell X1 who have released nine studio albums to date.  Bell X1 are festival and arena headliners in their native Ireland playing to ever growing numbers on their regular North American and European tours.  He has released two solo albums under his own name with a third and fourth under the moniker Join Me in the Pines. 

2025 sees Geraghty return to the live scene under his own name, and with the promise of a new album, set for release in 2026.

the-jades.name: THE JADES
the-jades.bio: School-formed London four-piece the Jades bring a chaotic blend of Pulp’s poppy wit and the raw rock ‘n’ roll energy of Pixies and Ramones. Expect a riotous dance floor.

baka-beyond.name: BAKA BEYOND
baka-beyond.bio:
Baka Beyond are on the road again with their mix of African and Celtic music. promoting their new  album, Sing the World Awake. 
Inspired by the Baka Pygmies of Cameroon, founders Martin Cradick and Su Hart were deeply  moved by the Baka's music during their first visit to the Cameroon rainforest, prompting them to  share this experience with the world. Their album Spirit of the Forest catapulted them to global  fame, but they've stayed true to their roots. To ensure the Baka people benefit from their music,  they set up the charity "Global Music Exchange" and still visit the same Baka extended family  every year to ensure that they continue to benefit. 
From humble beginnings to a multicultural phenomenon, Baka Beyond's stage shows are a  testament to the power of music to unite us all. With band members hailing from across the globe,  each bringing their own unique flair.

funky-town.name: FUNKY TOWN
funky-town.bio:
We are FunkyTown, and we are here to make your clothes feel suddenly optional

We deliver pure unfiltered soul music driven by a guitar, bass and drum groove that locks you in while our trumpet and trombone duo blow enough heat to melt the stage. Up front, the vocals are pure velvet, delivering sexy soul singing that will make you look at your partner, or a random stranger, a little differently

We do not do subtle, and we do not do polite. We bring the sweat, the groove and bad decisions

the-timahoe-male-choir.name: THE TIMAHOE MALE CHOIR
the-timahoe-male-choir.bio: A group of men from Timahoe Co Laois in the Midlands of Ireland, who love singing.

the-pearly-whites.name: THE PEARLY WHITES
the-pearly-whites.bio:
The Pearly Whites bring a high-energy blend of powerful vocals, exceptional musicianship and a huge brass sound to stages across Ireland. Known for their infectious stage presence and crowd-pleasing performances, they have built a reputation for creating unforgettable experiences wherever they perform.

Drawing inspiration from across the decades, their setlist seamlessly blends artists such as Paolo Nutini, David Bowie, The Cranberries, Blur, Lionel Richie, AC/DC and Chappell Roan, alongside Irish favourites, dance classics and timeless party hits. The result is a show that appeals to all ages and keeps audiences singing and dancing from start to finish.

Having performed at major events and venues throughout Ireland, The Pearly Whites bring a feel-good energy and genuine connection with their audience that sets them apart. Expect huge choruses, soaring brass, plenty of crowd participation and a soundtrack packed with songs you know and love as they bring their unique show to Electric Picnic 2026.

bootleg-beach-boys.name: BOOTLEG BEACH BOYS
bootleg-beach-boys.bio: The Bootleg Beach Boys perform selections of classic hits, & cult  favourites, from California's most famous band. From surf themed  anthems such as "Surfin' Safari" & "Surfer Girl" to classic muscle  car memorabiles like "Shut Down" & "Fun Fun Fun", the band  have gathered an impressive repertoire of west coast, harmony  laden songs, that evoke the spirit and essence of the pursuit of the  1960's American dream.

mccartney-all-the-best.name: MCCARTNEY ALL THE BEST
mccartney-all-the-best.bio:
McCartney: All the Best' is a live music tribute show that perfectly captures the essence of McCartney’s stellar years as a member of the groundbreaking and iconic band, The Beatles. But it doesn’t stop there; it goes beyond, exploring McCartney’s pioneering foray into Low-Fi, his million-selling band, Wings and the solo treasures.

Prepare to be enthralled as the stage comes alive with timeless hits like 'Hey Jude', 'Get Back', 'All My Loving', 'Can’t Buy Me Love', 'Lady Madonna', 'Band on the Run', 'Live and Let Die', 'My Love', 'Silly Love Songs', 'Pipes of Peace', 'No More Lonely Nights' and countless others, anthems that have earned Paul McCartney the status of the most successful recording artist of all time.

eppie.name: EPPIE
eppie.bio: Their sound being described as “endearing, daisy-fresh and effortlessly romantic”, Eppie is a four-piece band from Dublin that blends their love of 60s and 70s psychedelic rock with modern alternative and bedroom pop artists to create music that stands out amongst the sea of rock bands across the Dublin scene. Named after frontwoman Palomi’s younger sister, the band has seen early success, most recently having been listed among Hot Press Magazine’s “Hot for ‘26” artists. They have performed multiple successful shows across Ireland, and recently made their international debut in London. Fans can catch them live at Electric Picnic at the end of August, or at Ireland Music Week in October.

pop-gods.name: POP GODS
pop-gods.bio: Pop Gods are a nostalgic 80s and 90s band who have played over 1,000 shows, including Electric Picnic, the Google Summer Party (three years running), and many international gigs such as Bugatti Rimac in Zagreb and New Year’s Eve balls in Bahrain and Oman.From Whitney, Wham!, Spice Girls, Take That, and Westlife—Expect Trailer Park to bounce the way only Pop Gods can make it bounce.

esmerelda-road.name: ESMERELDA ROAD
esmerelda-road.bio:
Esmeralda Road are a Belfast band quickly establishing themselves as one of the most exciting new live acts to emerge from the UK and Ireland.
Built on sharp songwriting, restless rhythms and an instinct for turning small rooms into full-blown parties, the band first gained attention through a string of sold-out shows in Belfast and early releases that spread quickly online. On stage, their reputation grew just as quickly. Esmeralda Road began taking their high-energy live show across the UK and Ireland, sharing stages with artists including Liam Gallagher and Primal Scream, while building a devoted following through touring.
Off the back of a support tour with Irish indie risers Basht., with new music on the horizon, and big live plans for the rest of the year, 2026 is shaping up to be a landmark year for Esmeralda Road.

hank-the-lads.name: HANK & THE LADS
hank-the-lads.bio:
Hank & The Lads are a three-piece Irish band whose sound has been shaped in the pubs of Drogheda — soulful, honest performances and stories that connect straight with a crowd. Soulful vocals meet alt-folk and country, blended into a catchy, genre-crossing pop-acoustic sound that's all their own.
Their debut single "Animal" is already gaining serious traction — over 100,000 views on TikTok and airplay on 2FM — backed by a strong and growing social campaign, with a cohesive visual identity carried right through from their single artwork to their socials and Spotify. Catch the lads performing live most weekends around Ireland.

savage-hearts.name: SAVAGE HEARTS
savage-hearts.bio: For 8 years Irish rock 'n' rollers The Strypes tore up stages around the world from Glastonbury, Fuji Rock and the David Letterman show to tours with the likes of Arctic Monkeys, Foo Fighters, Blur, Stone Roses and many more. Now drummer and founding member Evan Walsh has brought the band's legacy forward with The Savage Hearts, mixing psychedelia and garage rock sounds with the tight, experienced musicianship of Darragh Muldoon, Stef Byrne and Sam Morrissey. In the short time since forming the band has scored 5 No. 1 singles on the Irish downloads chart and gigged heavily including shows with iconic acts The Boomtown Rats, The Undertones, Dr. Feelgood, Jerry Fish and The Would Be's amongst others. The band has also hit some of the UK's most iconic stages from London's Hope & Anchor, Hawley Arms and Dublin Castle to the iconic Cavern Club in Liverpool. Now signed to UK indie label Blaggers Records and working on their debut album, The Savage Hearts' future is looking brighter than ever.

shakalak.name: SHAKALAK
shakalak.bio:
Shakalak are an Irish psychedelic hip-hop band who have built a dedicated cult following over the last number of years. Their music is built with live electronic beats, synthesisers,  psychedelic electric guitar, and saxophone, coupled with the lyrical dexterity of poet John Cummins. They have performed sold out headline shows in Dublin (Whelan's, Workman’s Club, Grand Social, Button Factory) and many other venues and festivals around Ireland.

Their most recent album Kulture Bikki is a global, local, lyrical, musical, rhythmic trip.
Trigger warning: May Contain Love Bullets - Enjoy the dip!

"Cummins is the real deal; a curious, musical, staccato flow, and brilliantly nostalgic and visceral tales of festival, childhood, football and chippers." 
 - The Irish Times on Shakalak frontman John Cummins

dj-will-softly.name: DJ Will Softly
dj-will-softly.bio: The soundtrack to glitter, wellies and ice creams. DJ Will Softly brings festival-sized singalongs to the Ickle Big Stage with clean edits of today’s hits, indie classics, and 70/80/90/00s nostalgia. From rock anthems to dancefloor fillers, he’s got parents + kids dancing in the same tent. Bubbles, big choruses, zero stress. The daytime party everyone attends. Amazing prizes for the best dancers.

hype-man-jackson-feat-calum-kieran.name: Hype Man Jackson feat. Calum Kieran
hype-man-jackson-feat-calum-kieran.bio: Hype Man Jackson feat. Calum Kieran is an energetic brother duo from Dublin, bringing big festival energy, crowd interaction and feel-good music to audiences of all ages. Nine-year-old Jackson leads the entertainment as the act’s charismatic hype man, while his older brother Calum Kieran delivers dynamic DJ sets tailored to every audience, blending a wide range of genres while staying true to his signature electronic sound rooted in techno, trance and acid-driven music.

don-king.name: Don King
don-king.bio: DonKing Rongavilla is a dynamic force in the world of dance and performance, bringing creativity, energy, and expertise to every project. With experience in both small and large-scale productions across various genres, he has established himself as a dancer, choreographer, director, instructor, teacher, presenter, and performer. A true creative visionary, he is dedicated to pushing boundaries and delivering unforgettable experiences. He can make everyone dance , inclusivity is the key. Whether on stage, behind the scenes, or in the studio, Don King Rongavilla continues to inspire and elevate the world of dance and performance.

niall-de-burca.name: Niall de Burca
niall-de-burca.bio: Grab your seats early and hang on tight… Niall de Búrca returns for a hooley of tales! Niall is a Seanchaí with a unique style that appeals to audiences worldwide. As a kid in the West he listened to scéals aplenty. Nowadays he performs and investigates stories in amazing countries like Korea, Lithuania and Ghana. Get ready for a talefeast that will take you on a rollercoaster ride of the imagination! Niall has performed in such wonderful places as Áras an Uachtaráin and Kronberg Castle in Denmark where Shakespeare set Hamlet. He’s even performed aboard the Sea Stallion; a replica of a 1000 year old Viking ship that was built in Ireland with wood from Glendalough!

ballymore-eustace-brass-band.name: Ballymore Eustace Brass Band
ballymore-eustace-brass-band.bio: Ballymore-Eustace Concert Band presents an array of music with a repertoire featuring movie scores, pop classical and rock pieces. Expect everything from Bon Jovi to Sondheim to Abba from this 40 strong community band.

baby-boppers-with-emarley.name: Baby Boppers with Emarley
baby-boppers-with-emarley.bio: Baby Boppers & Rhythm Rascals is a music-filled dance class with lots of colour and fun involved. It’s a class where parents and little ones move together to the beat! And don’t worry those beats aren’t just all the baby preferences, a lot are tunes parents absolutely love! Wear babies comfortably in their baby carriers for gentle movement, while allowing little crawlers and walkers explore rhythms in a safe, supportive, feel good space. Designed to boost fitness, coordination, and bonding, each session promotes well-being for both parent and child. Move to the groove, prism to the rhythm, connect and bop one beat at a time at our workshop.

kowgirl-kourtney-aerial-and-hula-hoop-ex.name: Kowgirl Kourtney - Aerial and Hula Hoop Extravaganza
kowgirl-kourtney-aerial-and-hula-hoop-ex.bio: Kowgirl Kourtney is bringing the Wild West to Electric Picnic with an action-packed aerial and hula hoop show, followed by a fun, interactive hula hoop workshop for all ages. Expect big tricks, big smiles, and plenty of fun for the whole family!

son-s-of-ire.name: Son's of Éire
son-s-of-ire.bio: Sons of Éire are a trio of Irish musicians — Liam Lynch (Bailieborough, Co. Cavan), Mark Haines (Birr, Co. Offaly) and Andrew Beirne (Carrigallen, Co. Leitrim). The group has represented Ireland internationally, performing at the Irish Embassy in Zambia for St Patrick's Day celebrations in both 2024 and 2025 — a rare honour reflecting their standing as ambassadors for Irish traditional music abroad. Drawing from three different counties, Sons of Éire bring a shared passion for Irish music and culture, blending tradition with a modern edge that resonates with audiences at home and overseas.

abegail.name: Abegail
abegail.bio: Performing originals and covers, Abigail is preparing her debut album and is delighted to be bringing her sound to Electric Picnic this year. Inspired by the likes of boygenius, Big Thief and Elliott Smith, her set will shift from quiet and vulnerable to bold and powerful.

mark-the-science-guy.name: Mark The Science Guy
mark-the-science-guy.bio: Mark Langtry, aka 'Mark the Science Guy', - the nation's favourite science teacher. Mark is a Scientist, Author, Educator and Presenter of RTE's award-winning science series, 'Let's Find Out'. Through exciting live shows, television, media content and educational resources, Mark brings science to life for audiences of all ages. His work inspires curiosity, encourages people to explore how the world works, and empowers young people to learn, grow and realise their potential through education.

crann-tree-planting-workshop.name: Crann Tree Planting Workshop
crann-tree-planting-workshop.bio: Crann is Ireland’s oldest trees charity, celebrating our 40th anniversary this year. Our mission is to educate and promote the beauty and true value of Ireland’s trees. Crann’s education team visit schools across Ireland. The Little Picnic shows are aimed at giving all the young Picnic-ers and their families an authentic Crann experience and to explain our schools’ programme. The workshops and performances promise to be practical, exciting and action-packed outdoor learning experiences for tree-planting and story-filled, inclusive and musical, arts-based adventures. In the words of our founder Jan Alexander, this will be a ‘hearts and minds’ experience where our young people will learn how to “Re-leaf Ireland”- from Stradbally to the rest of the world. Crann’s education officer James Lowry is a primary and inclusive educator with 25 years of work in Irish schools and their woodlands and gardens. He is also a member of the Irish Wildlife Trust and the Climate ambassador programme.

ruth-shine-school-of-dance.name: Ruth Shine School of Dance
ruth-shine-school-of-dance.bio: Ruth Shine School of Dance, established for over 20 years, is a forward thinking, creative dance school based in Blessington and Palmerstown. We firmly believe dance is for everyone and push ourselves to provide the highest quality classes for our community.

instrument-building-workshop.name: Instrument Building Workshop
instrument-building-workshop.bio: Learn the skills needed to handcraft a unique instrument from recycled materials.

zine-making-workshop-with-etereal-magzin.name: Zine Making Workshop with Etereal Magzine
zine-making-workshop-with-etereal-magzin.bio: Collage Workshop with Ethereal Magazine. We'll dive into the art of combining print media using simple paper tools in a relaxed setting. Come alone and makes friends, or bring someone with you. It's a fun and playful hour of creativity to indulge your inner artist this weekend. A patient artist guides you through the session, where you'll cut and paste together an original art piece. All materials are provided but feel free to bring your own magazines or any fun printed materials you've gathered over the weekend. You can bring your collage home or we can send you a scan via email.

atu-robotics-workshop.name: ATU Robotics Workshop
atu-robotics-workshop.bio: Hosted by Atlantic Technological University and Offaly County Council, this workshop will give attendees the chance to pilot VEX Robots built for the primary school VEX Robotics competition on a VEX Arena. These robots will all be unique and will be able to complete different tasks moving field elements to give each participant their own distinctive experience with piloting these robots. For those with an interest in any aspect of STEM or just want to have some fun piloting automata this showcase is the right choice. A Robotics workshop where kids will get the chance to control a variety of different robots all with different capabilities for a different driving experience with each. The workshop will be an interactive demonstration of the VEX Robotics programme.

little-irish-history-heros-with-niamh-do.name: Little Irish History Heros with Niamh Donnellan
little-irish-history-heros-with-niamh-do.bio: Join children’s author Niamh Donnellan for storytelling and crafts based on her book, Little Irish History Heroes. Niamh Donnellan is a writer and poet. She won the Anthology Short Story Award 2020 and in Kilkenny with her young family and two mischievous cats. This a fun, rhyming introduction to the heroes of Irish legend. Hear stories about the giant Fionn Mac Cumhaill, pirate queen Grace O'Malley, high king Brian Boru, bold Queen Maeve, kind St Brigid and young hurler Cú Chulainn for a new twist on ancient tales of bravery. Then make your own hero's crown to take home! Age 4-8.

crann-music-storytelling.name: Crann Music & Storytelling
crann-music-storytelling.bio: Crann is Ireland’s oldest trees charity, celebrating our 40th anniversary this year. Our mission is to educate and promote the beauty and true value of Ireland’s trees. Crann’s education team visit schools across Ireland. The Little Picnic shows are aimed at giving all the young Picnic-ers and their families an authentic Crann experience and to explain our schools’ programme. The workshops and performances promise to be practical, exciting and action-packed outdoor learning experiences for tree-planting and story-filled, inclusive and musical, arts-based adventures. In the words of our founder Jan Alexander, this will be a ‘hearts and minds’ experience where our young people will learn how to “Re-leaf Ireland”- from Stradbally to the rest of the world. Crann’s education officer James Lowry is a primary and inclusive educator with 25 years of work in Irish schools and their woodlands and gardens. He is also a member of the Irish Wildlife Trust and the Climate ambassador programme.

planet-science-kidz-slime-lab.name: Planet Science Kidz: Slime Lab
planet-science-kidz-slime-lab.bio: Get ready to stretch it, squish it, bubble it, and BLAST it! Planet Science Kidz: Slime Labs is where kids dive into the wild world of chemistry and polymers through messy, magical, hands-on fun. Create Slime Monsters, blow Giant Slime Bubbles, and watch epic Slime Falls ooze before your eyes! But that’s not all… young scientists will also witness erupting test tubes, jaw-dropping Coke geysers, and even an exciting rocket launch! It’s the ultimate lab for gooey creations, big reactions, and curious minds.One seriously fun, hands-on science adventure not to be missed!

festival-fashion-lab.name: Festival Fashion Lab
festival-fashion-lab.bio: Join us for a hands-on T-shirt customisation workshop where a plain tee becomes something uniquely yours. Using fabric paint, ribbons, beads, eyelets, tulle and simple cutting techniques, you’ll transform a blank T-shirt into a one-off festival outfit ready for the evening’s music and celebrations. Whether you want bold graphics, statement sleeves, fringe, colour, sparkle or something completely unexpected, we’ll provide the materials, inspiration and guidance to get you started. No experience is needed and all materials are included. Suitable for all ages—just bring your imagination and leave with a custom piece you’ll actually want to wear.

lino-print-festival-bunting.name: Lino Print Festival Bunting
lino-print-festival-bunting.bio: Discover the art of lino printing while creating a colourful string of festival bunting. Carve your own design or print with pre-carved stamps, then decorate your campsite or bring your bunting home as a unique reminder of the festival.

lino-print-your-own-wooden-bookmark.name: Lino Print Your Own Wooden Bookmark
lino-print-your-own-wooden-bookmark.bio: Create a unique wooden bookmark in this fun, hands-on lino printing workshop. Carve your own stamp or choose from a collection of pre-carved designs inspired by nature and storytelling, then print your bookmark to take home as a lasting festival keepsake.

messy-play-with-all-abilities.name: Messy Play with All Abilities
messy-play-with-all-abilities.bio: Roll up your sleeves & get ready for messy sensory fun! Using all our senses we'll splash and squish and squash getting creative and learning how playful activities can help manage big emotions! All Abilities Ireland working out of Portlaoise for the last 15 years are here to help parents connect and little people make friends.

tie-dye-with-lollipop-apparel.name: Tie Dye with Lollipop Apparel
tie-dye-with-lollipop-apparel.bio: Lollipop Apparel creates vibrant, handmade tie-dye hoodies designed by you and brought to life with colour, care and creativity.
